As Triple H sets his sights on taking the WWE Undisputed Championship at WrestleMania, Kurt Angle looks for a golden opportunity of his own.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 04, 2002
videos.overview: Triple H faces Kurt Angle in a steel cage. In order to force Ric Flair into accepting his challenge to a match at WrestleMania, The Undertaker sets his sights on "The Nature Boy"'s flesh and blood. Plus, the NWO looks to finish the job they started on "Stone Cold" Steve Austin, Rob Van Dam takes on Lance Storm, and much more action.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 11, 2002
videos.overview: The NWO battles The Rock & "Stone Cold" Steve Austin 3-on-2 Handicap Match. The rivalry between Triple H and WWE Undisputed Champion Chris Jericho gets personal when The Game's pride and joy is put in harm's way. Plus, Mr. McMahon calls an emergency Board Meeting to discuss the state of WWE, Lita & Trish Stratus face Stacy Keibler & Jazz, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 18, 2002
videos.overview: CEO Linda McMahon makes an historic announcement that will reshape the landscape of WWE for years to come with a Brand Extension that will see Mr. McMahon taking control of SmackDown while Ric Flair oversees Monday Night Raw. As the WWE Universe readies for the first ever WWE Draft, nothing will prepare them for the arrival of Brock Lesnar.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 25, 2002
videos.overview: History is made as the first ever WWE Draft pits SmackDown General Manager Mr.McMahon against RAW General Manager Ric Flair in a battle over the superstars that will belong to their brands. From The Rock and Hulk Hogan to the Undertaker and Rob Van Dam, the destination of WWE's top superstars will be decided in the birth of the WWE Brand Extension.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 01, 2002
videos.overview: Following the first WWE Draft, a new era begins on Monday Night Raw as Co-Owner Ric Flair takes the helm of WWE's flagship show. While "The Nature Boy" looks to sign "Stone Cold" Steve Austin exclusively to his brand, Mr. McMahon arrives with his own agenda. WWE Undisputed Champion Triple H receives a new title and a new challenge and more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 08, 2002
videos.overview: With Mr. McMahon disrupting WWE Co-Owner Ric Flair's plans to name an opponent for the WWE Undisputed Championship at Backlash, "The Nature Boy" gives both "Stone Cold" Steve Austin and The Undertaker an opportunity to become the No. 1 Contender. In the wake of Brock Lesnar's trail of carnage, Paul Heyman explains his association with the Beast.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 15, 2002
videos.overview: The Undertaker teams with the NWO's Scott Hall & X-Pac to take on Bradshaw & "Stone Cold" Steve Austin in a Handicap main event. The Hardy Boyz face Booker T & Goldust. Paul Heyman springs a trap on Brock Lesnar's next victim. Plus, Molly Holly faces Trish Stratus to determine the No. 1 Contender for the Women's Championship and more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 22, 2002
videos.overview: "Stone Cold" Steve Austin looks for payback on the NWO. Triple H looks for revenge of his own as he targets The Undertaker. Plus, Brock Lesnar's path of destruction continues as he goes one-on-one with Matt Hardy, Goldust & Booker T battle Bubba Ray & Spike Dudley, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 29, 2002
videos.overview: With Big Show aligned with the NWO after turning on "Stone Cold" Steve Austin, Co-Owner Ric Flair again tries to set things acting as referee when the Rattlesnake & Bradshaw take on Scott Hall & X-Pac. As WWE Undisputed Champion Hulk Hogan faces William Regal Eddie Guerrero defends the Intercontinental Championship against Jeff Hardy and more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 06, 2002
videos.overview: The NWO promises to reveal a shocking surprise that will change the very nature of Raw. The Undertaker's pursuit for the WWE Undisputed Championship ends up costing him another prized possession when Hulk Hogan goes for a little ride. Goldust follows Booker T to an unusual location. Plus, Brock Lesnar, William Regal, and many more in action.

videos.title: Raw - May. 13, 2002
videos.overview: Ric Flair challenges Hulk Hogan for the WWE Undisputed Championship in a No Disqualification match. But when "Stone Cold" Steve Austin disrupts his opportunity, "The Nature Boy" forces the Rattlesnake to compete in a Lumberjack match against the newest member of the NWO. Plus, Brock Lesnar battles the Hardy Boyz in a Handicap match and more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 20, 2002
videos.overview: Rob Van Dam challenges WWE Undisputed Champion The Undertaker for the gold. After being put out-of-action on the orders of WWE Co-Owner Ric Flair, "Stone Cold" Steve Austin runs into trouble at local bar. Plus, Kevin Nash returns to take command of the NWO, Brock Lesnar looks to invade Dudleyville, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 27, 2002
videos.overview: Eddie Guerrero defends his Intercontinental Championship against Rob Van Dam in a Ladder match. Bubba Ray Dudley gets a chance at payback as he take on Brock Lesnar. Plus, the NWO's X-Pac & Booker T face the Hardy Boyz, Tommy Dreamer shows WWE Undisputed Champion The Undertaker what lengths he is willing to go to, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 03, 2002
videos.overview: "Stone Cold" Steve Austin faces Ric Flair. Brock Lesnar teams with Eddie Guerrero to take on Bubba Ray Dudley & Intercontinental Champion Rob Van Dam. Kevin Nash breaks a lot of hearts when introduces the newest addition to the NWO. Plus, the King of the Ring Qualifying matches, Tommy Dreamer faces WWE Undisputed Champion The Undertaker, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 10, 2002
videos.overview: Ric Flair receives an unexpected challenge from Mr. McMahon to face off in a No Holds Barred Match for sole ownership of WWE. Brock Lesnar battles Bubba Ray Dudley in a King of the Ring Qualification Match. Plus, Shawn Michaels gives the boot to a member of the NWO, the Hardy Boyz confront WWE Undisputed Champion The Undertaker, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 17, 2002
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon breaks his silence about "Stone Cold" Steve Austin leaving WWE, and has his world rocked with the return of another iconic superstar. Plus, Brock Lesnar takes on Booker T in a King of the Ring Quarterfinal Match main event, Matt Hardy faces WWE Undisputed Champion The Undertaker, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 24, 2002
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon challenges the Raw Superstars to prove they have ruthless aggression. Intercontinental Champion Rob Van Dam battles the 2002 King of the Ring Brock Lesnar in the main event. Plus, Booker T & Goldust target the NWO by taking on X-Pac and the Big Show, Jeff Hardy faces WWE Undisputed Champion The Undertaker, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 01, 2002
videos.overview: As Paul Heyman continues to unleash Brock Lesnar on the WWE, Ric Flair looks to stop The Next Big Thing's path of destruction. Dissent is brewing within the New World Order but Shawn Michaels reveals he has a solution. In an epic main event, Jeff Hardy challenges Undertaker for the Undisputed WWE Championship in a Ladder Match. Plus, Rob Van Dam and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 08, 2002
videos.overview: The NWO sends a message to an old friend before teaming with a couple of radical superstars to take on Booker T, Goldust, Rob Van Dam, Bubby Ray & Spike Dudley in a 10-Man Tag Team main event. Brock Lesnar and Paul Heyman receive a warm homecoming from some ECW Alumni. Jeff Hardy challenges William Regal for the European Championship and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 15, 2002
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon drops a bombshell on the WWE Universe when he introduces a former rival as the new General Manager of Raw. Brock Lesnar teams with WWE Undisputed Champion The Undertaker to take on Ric Flair & Rob Van Dam. Booker T battles Big Show. Plus, a Six-Man Tag Team Elimination match, Trish Stratus in action, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 22, 2002
videos.overview: Raw General Manager Eric Bischoff introduces Triple H to the brand with Shawn Michaels as his manager. But when The Heartbreak Kid takes exception to his new boss, The Game sets things right. Brock Lesnar makes a shocking business decision. Rob Van Dam meets Jeff Hardy in a Ladder match to unify the European and Intercontinental Championships.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 29, 2002
videos.overview: Raw General Manager Eric Bischoff introduces some new additions to his brand. After his recent betrayal at the hands of Triple H, Shawn Michaels goes on a hunt for some retribution on The Game. Plus, Ric Flair goes one-on-one with WWE Undisputed Champion The Rock, Fabulous Moolah is given three minutes to plug her new autobiography, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 05, 2002
videos.overview: As Triple H searches for the unknown assailant responsible for viciously assaulting Shawn Michaels, the details behind this sordid attack come to light when Raw General Manager Eric Bischoff sets up a meeting via satellite between The Game and the Heartbreak Kid. Rob Van Dam takes on Chris Jericho. Plus, 3-Minute Warning, Tommy Dreamer, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug 12, 2002
videos.overview: Triple H battles The Undertaker to become the Number One Contender for Brock Lesnar's WWE Undisputed Title. Plus, RVD, Jeff Hardy, and more!

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 19, 2002
videos.overview: Triple H goes one-on-one with WWE Undisputed Champion The Rock in a No Disqualification main event. Shawn Michaels decides to show The Game that he is more than ready for a fight. Plus, The Undertaker teams with Booker T & Goldust to take on The Un-Americans in a Six-Man Tag Team Match, Chris Jericho targets Ric Flair, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 26, 2002
videos.overview: Brock Lesnar returns to Raw while Triple H and The Undertaker battle in the main event for a chance to become the No. 1 Contender for his title. However, SmackDown GM Stephanie McMahon shows up with announcement that will change the complexion of the Brand Extension. Plus, Rob Van Dam, Jeff Hardy, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 02, 2002
videos.overview: In retaliation for Stephanie McMahon making Brock Lesnar and his Undisputed Championship exclusive to the SmackDown brand, Raw General Manager Eric Bischoff makes history by revealing a new Heavyweight Championship exclusive to the red brand. Kane faces Lance Storm & Christian in a Handicap Match. Plus, Triple H, Booker T, Rob Van Dam, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 09, 2002
videos.overview: Intercontinental Champion Rob Van Dam battles Chris Jericho, the Big Show, and Jeff Hardy in a Fatal 4-Way Elimination main event to determine the No. 1 Contender for the World Championship. Plus, Kane and Bradshaw take on the Un-Americans, Bubba Ray Dudley in action, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 16, 2002
videos.overview: As Rob Van Dam prepares to challenge Triple H for his World Heavyweight Championship at Unforgiven, "Mr. Monday Night" must first defend his Intercontinental Championship against Chris Jericho while The Game puts his gold on the line against Jeff Hardy. Plus, Kane goes one-on-one with William Regal, Rico makes his Raw debut, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 23, 2002
videos.overview: After preventing Rob Van Dam from capturing the World Heavyweight Championship against Triple H at Unforgiven, Ric Flair's relationship with The Game begins to evolve as both men join forces to take on Bubba Ray Dudley and RVD. Raw General Manager Eric Bischoff looks to lay down the law. Randy Orton makes his Raw debut, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 30, 2002
videos.overview: While Bubba Ray Dudley seizes an opportunity to challenge Triple H for his World Heavyweight Championship, Kane begins a journey of his own when he faces Chris Jericho for the Intercontinental Championship. Eric Bischoff looks to make an example out of Lita. Plus, Trish Stratus defends her Women's Championship against Victoria, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 07, 2002
videos.overview: Raw General Manager Eric Bischoff introduces a concept where anything and everything can happen in a game of chance. The Superstars of Raw compete in a series of unique matches that can only be chosen by a game of Roulette. Plus, World Heavyweight Champion Triple H makes a shocking revelation about Kane's past.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 14, 2002
videos.overview: World Heavyweight Champion Triple H battles Rob Van Dam in a Canadian Lumberjack Match. Intercontinental Champion Kane breaks his silence about The Game's shocking allegations. Plus, Booker T goes one-on-one with the Big Show in a Falls Count Anywhere Match, Molly Holly & Victoria face Jacqueline & Women's Champion Trish Stratus, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 21, 2002
videos.overview: While Kane prepares to challenge Triple H for his World Heavyweight Championship at No Mercy by competing against him in a Tag Team main event, The Game decides to rub salt in the Big Red Machine's wounds with a shocking display of humiliation that would become one of the most controversial moments in Raw history. Plus, Rob Van Dam and more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 28, 2002
videos.overview: Despite defeating Kane at No Mercy, World Heavyweight Champion Triple H looks to put his rivalry with the Big Red Machine to rest when they meet in a Casket Match. However, The Game may be in for some heartbreak when an old friend returns to settle a score. Eric Bischoff introduces a concept for a new structure to be unveiled at Survivor Series.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 04, 2002
videos.overview: With his reign as World Heavyweight Champion being threatened by the first ever Elimination Chamber Match at the upcoming Survivor Series, Triple H seeks answers regarding Shawn Michaels' WWE future. Plus, The Game & Chris Jericho take on Booker T & Kane. Dave Batista makes his Raw debut, Rob Van Dam battles Christian, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 11, 2002
videos.overview: As the very first Elimination Chamber Match for the World Heavyweight Championship approaches at Survivor Series, Shawn Michaels stakes his claim in the contest while Triple H faces Booker T in the main event. While her problems with Women's Champion Trish Stratus continue, Victoria takes out her aggression on Terri once again. Plus, Kane and more.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 18, 2002
videos.overview: Shawn Michaels kicks off his reign as the new World Heavyweight Champion with three challengers to his title when Rob Van Dam battles Booker T and Chris Jericho in a Triple Threat Match to determine the No. 1 Contender for the gold. Scott Steiner speaks on the current state of WWE. Plus, Women's Champion Victoria, 3-Minute Warning, and many more.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 25, 2002
videos.overview: Shawn Michaels defends his World Heavyweight Championship against Rob Van Dam. Trish Stratus looks to recapture the Women's Championship by challenging Victoria for the gold. Batista sets his sights on Kane in singles action. Plus, Jeff Hardy & The Hurricane take on Lance Storm & William Regal, Goldust battles Rico, and much more action.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 02, 2002
videos.overview: The rivalry between Triple H and World Heavyweight Champion Shawn Michaels continues to escalate when the Heartbreak Kid serves as the Special Guest Referee for The Game's main event battle with Rob Van Dam to determine the new No. 1 Contender for Michaels' title. Batista faces The Hurricane. Plus, Trish Stratus in action and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec 09, 2002
videos.overview: Eric Bischoff adds a stipulation to Triple H's World Heavyweight Title defense vs. Shawn Michaels at Armageddon. Plus, Kane, Y2J, and more!

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 16, 2002
videos.overview: Shawn Michaels is called out by one of his most loyal followers. While Triple H celebrates his new championship reign, Scott Steiner arrives to let him know exactly why he signed with Raw. Plus, Chris Jericho goes one-on-one with Booker T, Kane & Rob Van Dam take on 3-Minute Warning, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 23, 2002
videos.overview: In the midst of the holiday season, RAW General Manager Eric Bischoff looks to punish Jim Ross & Jerry "The King" Lawler by forcing them to team up in the main event against Lance Storm & William Regal. Triple H issues a unique challenge to Scott Steiner. Plus, Booker T & Goldust defend their World Tag Team Championship, Test in action, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 30, 2002
videos.overview: As 2002 comes to a close, join Jonathan Coachman and Terri as they highlight some of the year's most memorable matches and unforgettable moments in WWE. From The Rock facing Hollywood Hulk Hogan at WrestleMania X8 to the in-ring return of Shawn Michaels against Triple H at SummerSlam, relive the most exciting action from throughout the year.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 06, 2003
videos.overview: Christian & Chris Jericho take on Kane & Rob Van Dam. Despite being defeated by Scott Steiner in an Arm Wrestling Match, World Heavyweight Champion Triple H issues another unique challenge to Big Poppa Pump. Plus, Booker T & Goldust defend their World Tag Team Championship against Lance Storm & William Regal, Test battles Chris Nowinski, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 13, 2003
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon returns to give General Manager Eric Bischoff the proper motivation to turn Raw completely around. World Heavyweight Champion Triple H meets Scott Steiner in another unique contest. The Superstars of Raw compete in a Battle Royal where the winner will get to choose his entrance number in the 2003 Royal Rumble Match. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 20, 2003
videos.overview: Raw General Manager Eric Bischoff drops a bombshell on the WWE Universe by inviting a former adversary to return at No Way Out. One of the most legendary factions in history is formed when Scott Steiner's challenge to a Royal Rumble rematch against World Heavyweight Champion Triple H is answered by an animal. Jeff Hardy faces Rob Van Dam and more!

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 27, 2003
videos.overview: On a night where World Heavyweight Champion Triple H and Batista take on Kane and Rob Van Dam in the main event, Scott Steiner learns that The Game doesn't come to a fight by himself. Plus, Booker T goes one-on-one with Jeff Hardy, Victoria defends her Women's Championship against Trish Stratus in a Chicago Street Fight, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 03, 2003
videos.overview: Scott Steiner battles Chris Jericho in the main event for an opportunity at Triple H's World Heavyweight Championship. The Game gives his new faction a name that their enemies will come to fear. RAW General Manager Eric Bischoff leaves Chief Morely in charge while he travels through the great state of Texas in search of "Stone Cold" Steve Austin.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 10, 2003
videos.overview: With time running out in his quest to sign "Stone Cold" Steve Austin to Monday Night RAW before No Way Out, Eric Bischoff is confronted by Mr. McMahon who gives his former adversary one final chance to keep his job as Raw General Manager. Evolution's Batista looks to make an example out of Tommy Dreamer. Chris Jericho faces Jeff Hardy and more.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 17, 2003
videos.overview: As he awaits his confrontation with "Stone Cold" Steve Austin at No Way Out, Raw General Manager Eric Bischoff looks to warm up by competing in a No Holds Barred main event against The Rattlesnake's best friend, Jim Ross. Scott Steiner partners with Booker T to take on Evolution's Batista and World Heavyweight Champion Triple H. Plus, more action.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 24, 2003
videos.overview: The Rock returns to Raw to compete in a 20-Man Battle Royal to determine who will challenge Triple H for his World Heavyweight Championship at WrestleMania XIX. Evolution's Randy Orton & Batista face Scott Steiner & Booker T. Plus, Jerry "The King' Lawler battles Chief Morely in a No Disqualification Match, Kane in action, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 03, 2003
videos.overview: "Stone Cold" Steve Austin's return to Raw is met with an unceremonious welcome from his longtime rival The Rock. Booker T comes face-to-face with World Heavyweight Champion Triple H. Plus, Kane & Rob Van Dam battle Al Snow & Tommy Dreamer in a Hardcore Tag Team Match, Chris Jericho goes one-on-one with Test, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 10, 2003
videos.overview: Eric Bischoff looks to bury the hatchet with "Stone Cold" Steve Austin while The Rock challenges the Texas Rattlesnake to one more match at WrestleMania. Before World Heavyweight Champion Triple H takes on Maven, Booker T addresses The Game's recent comments. Plus, Trish Stratus battles Jazz for a chance at the Women's Championship and more.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 17, 2003
videos.overview: Eric Bischoff challenges "Stone Cold" Steve Austin to a Lumberjack Match, but plans change when The Rock makes a suggestion that spells trouble for The Rattlesnake. World Heavyweight Champion Triple H finds himself in match against Booker T's most loyal friend, Goldust. Plus, Chris Jericho & Christian take on Test & Scott Steiner and more.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 24, 2003
videos.overview: Booker T & Goldust take on Ric Flair and World Heavyweight Champion Triple H. With The Rock set to perform a special concert for the WWE Universe, Eric Bischoff bans "Stone Cold" Steve Austin from the building. Before their match on the grandest stage of them all, Chris Jericho pays a tribute to his childhood idol Shawn Michaels. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 31, 2003
videos.overview: When The Rock looks to celebrate his first WrestleMania victory over Stone Cold Steve Austin with a special Appreciation Night Ceremony for himself, The Great One is floored by the arrival an unexpected guest. After retaining his World Heavyweight Championship on the grandest stage of them all, Triple H faces The Hurricane.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 07, 2003
videos.overview: While the WWE Universe still buzzes over Goldberg's groundbreaking arrival, The Rock is left with a challenge to face him at Backlash. After witnessing "Stone Cold" Steve Austin's recent firing at the hands of Eric Bischoff, Jim Ross decides to take his career in a different direction. Chris Jericho & Triple H face Shawn Michaels & Booker T.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 14, 2003
videos.overview: Kevin Nash speaks out on his relationship with Shawn Michaels and World Heavyweight Champion Triple H. The Rock answers Goldberg's challenge. Plus, Kane & Rob Van Dam defend their World Tag Team Championship against Lance Storm & Chief Morely, Scott Steiner debates Chris Nowinski, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 21, 2003
videos.overview: Shawn Michaels serves a special guest referee for a WrestleMania XIX rematch between Booker T and World Heavyweight Champion Triple H. As his match against Goldberg at Backlash approaches, The Rock shows the WWE Universe exactly what he thinks of his opponent in a special concert. Plus, Lita returns, The Hurricane faces Chris Jericho, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 28, 2003
videos.overview: Trish Stratus faces Eric Bischoff in a No Disqualification Match main event. Linda McMahon returns with some news regarding "Stone Cold" Steve Austin. Following his victory over The Rock, Goldberg is given a platform to address the WWE Universe when Chris Jericho unveils the debut edition of The Highlight Reel. Triple H targets Kevin Nash and more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 05, 2003
videos.overview: With Stone Cold Steve Austin being brought back to Monday Night RAW as the new Co-General Manager of the brand, The Rattlesnake looks to make some changes that reignite his rivalry with Eric Bischoff. World Heavyweight Champion Triple H makes his presence felt when Chris Jericho features Kevin Nash as his guest on new edition of The Highlight Reel.

videos.title: Raw - May. 12, 2003
videos.overview: Kevin Nash faces Chris Jericho in the main event. Goldberg gets his hands on Christian in a Steel Cage Match. While Rob Van Dam and Kane each stake their claim in the upcoming Battle Royal to crown a new Intercontinental Champion, they must first defend their Tag Team Championship against the Legion of Doom. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 19, 2003
videos.overview: "Stone Cold" Steve Austin makes some action-packed matches and begins an investigation into who tried to run down Goldberg. When Triple H is forced to defend his World Heavyweight Championship in the main event against a former champion of his own choosing, The Game unwisely selects a friend. Plus, The Dudley Boyz in action and much more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 26, 2003
videos.overview: Eric Bischoff orders Shawn Michaels and Ric Flair to team up against Triple in the main event. On an all new edition of The Highlight Reel, Chris Jericho issues a challenge to his featured guest, Goldberg. Plus, Booker T, Rob Van Dam, and many more in action.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 02, 2003
videos.overview: Ric Flair, Randy Orton & World Heavyweight Champion Triple H take on Shawn Michaels, Kevin Nash & The Hurricane in a Six-Man Tag Team Match. When Chris Jericho runs in terror of Goldberg, Intercontinental Champion Christian takes over as host of The Highlight Reel with featured guest, The Rock. Plus, "Stone Cold" Steve Austin and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 09, 2003
videos.overview: As Triple H prepares to defend his World Heavyweight Championship against Kevin Nash inside a Hell in a Cell at Bad Blood, RAW Co-General Manager Stone Cold Steve Austin introduces a Special Guest Referee to maintain order in a match that he is all too familiar with. Before he can get his hands on Chris Jericho, Goldberg warms up for his upcoming match by taking on Rosey. Plus, Randy Orton battles The Hurricane, Booker T meets Christian in the first ever 'Spin-A-Rooney' Contest, and much more!

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 16, 2003
videos.overview: On a night where Kane & Rob Van Dam look to regain the World Tag Team Championship in the main event, World Heavyweight Champion Triple H offers the Big Red Machine a chance to join Evolution. However, Raw Co-General Manager "Stone Cold" Steve Austin has another offer for The Game's newest prospect. Plus, Booker T, Goldberg, and more in action.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 23, 2003
videos.overview: Kane puts his mask on the line against Triple H for The Game's World Heavyweight Championship. In blast from the past, Shawn Michaels & Kevin Nash team up to take on Evolution's Ric Flair & Randy Orton. Plus, Rodney Mack's "White Boy Challenge" is answered by Goldberg, Mick Foley is honored by his peers as a true Hardcore Legend, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 30, 2003
videos.overview: Rob Van Dam looks for some retribution for his former tag team partner Kane by challenging Triple H for his World Heavyweight Championship in a No Disqualification Match. Gail Kim makes her WWE debut by competing in a Battle Royal for Jazz's Women's Championship. Plus, Christian defends his Intercontinental Championship against Booker T and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 07, 2003
videos.overview: Raw Co-General Manager "Stone Cold" Steve Austin looks to call out Kane to try to motivate him in a less destructive direction. Ric Flair & Randy Orton battle Rob Van Dam & Bubba Ray Dudley. Plus, Booker T receives another opportunity at Christian's Intercontinental Championship, Shawn Michaels appears on an all-new Highlight Reel, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 14, 2003
videos.overview: Things get heated when Jim Ross sits down for a one-on-one interview with Kane. Evolution takes a trip to Dudleyville as Ric Flair, Randy Orton, and World Heavyweight Champion Triple H battle Bubba Ray, D-Von, and Spike Dudley in a Six-Man Tag Team Match. Plus, Gail Kim defends her Women's Championship against Molly Holly, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 21, 2003
videos.overview: After witnessing the recent disturbances caused by Kane, Linda McMahon returns to set things in order with the Co-General Managers of Raw, Eric Bischoff and "Stone Cold" Steve Austin. But when the Big Red Monster faces Rob Van Dam in the main event, the CEO of WWE finds herself in dangerous situation. Goldberg returns to show The Game who's next.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 28, 2003
videos.overview: Less than a week after giving CEO Linda McMahon a Tombstone heard around the world, Kane is forced to come face-to-face with another member of the McMahon family. With Goldberg set to challenge Triple H for his World Heavyweight Championship at SummerSlam, The Game sends a message to his upcoming opponent. Randy Orton appears on the Highlight Reel.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 04, 2003
videos.overview: When Eric Bischoff refuses to give Shane McMahon a match against Kane, "Stone Cold" Steve Austin orders his fellow Co-General Manager of Raw to face Shane-O-Mac in a No Holds Barred Match. Goldberg faces Ric Flair. Plus, Rob Van Dam goes one-on-one with Chris Jericho, Trish Stratus challenges Molly Holly for her Women's Championship, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 11, 2003
videos.overview: As Goldberg goes one-on-one with Ric Flair in the main event, RAW Co-General Manager "Stone Cold" Steve Austin decrees that he will suspend Evolution members Randy Orton and World Heavyweight Champion Triple H if they interfere. Plus, Christian defends his Intercontinental Championship, The Hurricane in action, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 18, 2003
videos.overview: On a night where Shane McMahon resolves to take out Eric Bischoff before their match at SummerSlam, the Co-General Manager of Raw brings their rivalry to another level by paying CEO Linda McMahon an unannounced visit at her home. Goldberg gets his hands on another member Evolution when he goes one-on-one with Randy Orton in the main event and more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 25, 2003
videos.overview: Goldberg issues another challenge to Triple H for his World Heavyweight Championship. When Shane McMahon takes exception to his father's comments on The Highlight Reel, he finds himself facing Chris Jericho. Plus, Eric Bischoff names the Raw Employee of the Month, Randy Orton takes on Maven, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 01, 2003
videos.overview: After turning the heat up in his rivalry with Kane, Shane McMahon finds himself at the mercy of the Big Red Monster. In an action-packed Six-Man Tag Team main event, Goldberg teams with Shawn Michaels & Maven to take on Evolution's Ric Flair, Randy Orton, & World Heavyweight Champion Triple H. "Stone Cold" Steve Austin, Chris Jericho, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 08, 2003
videos.overview: "Stone Cold" Steve Austin gives a "State of Raw Address." Evolution gets the better of Goldberg when he is forced to compete in a Tag Team Match. In retribution for saving Shane McMahon, Rob Van Dam faces Kane inside a steel cage. Plus, a 10-Man Tag Team Match, Gail Kim teams with Women's Champion Molly Holly, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 15, 2003
videos.overview: Shane McMahon and Kane sign the contract for their upcoming Last Man Standing Match. As his World Heavyweight Championship defense against Goldberg approaches, Triple H hosts a special celebration in honor of the career of his opponent. Plus, Rob Van Dam battles Chris Jericho, Jerry "The King" Lawler faces Al Snow, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 22, 2003
videos.overview: Goldberg begins his reign as World Heavyweight Champion by defending his title against Chris Jericho. Evolution takes on Maven, Garrison Cade & Mark Jindrak in a Six-Man Tag Team Match. Plus, Rob Van Dam challenges Christian for his Intercontinental Championship, Kane pays the recuperating Shane McMahon a visit, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 29, 2003
videos.overview: Despite "Stone Cold" Steve Austin being suspended by the WWE Board of Directors, his rivalry with his fellow Co-General Manager continues as Eric Bischoff takes control of Raw. While Triple H places a bounty on his head, World Heavyweight Champion Goldberg teams with Shawn Michaels to take on Evolution's Ric Flair & Randy Orton. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 06, 2003
videos.overview: With Triple H putting a bounty on Goldberg's head, The World's Strongest Man Mark Henry seizes an opportunity to cash in on the reward when battles the World Heavyweight Champion in the main event. After being assaulted in the hospital by Kane, Shane McMahon sends the Big Red Monster on the ride of his life. Plus, Rob Van Dam, Evolution, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 13, 2003
videos.overview: Shawn Michaels teams with World Heavyweight Champion Goldberg to take on Mark Henry and Evolution's Ric Flair & Randy Orton in a Handicap Match. When Chris Jericho tries to rally against the leadership "Stone Cold" Steve Austin, Shane McMahon teams with Booker T & The Dudley Boyz to battle Y2J and friends in an 8-Man Tag Team Tables Match.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 20, 2003
videos.overview: Eric Bischoff makes a special proposal to "Stone Cold" Steve Austin. When Goldberg defends his World Heavyweight Championship against Shawn Michaels, a more evolved Superstar returns to cash in on Triple H's offered bounty. Plus, Kane sends a message to Shane McMahon, Lita & Trish Stratus team up to take on Victoria & Molly Holly, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 27, 2003
videos.overview: With Goldberg being taken out by Batista on last week's edition of Monday Night RAW, Eric Bischoff looks to hand over the World Heavyweight Championship to Evolution. Rob Van Dam defends the Intercontinental Championship against Chris Jericho in a steel cage. Plus, Shane McMahon faces a mystery opponent in a No Disqualification Match and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 03, 2003
videos.overview: "Stone Cold" Steve Austin and fellow Co-General Manager Eric Bischoff meet to sign the contract for their teams to battle for control of Monday Night Raw at Survivor Series. Plus, Batista returns to the ring to take on Maven, Shawn Michaels goes one-on-one Mark Henry in the main event, and much more action.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 10, 2003
videos.overview: As the battle for control of Raw approaches at Survivor Series, members of both Team Austin and Team Bischoff meet in a series of matches including Shawn Michaels taking on Randy Orton. Goldberg goes one-on-one with Batista in the main event. Shane McMahon confronts Kane at an unusual location. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 17, 2003
videos.overview: Following his team's victory over Team Austin at Survivor Series, Eric Bischoff assumes total control of Raw as the sole General Manager and grants each of his loyal Superstars some special favors. Despite retaining his World Heavyweight Championship against Triple H, Goldberg is forced to battle Evolution in a main event Handicap Match.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 24, 2003
videos.overview: Eric Bischoff places his Superstars at the mercy of chance and circumstance when he reintroduces Raw Roulette. While this concept gives Triple H another chance at Goldberg's World Heavyweight Championship, Shawn Michaels finds himself less fortunate as he teams up with Chris Jericho to take on Batista & Ric Flair in the main event.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 01, 2003
videos.overview: Eric Bischoff receives some stunning news from the newly hired Outside Consultant, Mick Foley. With Foley being given the power by Linda McMahon to make any change he wants, World Heavyweight Champion Goldberg receives a chance to get his hands on Evolution when he teams with Shawn Michaels & Rob Van Dam to face Kane, Randy Orton & Batista.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 08, 2003
videos.overview: Mick Foley starts a petition to bring "Stone Cold" Steve Austin back to Raw. While struggling to maintain power on Raw, Eric Bischoff orders World Heavyweight Champion Goldberg to face Kane in a Lumberjack Match main event. Plus, Chris Jericho and Christian offer an apology to Lita and Trish Stratus, Batista battles Rob Van Dam, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 15, 2003
videos.overview: Evolution's World Heavyweight Champion Triple H and World Tag Team Champions Batista & Ric Flair take on Rob Van Dam & Shawn Michaels in the main event. Eric Bischoff unveils yet another plan to help him seize control of Raw by offering a proposal to his fellow Co-General Manager, Mick Foley. Plus, Rico battles Jon Heidenreich, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 22, 2003
videos.overview: Join Jerry "The King" Lawler and Jonathan Coachman as they review some of the Raw brand's most memorable matches and unforgettable moments from 2003. From Shawn Michaels' one-on-one battle against Chris Jericho at WrestleMania XIX, to Team Austin battling Team Bischoff at Survivor Series for complete control of RAW relive the best in Raw action.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 29, 2003
videos.overview: The WWE Board of Directors convene for a special meeting to decide "Stone Cold" Steve Austin's fate. Shawn Michaels receives another chance at glory when he challenges Triple H for the World Heavyweight Championship. Plus, Randy Orton defends his Intercontinental Championship against Booker T, Rob Van Dam goes one-on-one Scott Steiner, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 05, 2004
videos.overview: In his role as the new Sheriff of Raw, "Stone Cold" Steve Austin lays down the law by ordering Triple H to defend the World Heavyweight Championship against Shawn Michaels at the Royal Rumble in a unique match. Plus, Ric Flair & Batista defend the World Tag Team Championship against The Dudley Boyz, and Rob Van Dam in action, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 12, 2004
videos.overview: Randy Orton extends an open invitation to Mick Foley to witness him defend the Intercontinental Championship against Rob Van Dam in the main event. Shawn Michaels and World Heavyweight Champion Triple H come face-to-face in an interview with Jonathan Coachman. After demanding some in-ring action, Matt Hardy goes one-on-one with Goldberg and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 19, 2004
videos.overview: With Eric Bischoff away, Interim General Manager Jonathan Coachman announces that the Superstars of Raw will compete in a series of matches for a chance to participate in an Over The Top Rope Challenge where the winner will receive the Number 30 Spot in the 2004 Royal Rumble. Plus, Randy Orton, Mick Foley, "Stone Cold" Steve Austin, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 26, 2004
videos.overview: Shawn Michaels and World Heavyweight Champion Triple H are left stunned when Sheriff "Stone Cold" Steve Austin introduces a new player to their rivalry. Mick Foley confronts Randy Orton. Plus, Chris Jericho's overplays his position, Raw General Manager Eric Bischoff punishes Jonathan Coachman, and much more action.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 02, 2004
videos.overview: Before facing Shawn Michaels in the main event, Intercontinental Champion Randy Orton looks to take out Mick Foley. When Chris Jericho welcomes Chris Benoit to The Highlight Reel, Y2J finds himself teaming with Christian to challenge Batista & Ric Flair for the World Tag Team Championships. Plus, Goldberg and more.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 09, 2004
videos.overview: As World Heavyweight Champion Triple H prepares to sign the contract for his title defense at WrestleMania XX, an old friend shows up to break some hearts. With "Stone Cold" Steve Austin offering Goldberg a chance to get even with Brock Lesnar at No Way Out, SmackDown General Manager Paul Heyman comes to Monday Night Raw with a word of warning.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 16, 2004
videos.overview: While Shawn Michaels looks to settle some unfinished business in the main event, Sheriff Stone Cold Steve Austin and General Manager Eric Bischoff try to decide who will challenge Triple H for the World Heavyweight Championship at WrestleMania XX. Intercontinental Champion Randy Orton looks end his rivalry with Mick Foley and more.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 23, 2004
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon makes some groundbreaking announcements for WrestleMania XX including naming "Stone Cold" Steve Austin the special referee for the match between Brock Lesnar and Goldberg. But first, the Rattlesnake must prove his officiating capabilities when The Chairman takes on Eric Bischoff in the main event. Plus, Batista and more in action.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 01, 2004
videos.overview: Triple H looks to eliminate the two threats to his World Heavyweight Championship by having them face off with Batista and Intercontinental Champion Randy Orton in tag team action. But while Evolution tries to maintain their dominance, Mick Foley looks to rock their world by enlisting the help of an old friend. Plus, Rob Van Dam and more in action.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 08, 2004
videos.overview: Triple H delivers a message to both challengers for his World Heavyweight Championship. Following their unforgettable reunion, The Rock 'n' Sock Connection returns to Raw for a face-to-face confrontation with Evolution. Plus, Kane is confronted by his fate, an 8-Man Tag Team Match, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 15, 2004
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon makes a special announcement. In retaliation for losing the World Heavyweight Championship, Triple H goes on a quest for vengeance by having Batista, Ric Flair & Randy Orton battle two enemies of Evolution in a Handicap Match. Plus, Rob Van Dam and Booker T defend the World Tag Team Championship against The Dudley Boyz and more.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 22, 2004
videos.overview: The landscape of WWE is drastically altered when SmackDown General Manager Paul Heyman and Raw General Manager Eric Bischoff randomly select Superstar additions to their prospective brands in the first ever WWE Draft Lottery. Mr. McMahon has Eddie Guerrero defend the WWE Championship. Plus, Evolution, Chris Jericho, and many more in action.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 29, 2004
videos.overview: Triple H receives a challenge from one of Raw's newest additions, Shelton Benjamin. In an effort to discover the reasons behind her controversial actions at WrestleMania, Chris Jericho confronts Trish Stratus on an all new edition of The Highlight Reel. Plus, Tajiri battles Kane, Mick Foley issues a special challenge to Randy Orton, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 05, 2004
videos.overview: When Shelton Benjamin challenges Triple H to a rematch from the previous edition of Monday Night RAW in effort to prove that his victory wasn't a fluke, Evolution responds by stacking the odds in The Game's favor. The Women of WWE compete in a Battle Royal to determine the No. 1 Contender for the Women's Championship. Plus, Kane and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr 12, 2004
videos.overview: Shelton Benjamin and others take on Evolution in the main event. Plus, Lita joins The Highlight Reel, Edge confronts Johnny Nitro, and more!

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 19, 2004
videos.overview: Shawn Michaels seizes an opportunity to put him back in the hunt for the World Heavyweight Championship. Edge picks a fight with Randy Orton that leads him into a Tag Team main event against Evolution's Ric Flair & Batista. Kane makes a statement to Lita. Plus, Victoria defends the Women's Championship against Molly Holly and more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 26, 2004
videos.overview: Triple H goes one-on-one with Tajiri. Shelton Benjamin takes exception to Randy Orton disrespecting another legend. Before Matt Hardy can battle Kane in retaliation for his recent assault, the Big Red Monster takes matters in his own hands. Plus, Evolution's Ric Flair & Batista go after the World Tag Team Championship and more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 03, 2004
videos.overview: Triple H, Batista & Randy Orton take on Shelton Benjamin, Tajiri & Edge in a Six-Man Tag Team Match. During an all new Highlight Reel, things take a dire turn for Matt Hardy after Kane reveals that he has stolen something precious to him. Plus, Shawn Michaels goes after the World Heavyweight Championship in the main event, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 10, 2004
videos.overview: Chris Jericho faces Christian in a Steel Cage Match. When Shawn Michaels makes his presence felt during Triple H's match with Shelton Benjamin, Raw General Manager Eric Bischoff decides to punish The Heartbreak Kid. While Matt Hardy prepares for action, Kane informs Lita that time is running out. Plus, Tajiri takes on Batista and much more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 17, 2004
videos.overview: Batista & Randy Orton look to bring home the gold to Evolution by going after the World Tag Team Championship. Weeks of being tormented by Kane come to a head when Lita is faced with an ultimatum. Eugene has his world rocked by the return of a new friend. All this and much more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 24, 2004
videos.overview: Shawn Michaels' ongoing rivalry with Triple H rages on as Raw General Manager Eric Bischoff reinstates The Heartbreak Kid. When things break down on The Highlight Reel, Chris Jericho finds himself teaming with Shelton Benjamin to take on Evolution's Batista & Intercontinental Champion Randy Orton. Plus, Edge faces Ric Flair and much more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 31, 2004
videos.overview: Triple H sends a message to Shawn Michaels. After The Coach lures Eugene into an attack by Kane, RAW General Manager Eric Bischoff decides to make an example out of his nephew by having him go one-on-one the Big Red Machine. Plus, Shelton Benjamin takes on Randy Orton, Matt Hardy battles Garrison Cade, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 07, 2004
videos.overview: Triple H orders Evolution to divide and conquer their enemies as Batista faces Shelton Benjamin in singles action before Intercontinental Champion Randy Orton goes one-on-one with The Heartbreak Kid in the main event. Eugene tries to prove himself when he takes on Eric Bischoff's apprentice, Johnny Nitro. Plus, Lita battles Gail Kim, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 14, 2004
videos.overview: Shawn Michaels and Triple H come face-to-face once again as Jim Ross tries to get both men to put their rivalry to rest. On a new edition of The Highlight Reel, Eugene is given a chance to meet his hero. Lita's life is forever changed after receiving some troubling news. Plus, Evolution's Ric Flair, Batista, and Randy Orton and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 21, 2004
videos.overview: Eugene receives the opportunity of lifetime when he competes in the main event against his hero, Triple H. The future clashes with the past when The Rock and Intercontinental Champion Randy Orton come face-to-face. Matt Hardy's joy over Lita's pregnancy turns to grief after Kane makes a shocking revelation. Edge & Chris Jericho face Evolution.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 28, 2004
videos.overview: After taking exception to Triple H dubiously making Eugene an honorary member of Evolution, William Regal finds himself taking on The Game in singles action with a very special guest referee. Before Kane goes after the World Heavyweight Championship in the main event, Jim Ross conducts a one-on-one interview with the Big Red Monster.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 05, 2004
videos.overview: When Eugene takes control of Raw, Triple H seizes the opportunity to manipulate the new Interim-General Manager into stacking the odds in Evolution's favor. Randy Orton defends his Intercontinental Championship against Chris Jericho. Molly Holly faces Victoria and Nidia to determine the No. 1 Contender for the Women's Championship.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 12, 2004
videos.overview: Eugene is given a chance to ascend to the top of WWE when Raw General Manager Eric Bischoff unexpectedly grants him an opportunity at the World Heavyweight Championship. After the sordid affair between Kane and Lita explodes on The Highlight Reel, Chris Jericho finds himself going one-on-one with the Big Red Monster. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 19, 2004
videos.overview: Following Evolution's despicable assault on Eugene, William Regal confronts Triple H and Raw General Manager Eric Bischoff. Randy Orton looks to reclaim some gold when he challenges Edge for the Intercontinental Championship. A battle between Kane and Chris Jericho proves too big for a ring to hold. Plus, the Raw Divas Search continues and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 26, 2004
videos.overview: Triple H looks to reclaim the World Heavyweight Championship in an Iron Man Match in the main event. While The Game prepares to go the distance for gold, the rest of Evolution competes against the Superstars of Raw in an Over The Top Rope Battle Royal to determine a No. 1 Contender to face the champion at SummerSlam. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 02, 2004
videos.overview: After failing to recapture the World Heavyweight Championship thanks to Eugene, Triple H calls out his special "friend" for some payback. However, it is William Regal who ends up feeling the wrath of The Game. Tensions between Chris Jericho and Intercontinental Champion Edge boil over when Y2J invites his rival to join him on The Highlight Reel.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 09, 2004
videos.overview: Following Triple H's vicious assault on William Regal, Eugene calls out The Game for a face-to-face confrontation. In an attempt to get even with Kane, Matt Hardy puts his relationship with Lita at stake by entering a dangerous contract with the Big Red Monster. Plus, Evolution competes in a Handicap Match main event and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 16, 2004
videos.overview: On a night where Randy Orton defends his newly won World Heavyweight Championship in a main event rematch from SummerSlam, Evolution plans an unforgettable celebration to commemorate his history-making reign. Less than a week before her wedding to Kane, Lita lets the WWE Universe know where she stands. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 23, 2004
videos.overview: The bells of unholy matrimony toll throughout the WWE Universe as Lita begrudgingly prepares to marry Kane in one of the most bizarre and unusual wedding ceremonies in WWE. After excommunicating World Heavyweight Champion Randy Orton from Evolution, Triple H explains his motivations for turning on his former friend. Plus Edge and more in action.

videos.title: Raw - Aug 30, 2004
videos.overview: Triple H faces Eugene in a No DQ Match main event. Plus, Randy Orton sends a message to Evolution, Kane gives Lita a wedding gift, and more!

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 06, 2004
videos.overview: Things take an unexpected turn when Kane battles World Heavyweight Champion Randy Orton in the main event. After Raw General Manager Eric Bischoff strips the recently-injured Edge of the Intercontinental Championship, Christian and Chris Jericho get an opportunity to climb for the gold at Unforgiven. Plus, Triple H faces Eugene inside a steel cage.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 13, 2004
videos.overview: After crashing Triple H's celebration for becoming the new World Heavyweight Champion, Randy Orton is forced to take on Evolution in a 3-On-1 Handicap Match. The sordid marriage between Kane and Lita comes to an unexpected turning point when Gene Snitsky debuts against the Big Red Monster. Plus, the 2004 Raw Divas Search continues and more!

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 20, 2004
videos.overview: Evolution competes in a Six-Man Tag Team Match. After weeks of competition, the 2004 Raw Divas Search comes down to two finalists. Mr. McMahon returns to deliver some taboo news to Raw General Manager Eric Bischoff. Plus, Chris Jericho defends the Intercontinental Championship against Shawn Michaels, The Hurricane battles Tajiri, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 27, 2004
videos.overview: Randy Orton's hopes of regaining the World Heavyweight Championship from Triple H at Taboo Tuesday are put in jeopardy when he is ordered to face Batista in a No Disqualification Match. Shawn Michaels and Intercontinental Champion Chris Jericho take on Christian & Tyson Tomko. Gene Snitsky refuses to take responsibility for his actions and more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 04, 2004
videos.overview: A dispute between World Heavyweight Champion Triple H and Intercontinental Champion Chris Jericho leads to both men colliding in a Lumberjack Match. Kane takes exception when Gene Snitsky reveals a shallow depth of character. Eric Bischoff again humiliates Eugene. Plus, The Hurricane and Rosey go after the World Tag Team Championships and more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 11, 2004
videos.overview: With the WWE Universe being given the opportunity to decide who will face Triple H for the World Heavyweight Championship at Taboo Tuesday, The Game's three potential opponents team up for main event action when they take on Evolution in a Six-Man Tag Team Match. Kane goes on a rampage after hearing some disparaging comments from Gene Snitsky.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 18, 2004
videos.overview: While awaiting the WWE Universe's decision on who will face Triple H for the World Heavyweight Championship at Taboo Tuesday, the three potential challengers meet in a Triple Threat Match. Eric Bischoff orders Eugene to face Gene Snitsky. Plus, Randy Orton & Intercontinental Champion Chris Jericho take on Evolution's Batista & Ric Flair, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 25, 2004
videos.overview: When Eric Bischoff takes the night off, Evolution tries to seize control of Raw, but face defiance from Raw's Superstars. Randy Orton receives an offer he can’t refuse to go one-on-one with Ric Flair in the main event for a shot the World Heavyweight Championship at Survivor Series. Plus, Edge explains his actions from Taboo Tuesday and more.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 01, 2004
videos.overview: Evolution demands that order be restored to Raw. However, resistance from General Manager Eric Bischoff leads World Heavyweight Champion Triple H to abandon his allies before they take to the ring for a Six-Man Tag Team Match. Plus, Intercontinental Champion Shelton Benjamin faces Viscera, Eugene battles Gene Snitsky in a Hardcore Match, and more

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 08, 2004
videos.overview: With control of RAW to be decided between Team Orton and Team Triple H at Survivor Series, Batista looks to make a statement on behalf of The Game when he goes one-on-one with Randy Orton. Chris Jericho invites Lita and Women's Champion Trish Stratus to the Highlight Reel. Plus, Edge in action, Shelton Benjamin takes on Tyson Tomko, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 15, 2004
videos.overview: Following Team Orton's victory at Survivor Series, Maven takes control of this Raw by making several unique matches, including giving himself a chance at Triple H's World Heavyweight Championship. However, The Game makes him an offer of a lifetime. Plus, Jonathan Coachman faces Randy Orton, Lita takes on Molly Holly, and much more action.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 22, 2004
videos.overview: With another member of Team Orton given control of Raw, Triple H's reign as World Heavyweight Champion is put in jeopardy when he is forced to put the title on the line in a Steel Cage Match. Plus, Trish Stratus defends the Women's Championship against Lita and Molly Holly in a Triple Threat Match, Jonathan Coachman faces Rhyno and more.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 29, 2004
videos.overview: As Randy Orton assumes the role of Raw General Manager, Triple H is faced with another threat to his reign as World Heavyweight Champion when a Battle Royal is held to see who will challenge The Game for the gold in the main event. Plus, Lita & Victoria take on Molly Holly & Trish Stratus, Eugene & William Regal in action, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 06, 2004
videos.overview: History is made when Trish Stratus defends the Women's Championship against Lita in the main event. After a controversial finish to last week's World Heavyweight Championship Match, Mr. McMahon gives some devastating news to Triple H on the Highlight Reel. Plus, Shelton Benjamin defends the Intercontinental Championship against Christian and more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 13, 2004
videos.overview: With the fate of the vacant World Heavyweight Championship in his hands, Eric Bischoff announces that a new champion will be crowned at New Year's Revolution when a sinister structure returns to WWE. While continuing to torment the women of WWE, Snitsky receives some hellish news from Women's Champion Lita. Plus, Randy Orton faces Edge and more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 20, 2004
videos.overview: Join Jerry "The King" Lawler and Jonathan Coachman as they look back on Raw's best matches and moments from 2004. From Randy Orton being excommunicated from Evolution to Lita and Trish Stratus' main event battle for the Women's Championship, all the action from throughout the year is featured.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 27, 2004
videos.overview: Several Raw Superstars including Chris Jericho, Triple H, Shelton Benjamin, and more try to earn the best spot in the upcoming Elimination Chamber Match for the World Heavyweight Championship by competing in a series of Beat The Clock Matches. However, General Manager Eric Bischoff throws a curve ball at the challengers' championship aspirations.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 03, 2005
videos.overview: Before they battle for the World Heavyweight Championship inside the Elimination Chamber at New Year's Revolution, the six competitors find themselves in singles action including Triple H taking on Randy Orton in the main event. Plus, Intercontinental Champion Shelton Benjamin battles Sylvain Grenier, Victoria faces Trish Stratus, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 10, 2005
videos.overview: Randy Orton tries to cause a rift between Batista and new World Heavyweight Champion Triple H before going one-on-one with The Animal in the main event to determine the No. 1 Contender for The Game's title. Shawn Michaels gives Edge some unexpected advice. Plus, several Superstars look to qualify for the Royal Rumble Match and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 17, 2005
videos.overview: While Triple H prepares to defend his World Heavyweight Championship against Randy Orton at the Royal Rumble, Batista's own championship aspirations cause some concern for The Game. Snitsky learns that Hell hath no fury like a Big Red Monster. Plus, Shawn Michaels faces Christian, Six-Man Tag Team action, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 24, 2005
videos.overview: With an opportunity for Triple H's World Heavyweight Championship approaching, Randy Orton prepares for The Game by going one-on-one with Ric Flair. Batista continues to pursue his championship goals when he battles La Resistance in a Handicap Match to qualify for the 2005 Royal Rumble. Plus, Evolution crashes a celebration for Jim Ross and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 31, 2005
videos.overview: Batista finds himself standing at a fork in his road to WrestleMania after The Animal is enticed to go to SmackDown to chase the WWE Championship. Kane and Snitsky's rivalry takes them inside a steel cage. Shawn Michaels & Randy Orton take on Evolution's Ric Flair and World Heavyweight Champion Triple H in the main event. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 07, 2005
videos.overview: For the first time, Raw emanates from Japan. Triple H defends his World Heavyweight Championship against Edge. Ric Flair goes one-on-one with Shawn Michaels. While deciding who he will face on The Grandest Stage of Them All, Batista takes to the ring to battle Maven. Plus, Randy Orton faces Tyson Tomko, a special fashion show, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 14, 2005
videos.overview: While preparing to go one-on-one with Edge, Batista's attention turns to SmackDown's WWE Champion John "Bradshaw" Layfield who's impending arrival on Raw sends The Animal hunting. Candice Michelle joins the Highlight Reel. Plus, Shelton Benjamin defends the Intercontinental Championship against Gene Snitsky, Randy Orton faces Christian, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 21, 2005
videos.overview: As the General Managers from both Raw and SmackDown await Batista's decision on which champion he will face for the gold at WrestleMania, The Animal makes a shocking revelation. Shelton Benjamin defends his Intercontinental Championship against Snitsky. Plus, Trish Stratus defends the Women's Championship against Victoria and Molly Holly and more.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 28, 2005
videos.overview: Batista clears addresses why he left Evolution for a pursuit of gold at WrestleMania. In a main event Street Fight, Shawn Michaels goes one-on-one with Edge. Plus, Chris Jericho takes on Maven, Gene Snitsky challenges Shelton Benjamin for the Intercontinental Championship, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 07, 2005
videos.overview: With his upcoming battle against Triple H for the World Heavyweight Championship at WrestleMania approaching, Batista sets his sights on another former ally from Evolution when he goes one-on-one with Ric Flair. Shawn Michaels sends a message to SmackDown's Kurt Angle. Randy Orton challenges The Undertaker to a WrestleMania match.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 14, 2005
videos.overview: Randy Orton is the guest on a new edition of Chris Jericho's Highlight Reel. With eyes set on his upcoming World Heavyweight Championship Match against Triple H, Batista takes on Gene Snitsky. Plus, Shawn Michaels teams with an old friend to take on Sylvain Grenier & Rob Conway, Kane battles both Christian and Tyson Tomko, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 21, 2005
videos.overview: Batista goes one-on-one with Kane in a Lumberjack Match main event. In an incredible Tag Team Match, Chris Jericho partners with Intercontinental Champion Shelton Benjamin to take on the duo of Christian & Tyson Tomko. Plus, Randy Orton's arrogance puts him further into the grave, Shawn Michaels battles Rob Conway, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Mar 28, 2005
videos.overview: Before they meet WrestleMania, World Champion Triple H and Batista come face-to-face. Plus, Shawn Michaels, Randy Orton, and more!

videos.title: Raw - Apr 04, 2005
videos.overview: Following WrestleMania, World Heavyweight Champion Batista faces Randy Orton in the main event. Plus, Shawn Michaels, Triple H, and more!

videos.title: Raw - Apr 11, 2005
videos.overview: Batista gives his first interview as World Heavyweight Champion. HBK looks for help from an unexpected source. Plus, Triple H and more!

videos.title: Raw - Apr 18, 2005
videos.overview: GM Eric Bischoff gives Jim Ross an advantage when he faces Triple H in a No DQ main event. Plus, Shawn Michaels, Trish Stratus, and more!

videos.title: Raw - Apr 25, 2005
videos.overview: Triple H stacks the odds against World Champion Batista when he faces Christian in the main event. Plus, Trish Stratus, Y2J, and many more!

videos.title: Raw - May. 02, 2005
videos.overview: Batista is given the night off from action while eight Superstars including Shelton Benjamin, Edge, Chris Jericho, and more compete in the first Gold Rush Tournament to determine a new No. 1 Contender for The Animal's title. Plus, The Hurricane & Rosey defend the World Tag Team Championships against La Resistance and more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 09, 2005
videos.overview: The Semi-Finals of the Gold Rush Tournament see Shawn Michaels take on Edge. Despite Christian's best efforts to turn the tables on Ric Flair, "The Nature Boy" shows everyone that he still has it what it takes. Rob Conway and Sylvain Grenier try to prove who is the better member of La Resistance. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 16, 2005
videos.overview: The Final Round of the Gold Rush Tournament to determine the No. 1 Contender for the World Heavyweight Championship sees Edge face Kane. While looking for someone to blame for Triple H's absence, Ric Flair finds some comfort in an old friend. Plus, Randy Orton addresses his status in the upcoming WWE Draft and more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 23, 2005
videos.overview: While Eric Bischoff holds a funeral service for ECW, Mr. McMahon shakes things up by putting Bischoff face-to-face with his longtime rival Paul Heyman. Edge challenges Batista for the World Heavyweight Championship. Plus, Ric Flair shows the WWE Universe the meaning of loyalty, Kane is left scarred by Lita's recent betrayal, and more.

videos.title: Raw - May 30, 2005
videos.overview: Eric Bischoff introduces a new team member in his fight against ECW.

videos.title: Raw - Jun 06, 2005
videos.overview: The Raw brand gets a boost when it welcomes its newest addition to the roster. Plus, Triple H, Batista, Edge, and many more.

videos.title: Raw - Jun 13, 2005
videos.overview: Triple H looks to protect his shot at the World Heavyweight Title from the next pick in the WWE Draft. Plus, John Cena, Batista, and more!

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 20, 2005
videos.overview: When things break down in a match between Kurt Angle and World Heavyweight Champion Batista, The Animal teams with Shawn Michaels to face Triple H and Raw's newest acquisition. John Cena defends the WWE Championship against Muhammad Hassan. Edge and Lita receive an uninvited guest to their wedding. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 27, 2005
videos.overview: Kurt Angle's pursuit of Batista and the World Heavyweight Championship is halted after a confrontation with Ric Flair. Shawn Michaels chooses John Cena and a mystery partner to help him face Chris Jericho, Christian, & Tyson Tomko in a Six-Man Tag Team main event. The newest addition to the Raw brand makes his arrival on Carlito's Cabana.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 04, 2005
videos.overview: Shawn Michaels teams with Hulk Hogan to take on Carlito and Kurt Angle in the main event. However, The Heartbreak Kid seizes this opportunity to make The Immortal One face the music. Plus, Edge & Snitsky battle Kane & Big Show, WWE Champion John Cena has a face-to-face confrontation with Chris Jericho on The Highlight Reel, and much more action.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 11, 2005
videos.overview: Shawn Michaels make a huge announcement on Piper's Pit. Raw General Manager Eric Bischoff feels the wrath of John Cena after ordering him to defend the WWE Championship against Chris Jericho at SummerSlam. Plus, a new Kurt Angle Invitational, Shelton Benjamin challenges Carlito for the Intercontinental Championship, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 18, 2005
videos.overview: Hulk Hogan answers Shawn Michaels' challenge for a match at SummerSlam. Eric Bischoff forces WWE Champion John Cena to battle Snitsky in a Lumberjack Match. Edge looks to put an end to his rivalry with Kane when he battles the Big Red Monster in a Steel Cage Match. Carlito defends the Intercontinental Championship against Shelton Benjamin and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 25, 2005
videos.overview: Chris Jericho serves as special guest referee when WWE Champion John Cena faces Intercontinental Champion Carlito. With his match with Hulk Hogan at SummerSlam set, Shawn Michaels informs the WWE Universe that the "old HBK" is back. While trying to put Kane down in a Stretcher Match, Edge is confronted by the return of another rival and more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 01, 2005
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon welcomes Matt Hardy back to Raw to address his personal rivalry with Edge and Lita. Chris Jericho serves as special guest referee when John Cena defends the WWE Championship against Intercontinental Champion Carlito. Plus, Shawn Michaels shows his opinion of Hulk Hogan in a hilarious parody, Tatanka in action and more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 08, 2005
videos.overview: Shawn Michaels and Hulk Hogan meet to discuss and answer questions about their upcoming battle. In attempt to punish someone for John Cena retaining the WWE Championship, Eric Bischoff joins The Highlight Reel to announcer that Referee Chad Patton will go one-on-one with Chris Jericho. Matt Hardy returns to action to face Snitsky and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 15, 2005
videos.overview: Hulk Hogan prepares for his upcoming showdown with Shawn Michaels by going one-on-one with Kurt Angle. WWE Champion John Cena is forced to take on Chris Jericho and Intercontinental Champion Carlito in a Handicap Match. Just days before he faces Matt Hardy, Edge takes to the ring to battle Val Venis. Plus, Big Show in action and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 22, 2005
videos.overview: Chris Jericho and John Cena find themselves fighting for more than gold after Raw General Manager Eric Bischoff orders them to face each other in the first ever "You're Fired" Match. Despite losing to Hulk Hogan, Shawn Michaels addresses his defeat. Plus, Kurt Angle takes on Shelton Benjamin, Ric Flair joins Carlito's Cabana, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 29, 2005
videos.overview: Ric Flair & Shawn Michaels take on Chris Masters & Carlito. Despite their battle at SummerSlam, the rivalry between Edge and Matt Hardy is far from over as they face each other in a Street Fight. WWE Champion John Cena calls out Kurt Angle for a face-to-face confrontation. All this and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 05, 2005
videos.overview: Kurt Angle makes his presence felt in a big way when WWE Champion John Cena goes one-on-one with Tyson Tomko. Lance Cade & Trevor Murdoch make their debut against World Tag Team Champions The Hurricane & Rosey. 2005 Raw Divas Search winner Ashley joins The Highlight Reel. Shawn Michaels steps up to Chris Masters' Masterlock Challenge and more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 12, 2005
videos.overview: WWE Champion John Cena competes in a Handicap Match against Kurt Angle & Tyson Tomko. Edge sends a message to Matt Hardy. Ric Flair goes one-on-one with Chris Masters. The team of Lance Cade & Trevor Murdoch continue to impress when they take to the ring against Eugene & Tajiri. Plus, Shelton Benjamin, Trish Stratus, and many more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 19, 2005
videos.overview: When RAW General Manager Eric Bischoff tries to unfairly award the WWE Championship to Kurt Angle in the aftermath of Unforgiven, Mr. McMahon returns to set things right. The Olympic Gold Medalist then partners with Chris Masters, Edge & Snitsky in an Eight-Man Tag Team Match against John Cena, Big Show, Shawn Michaels & Matt Hardy.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 26, 2005
videos.overview: The Superstars of RAW bid farewell to Spike TV with action including Shawn Michaels and WWE Champion John Cena taking on Carlito & Chris Masters in a Tables Match. Edge sends a message to Matt Hardy. Plus, Trish Stratus defends the Women's Championship against Victoria, Big Show battles Snitsky in a Street Fight, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 03, 2005
videos.overview: On a very special Raw Homecoming to USA, Triple H makes his own return to action when he and Ric Flair take on Carlito & Chris Masters. Eric Bischoff competes in a No Disqualification Match against WWE Champion John Cena. Plus, Kurt Angle and Shawn Michaels compete in a 30-Minute Iron Man Match and more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 10, 2005
videos.overview: After being stunned by Stone Cold Steve Austin on Raw's Homecoming to USA, the McMahon family looks for retribution. Triple H explains why he turned on Ric Flair. Shawn Michaels, Big Show, and WWE Champion John Cena unite to take on Carlito, Kurt Angle & Edge. Plus, Trish Stratus defends the Women's Championship against Victoria and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 17, 2005
videos.overview: With Jim Ross being unceremoniously fired by Linda McMahon, the CEO of WWE joins Carlito's Cabana to explain her actions. When Jonathan Coachman is given Good Ol' J.R.'s place as lead announcer, "Stone Cold" Steve Austin returns to fight for his friend's job. All this and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 24, 2005
videos.overview: Shawn Michaels battles Big Show and Kane in a Triple Threat Match. Mick Foley serves as special guest referee when Kurt Angles goes one-on-one with WWE Champion John Cena in a Non-Title Match. Plus, Mr. McMahon tries to further humiliate Jim Ross and his legacy, Ric Flair looks to get his hands on Triple H, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 31, 2005
videos.overview: Shawn Michaels goes one-on-one with WWE Champion John Cena in the main event. Triple H prepares for his upcoming Steel Cage Match with Ric Flair by taking on Viscera. Jonathan Coachman receives some news that could spare him from a rattlesnake's bite. Plus, a Diva Halloween Costume Contest, Eugene takes on Rob Conway, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 07, 2005
videos.overview: With the rivalry between Ric Flair and Triple H to be settled in an upcoming Last Man Standing Match, The Game gets a close look at "The Nature Boy" in action against Rob Conway. Shawn Michaels teams with WWE Champion John Cena to take on Chris Masters & Kurt Angle in the main event. Plus, Shelton Benjamin, Trish Stratus, and more in action.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 14, 2005
videos.overview: In the wake of the sudden and tragic passing of Eddie Guerrero, Superstars from both Raw and SmackDown come together to mourn the loss of Latino Heat and pay tribute to his legacy. From Rey Mysterio going one-on-one with Shawn Michaels to WWE Champion John Cena taking on Randy Orton, the Superstars of WWE pay homage to their fallen brother.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 21, 2005
videos.overview: Before Team SmackDown battles Team RAW at Survivor Series, Superstars from both sides serve as Lumberjacks when Raw's Shawn Michaels goes one-on-one with SmackDown's John "Bradshaw" Layfield. Ric Flair defends the Intercontinental Championship against Trevor Murdoch. Kurt Angle receives some assistance during his match with Shelton Benjamin.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 28, 2005
videos.overview: With his job as General Manager of RAW at stake thanks to Mr. McMahon, Eric Bischoff struggles to accomplish his goal of taking the WWE Championship off of John Cena by forcing him to defend the title against Kurt Angle and Chris Masters in a Triple Threat Submission Match. Shawn Michaels faces Carlito. Plus, Big Show & Kane in action and more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 05, 2005
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon presides over the trial of Eric Bischoff that could put an end to his tyrannical reign as Raw General Manager. Shawn Michaels & Shelton Benjamin take on Kurt Angle & Daivari. Plus, Triple H goes one-on-one with Tajiri, Kane & Big Show defend the World Tag Team Championships in a Fatal 4-Way Tag Team Match, and much more action.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 12, 2005
videos.overview: In the aftermath of Eric Bischoff's termination from WWE, Mr. McMahon assumes the role of Interim-General Manager and announces that Triple H, Shawn Michaels, Shelton Benjamin, and many more compete in a series of matches for a chance to qualify for the upcoming Elimination Chamber Match. Plus, WWE Champion John Cena takes on Daivari and more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 19, 2005
videos.overview: From Bagram Air Force Base in Afghanistan, WWE superstars are once again given the honor of performing for members of the U.S. Armed Forces with the holiday tradition of Tribute to the Troops. Witness WWE Champion John Cena, Triple H, Trish Stratus, and many more give a special thanks to our service men and women.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 26, 2005
videos.overview: Before battling for the WWE Championship in the Elimination Chamber at New Year's Revolution, John Cena, Kurt Angle, and more compete in a series of Beat The Clock Matches. Mr. McMahon looks to ring in the New Year by interviewing potential candidates for the vacant Raw General Manager position and indulges in an unusual Christmas present.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 02, 2006
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon orders Kurt Angle and WWE Champion to battle each other in a First Blood Match. Edge adds fuel to his rivalry with Intercontinental Champion Ric Flair. Triple H sends a message to Big Show. Plus, Gregory Helms' attitude gets him in royal trouble, Shawn Michaels goes one-on-one with Kane, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 09, 2006
videos.overview: The rivalry between Edge and John Cena over the WWE Championship continues to heat up but the relationship between Lita and Edge gets even hotter. Kurt Angle & Shawn Michaels battle Chris Masters & Carlito. Plus, Trish Stratus faces Ashley Massaro, Chavo Guerrero battles Rob Conway in a Royal Rumble Qualifying Match, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan 16, 2006
videos.overview: Ric Flair battles Edge for the WWE Championship in a TLC match. Shawn Michaels' career is at risk as he faces World Champion Kurt Angle.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 23, 2006
videos.overview: The rivalry between John Cena and WWE Champion Edge rages on when both men team with a mystery partner to go head-to-head in a Tag Team Match. With the Royal Rumble approaching, Jonathan Coachman and Jerry "The King" Lawler battle each other for the coveted Number 30 Spot. Plus, Shawn Michaels goes one-on-one with Shelton Benjamin and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 30, 2006
videos.overview: Despite losing the WWE Championship at the Royal Rumble, Edge receives another opportunity to ascend to the top of WWE when he battles John Cena for the gold. After costing Shawn Michaels his chance to main event WrestleMania, Mr. McMahon is faced with a special challenge from The Heartbreak Kid. Plus, Triple H faces Chavo Guerrero and more.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 06, 2006
videos.overview: Eight Superstars including Triple H, Rob Van Dam, Shelton Benjamin, and more compete in a tournament to determine who will compete for the WWE Championship at WrestleMania. Edge & Lita take on Maria and WWE Champion John Cena where the winner will get to choose the special guest referee in their upcoming battle for the WWE Championship and more.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 13, 2006
videos.overview: Mick Foley serves as the special guest referee when John Cena defends the WWE Championship against Edge. The Road to WrestleMania Tournament reaches the semi-finals with Triple H going one-on-one with Big Show and Rob Van Dam taking on Chris Masters. Mr. McMahon tries to humiliate Shawn Michaels. Plus, Shelton Benjamin faces Eugene and more.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 20, 2006
videos.overview: With an opportunity to challenge John Cena for the WWE Championship at stake, Triple H battles Rob Van Dam and Big Show in a Triple Threat Match. Edge looks to make an example of a beloved WWE Hall of Famer before challenging Mick Foley to a match at WrestleMania. Shawn Michaels receives some help when he takes on The Spirit Squad and more.

videos.title: Raw - Feb 27, 2006
videos.overview: Triple H comes face-to-face with WWE Champion John Cena. Mr. McMahon invites Marty Jannetty to join his club. Plus, RVD, Edge, and more!

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 06, 2006
videos.overview: Triple H and WWE Champion John Cena face off in a WrestleMania Rewind Match. The ongoing issues between Shawn Michaels and the McMahon family continue to escalate when The Heartbreak Kid battles Shane McMahon. Shelton Benjamin defends the Intercontinental Championship against Ric Flair, Candice Michelle celebrates a recent accomplishment, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 13, 2006
videos.overview: Before competing against each other in a Six-Man Tag Team main event, Triple H and WWE Champion John Cena come together to sign the contract for their upcoming match at WrestleMania 22. When things get messy in the rivalry between Shawn Michaels and the McMahon family, The Heartbreak Kid finds himself facing The Spirit Squad in a Steel Cage Match.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 20, 2006
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon continues to stack the deck against Shawn Michaels when he and WWE Champion John Cena take on Triple H and Shane McMahon. Lita pleads with Mick Foley to call off the upcoming Hardcore Match against Edge at WrestleMania. Shelton Benjamin defends the Intercontinental Championship against Ric Flair and Rob Van Dam in a Triple Threat Match.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 27, 2006
