videos.overview: After battling each other in an incredible contest, Triple H and Shawn Michaels find themselves in opposite corners once again when WWE Champion John Cena goes one-on-one with Mr. McMahon in the main event. Mick Foley offers an apology to Lita and gives Edge a gift to commemorate their upcoming confrontation at WrestleMania and more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 03, 2006
videos.overview: John Cena finds himself in main event action when he takes on The Game and Edge in a Handicap Match. Despite losing to Shawn Michaels on The Grandest Stage of Them All, Mr. McMahon issues another challenge to The Heartbreak Kid. Plus, Ric Flair receives a savage introduction to a new Superstar, Chavo Guerrero, Shelton Benjamin, and more in action.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 10, 2006
videos.overview: Triple H and WWE Champion John Cena take on Edge in a Handicap Match. Mr. McMahon's search to find Shawn Michaels' tag team partner leads The Chairman to a place he has never been. Kane & Big Show try to reclaim the WWE Tag Team Championships from The Spirit Squad. Plus, Mickie James defends the Women's Championship against Maria and more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 17, 2006
videos.overview: When Mr. McMahon looks for a sign from above, Shawn Michaels shows him the meaning of "seek and you shall find." However, The Heartbreak Kid's actions earn him a match with Umaga. Triple H finds himself competing in a Handicap Match main event against Edge and WWE Champion John Cena. Trish Stratus gives Mickie James a special surprise and more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 24, 2006
videos.overview: Before defending the WWE Title against Triple H and Edge at Backlash, WWE Champion John Cena teams with his upcoming opponents to take on The Spirit Squad in a 5-on-3 Handicap Match. Mr. McMahon gives Shawn Michaels a taste of things to come when The Heartbreak Kid battles Shane McMahon. Plus, Umaga in action and more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 01, 2006
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon gives control of Raw to The Spirit Squad. However, John Cena is given nothing to cheer about, as he is forced to defend the WWE Championship against Kenny in the main event with Triple H serving as the special guest referee. Plus, Edge welcomes Mick Foley to be his guest on an all new Cutting Edge, Umaga in action, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 08, 2006
videos.overview: On a night where Triple H challenges him for the WWE Championship, John Cena is also forced to team with Shawn Michaels against The Spirit Squad in a 5-on-2 Handicap Match. Rob Van Dam defends the Intercontinental Championship against Chris Masters, Shelton Benjamin, and Charlie Haas in a Fatal 4-Way Match. Plus, Mick Foley battles an ECW Original.

videos.title: Raw - May. 15, 2006
videos.overview: Triple H's frustrations with Mr. McMahon reach a new level when The Chairman changes The Game's WWE Championship opportunity against John Cena into an unusual contest involving Shelton Benjamin, Chris Masters, and Intercontinental Champion Rob Van Dam. Mick Foley invites another hardcore icon to a face-to-face confrontation.

videos.title: Raw - May. 22, 2006
videos.overview: In an attempt to humble Triple H for his actions, Mr. McMahon forces The Game to apologize before using him as his instrument of destruction when Shawn Michaels takes on all five members of The Spirit Squad. After Mick Foley's change in attitude leads him to present his honorary Hardcore Championship to Edge, another extreme legend takes exception.

videos.title: Raw - May. 29, 2006
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon capitalizes on Triple H's problems with The Spirit Squad by forcing The Game to face Kenny in the first Spiritjack Match. Old friends make bitter enemies when Mick Foley and Paul Heyman come together for a face-to-face confrontation between ECW and WWE. Edge battles Big Show for an opportunity at the WWE Championship and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 05, 2006
videos.overview: The war between ECW and WWE rages on, as WWE Champion John Cena and Rob Van Dam to sign the contract for their upcoming battle for the WWE Championship at One Night Stand. After being drafted to ECW by Paul Heyman, Kurt Angle gets into a heated confrontation with WWE's Mick Foley. Triple H goes one-on-one with Big Show and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 12, 2006
videos.overview: With the WWE Championship in the hands of Rob Van Dam, Paul Heyman promises to bring the gold to the premiere of ECW and welcomes Edge to join them as the new No. 1 Contender. However, The Rated-R Superstar will have to first go through former champion John Cena. Mr. McMahon forces Triple H to battle The Spirit Squad in a Gauntlet Match.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 19, 2006
videos.overview: After being reunited under the D-Generation X banner once again, Shawn Michaels and Triple H lure The McMahons out of the arena to get some overdue retribution on The Spirit Squad. John Cena faces ECW Original Balls Mahoney. Plus, Kane speaks out about being stalked by a version of his former self, Randy Orton takes on Snitsky, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 26, 2006
videos.overview: John Cena looks to bring the WWE Championship back to WWE when he challenges Rob Van Dam for the gold. Things get a little messy for The McMahons after D-Generation X imitates them. Kane's struggles with his former self rage on during his battle with Randy Orton. Mickie James defends the Women's Championship against Trish Stratus and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 03, 2006
videos.overview: ECW's Rob Van Dam defends the WWE Championship against Edge and John Cena in a Triple Threat Match. The McMahon family's humiliation at the hand of D-Generation X continues when Triple H and Shawn Michaels invade the production truck. Johnny Nitro defends the Intercontinental Championship against Carlito and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 10, 2006
videos.overview: In an effort to punish DX's biggest fan, Mr. McMahon and Shane team up to make an example out of Eugene in a Handicap Match. After his match against Shelton Benjamin is disrupted by Edge, John Cena pays the Rated-R Superstar a special visit. Amidst Ric Flair's rivalry with Mick Foley, "The Nature Boy" finds himself faced with a giant challenge.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 17, 2006
videos.overview: The rivalry between The McMahons and DX continues, as Shawn Michaels takes on Shane McMahon. While Mick Foley continues to deny Ric Flair's challenge for a rematch, "The Nature Boy" finds himself at odds with another friend of the Hardcore Legend. Torrie Wilson & Trish Stratus team up against Victoria and Women's Champion Mickie James and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 24, 2006
videos.overview: John Cena & Ric Flair take on WWE Champion Edge & Intercontinental Champion Johnny Nitro. With Triple H away at the hospital preparing for the birth of his child, Mr. McMahon seizes an opportunity to dismantle Shawn Michaels. Hulk Hogan shows up to give Randy Orton a lesson in respect. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 31, 2006
videos.overview: After being humiliated by the father of his new grandchild, Mr. McMahon orchestrates another plot to get even with DX when Shawn Michaels faces Umaga. WWE Champion Edge provides commentary as John Cena battles Matt Striker. Johnny Nitro defends the Intercontinental Championship against Carlito and Shelton Benjamin in a Triple Threat Match.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 07, 2006
videos.overview: The McMahons continue to get the upper hand on DX when it's Triple H's turn to face Umaga in the main event. Lita and WWE Champion Edge take on Carlito & Trish Stratus in a Mixed Tag Team Match. Shelton Benjamin goes one-on-one with Kane to determine the No. 1 Contender for the Intercontinental Championship. Plus, John Cena in action and more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 14, 2006
videos.overview: The McMahons send a message to Triple H and Shawn Michaels. Before he goes one-on-one with Carlito in the main event, WWE Champion Edge takes his rivalry with John Cena to a personal level when he reveals a visit to Cena's hometown. Randy Orton learns that there is nothing like the real thing after making a mockery of Hulk Hogan.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 21, 2006
videos.overview: While their humiliation at the hands D-Generation X continues, following their loss to Shawn Michaels and Triple H at SummerSlam, The McMahons look to perform their own brand of degradation on another WWE Superstar by having Mick Foley join Mr. McMahon's Kiss My Ass Club. Edge quickly finds himself the victim of an unexpected twist of fate.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 28, 2006
videos.overview: When D-Generation X's pranks cause Mr. McMahon to take the night off, Shane McMahon looks to punish Shawn Michaels & Triple H by placing them in a Handicap Match. John Cena issues a challenge to Edge for his WWE Championship that the Rated-R Superstar can't refuse. Plus, Lita defends the Women's Championship against Mickie James and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 04, 2006
videos.overview: With the blood of Shawn Michaels and Triple H on their hands following their recent assault on DX, The McMahons and Big Show are sent running in fear when The Game and The Heartbreak Kid look for retribution. John Cena teams with Carlito & Trish Stratus to take on Randy Orton, Women's Champion Lita & WWE Champion Edge. Plus, Jeff Hardy and more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 11, 2006
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon and his allies look to soften up Shawn Michaels and Triple H when The Chairman goes one-on-one with The Game in a No Holds Barred main event. John Cena partners with Jeff Hardy & Carlito to take on Randy Orton, Intercontinental Champion Johnny Nitro & WWE Champion Edge. Plus, Ric Flair battles Umaga, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 18, 2006
videos.overview: John Cena partners with DX to take on Edge, Trevor Murdoch & Lance Cade. Johnny Nitro defends the Intercontinental Championship in a Six-Pack Challenge against Jeff Hardy, Randy Orton, Carlito, Super Crazy, and Chris Masters. In a rematch from their battle at Unforgiven, Umaga goes one-on-one with Kane. All this and much more action.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 25, 2006
videos.overview: DX find themselves in the fight of their lives, as Triple H and Shawn Michaels team up for a Gauntlet Match. With one arm tied behind his back, WWE Champion John Cena faces Lita in a No Holds Barred Match. Kane challenges Johnny Nitro for the Intercontinental Championship. Plus, the tournament to crown a new Women's Champion begins and more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 02, 2006
videos.overview: Edge battles John Cena in a steel cage for the WWE Championship. After competing in a Texas Tornado Match, D-Generation X turns their attention gets even with Jonathan Coachman. Sgt. Slaughter returns to teach Nicky of The Spirit Squad some respect. Plus, Jeff Hardy challenges Johnny Nitro for the Intercontinental Championship and more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 09, 2006
videos.overview: Superstars from SmackDown and ECW join Raw for an evening of unforgettable action in a WWE family reunion. The Undertaker represents SmackDown in the main event against Raw Superstar and WWE Champion John Cena. Plus, D-Generation X battles Lance Cade & Trevor Murdoch in a Street Fight, Umaga faces Kane in a Loser Leaves Raw Match, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 16, 2006
videos.overview: Triple H faces Randy Orton. Mr. McMahon gathers ECW Champion Big Show and World Heavyweight Champion Booker T together with WWE Champion John Cena for some news regarding Cyber Sunday. Jeff Hardy defends the Intercontinental Championship against Super Crazy, Shelton Benjamin, and Chris Masters in a Fatal 4-Way Match. All this and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 23, 2006
videos.overview: While preparing to face ECW Champion Big Show and World Heavyweight Champion Booker T at Cyber Sunday, WWE Champion John Cena turns his attention to Johnny Nitro, as Nitro battles Cena on behalf of his celebrity friend, Kevin Federline. Randy Orton faces Triple H. Plus, the tournament to crown a new Women's Champion continues, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 30, 2006
videos.overview: With Cyber Sunday less than a week away, Mr. McMahon allows the WWE Universe a chance to choose John Cena's opponent between ECW Champion Big Show, World Heavyweight Champion Booker T, and Jonathan Coachman. Edge referees a bout between Triple H and Randy Orton. Plus, Eugene & "Hacksaw" Jim Duggan take on Umaga, Johnny Nitro in action, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 06, 2006
videos.overview: Eric Bischoff takes control of this edition of Raw by placing several Superstars in some precarious positions while seizing various opportunities to assist his allies. From serving as referee when Rated-RKO challenges Ric Flair & "Rowdy" Roddy Piper for the World Tag Team Championship to forcing Maria to face Umaga, Bischoff shows his tyranny.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 13, 2006
videos.overview: In an attempt to prevent D-Generation X from interfering when Rated-RKO challenges Ric Flair and "Rowdy" Roddy Piper for the World Tag Team Championship in the main event, Jonathan Coachman puts a bounty on the heads of Shawn Michaels and Triple H. Plus, WWE Champion John Cena battles Umaga, Women's Champion Lita faces Mickie James, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 20, 2006
videos.overview: Johnny Nitro defends the Intercontinental Title vs. Jeff Hardy in a Ladder Match. Plus, an Eight-Man Tag Team main event, Umaga, and more!

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 27, 2006
videos.overview: Umaga issues a challenge to John Cena for the WWE Championship. Before Rated-RKO take on the recently reunited Hardy Boyz, Edge & Randy Orton call out D-Generation X by appealing to Triple H and Shawn Michaels' better nature. Plus, Jerry Lawler goes one-on-one with Chris Masters, a WWE Divas Battle Royal, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 04, 2006
videos.overview: DX teams with The Hardy Boyz to take on Rated-RKO & MNM in an Eight-Man Tag Team Match. Despite a recent challenge from Umaga, John Cena puts the WWE Championship on the line in Chris Masters' Masterlock Challenge. Eugene is featured on the Kiss Cam. Plus, Shelton Benjamin faces Super Crazy, Cryme Tyme visits a retirement community, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 11, 2006
videos.overview: After making his presence felt in WWE Champion John Cena's match with Armando Alejandro Estrada, Johnny Nitro finds himself going one-on-one with Cena. The problems between DX and Rated-RKO escalate when a contest between Triple H and Edge leads to a Six-Man Tag Team Match. Plus, Umaga takes on Intercontinental Champion Jeff Hardy and more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 18, 2006
videos.overview: Thirty Superstars compete in a Battle Royal where the winner will challenge John Cena for the WWE Championship later in the evening. In a Handicap Tag Team Match, Johnny Nitro partners with The World's Greatest Tag Team to take on The Hardy Boyz. Plus, Ric Flair goes one-on-one with Kenny Dykstra and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 25, 2006
videos.overview: From Camp Victory in Baghdad, WWE superstars continue the Christmas tradition of performing for members of the U.S. Armed Forces with another presentation of Tribute to the Troops. On this memorable holiday celebration, WWE Champion John Cena, Edge, The Undertaker, Randy Orton, and many more superstars are in action!

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 01, 2007
videos.overview: WWE Champion John Cena looks to put his rivalry with Kevin Federline to an end when they meet in one-on-one action. However, K-Fed's first bout in WWE is riddled with controversy after he enlists the help of some special friends. Plus, Rob Conway makes an ill-fated promise, Cryme Tyme in action, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 08, 2007
videos.overview: John Cena goes one-on-one with The Great Khali in the main event. With Triple H going down with an injury in DX's battle with Rated-RKO, Edge & Randy Orton promise to finish off Shawn Michaels next. Plus, Jeff Hardy defends the Intercontinental Championship against Kenny Dykstra, two celebrities come to Raw to face-off against each other, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 15, 2007
videos.overview: Rated-RKO battles Shawn Michaels in a Handicap Match main event. Before they meet for the WWE Championship at the Royal Rumble, John Cena and Umaga come face-to-face in a contract signing for their upcoming bout. Plus, Mickie James defends the Women's Championship against Victoria, Ric Flair battles Kenny Dykstra, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 22, 2007
videos.overview: Shawn Michaels' personal rivalry with Edge leads The Heartbreak Kid into a main event Street Fight against The Rated-R Superstar. After mocking Mr. McMahon's unique obsession, WWE Champion John Cena learns the hard way why you never cross the boss. In a Raw vs. SmackDown Challenge, MNM member Joey Mercury faces Intercontinental Champion Jeff Hardy.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 29, 2007
videos.overview: Shawn Michaels partners with WWE Champion John Cena to challenge Rated-RKO for the World Tag Team Championships. Mr. McMahon's attempts to please the WWE Universe with a special Fan Appreciation Night are trumped by an unexpected guest. Plus, Jeff Hardy defends the Intercontinental Championship against The Great Khali and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 05, 2007
videos.overview: After The Undertaker chooses to face Batista for the World Heavyweight Championship at WrestleMania 23, John Cena is faced with three potential contenders for his WWE Championship, as Shawn Michaels battles Edge and Randy Orton in a Triple Threat Match main event to determine who will challenge Cena for the gold on The Grandest Stage of Them All.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 12, 2007
videos.overview: Things get more than a little hairy when Donald Trump challenges Mr. McMahon to a confrontation at WrestleMania 23. WWE Champion John Cena partners with Shawn Michaels, The Undertaker, and World Heavyweight Champion Batista to take on MVP, Mr. Kennedy, and Rated-RKO. Plus, Umaga makes a statement at the expense of two WWE legends and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 19, 2007
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon introduces his representative in the upcoming Battle of the Billionaires against Donald Trump and gives him a golden opportunity to challenge Jeff Hardy for the Intercontinental Title. Edge battles Rob Van Dam to qualify for the Money in the Bank Ladder Match. Randy Orton takes on WWE Champion John Cena. All this and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 26, 2007
videos.overview: Rated-RKO challenges Shawn Michaels and WWE Champion John Cena for the World Tag Team Championship. Jeff Hardy and Shelton Benjamin battle to qualify for the Money in the Bank Ladder Match. Donald Trump reveals his representative to face Umaga at WrestleMania's Battle of the Billionaires. All this and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 05, 2007
videos.overview: While trying to find out who the Special Guest Referee is for the Battle of the Billionaires at WrestleMania 23, Mr. McMahon receives some news that drives him stone cold crazy. In the first ever Falls Count Anywhere Match for the Women's Championship, Melina defends the gold against Mickie James. All this and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 12, 2007
videos.overview: Shawn Michaels and WWE Champion John Cena defend their World Tag Team Championship in a Gauntlet Match. The upcoming Battle of the Billionaires is made official when Donald Trump and Mr. McMahon sign the contract for their confrontation on The Grandest Stage of Them All. Plus, Randy Orton, Women's Champion Melina, and many more in action.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 19, 2007
videos.overview: As Shawn Michaels travels down the road to WrestleMania, The Heartbreak Kid looks to silence his critics when SmackDown's John "Bradshaw" Layfield makes an appearance. Intercontinental Champion Umaga battles Eugene. Plus, WWE Champion John Cena takes to the ring for main event action, Randy Orton goes one-on-one with Jeff Hardy, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 26, 2007
videos.overview: Shawn Michaels and WWE Champion John Cena take on The Undertaker and World Heavyweight Champion Batista. As his 'Battle of the Billionaires' confrontation approaches, Mr. McMahon steps into the ring for a No Disqualification Match against Donald Trump's representative, Bobby Lashley. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 02, 2007
videos.overview: John Cena & Shawn Michaels defend the World Tag Team Championship in a Tag Team Battle Royal. With Mr. McMahon literally losing his hair after his Battle of the Billionaires confrontation with Donald Trump, The Chairman looks for payback by having ECW Champion Bobby Lashley take on Armando Estrada and Intercontinental Champion Umaga.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 09, 2007
videos.overview: In an effort to regain respect for his family name after Mr. McMahon had his head shaved at WrestleMania, Shane McMahon puts his own hair on the line when he challenges Bobby Lashley for the ECW Championship. With a opportunity to challenge John Cena for the WWE Championship at Backlash at stake, Randy Orton goes one-on-one with Shawn Michaels.

videos.title: Raw - Apr 16, 2007
videos.overview: In the first episode of Raw to air from Italy, a member of the WWE Universe named Santino Marella accepts Umaga's Open Challenge.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 23, 2007
videos.overview: Shawn Michaels and WWE Champion John Cena relive their unforgettable battle for the WWE Title at WrestleMania 23 when they step into the ring once again to go head-to-head. With recent humiliations weighing on his mind, Shane McMahon decides to make an example out of a fan. Plus, Melina defends the Women's Championship against Maria and more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 30, 2007
videos.overview: After Shawn Michaels, Edge, and Randy Orton are each mysteriously assaulted by an unknown assailant, WWE Champion John Cena is in for a huge surprise when he demands a face-to-face confrontation with the Superstar responsible. Mr. McMahon celebrates his new reign as ECW Champion by sending Umaga to dismantle Rob Van Dam and much more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 07, 2007
videos.overview: Shawn Michaels goes one-on-one with The Great Khali for a chance at the WWE Championship at Judgment Day. Meanwhile, WWE Champion John Cena takes on Randy Orton. Plus, Mr. McMahon agrees to give Bobby Lashley an opportunity at the ECW Championship, Mr. Kennedy defends his Money in the Bank Contract against Edge, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 14, 2007
videos.overview: With Edge using his Money in the Bank Contract to capture the World Heavyweight Championship from The Undertaker, The Rated-R Superstar bids farewell to Raw by going one-on-one with Shawn Michaels. John Cena looks to retrieve his stolen WWE Championship from The Great Khali. Bobby Lashley battles Jonathan Coachman. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 21, 2007
videos.overview: Despite his victory over The Great Khali at Judgment Day, WWE Champion John Cena's problems with the Punjabi Nightmare are far from over. Before he can challenge Mr. McMahon for the ECW Championship at One Night Stand, Bobby Lashley must first run the Gauntlet against several opponents. Plus, Ric Flair takes on Carlito and much more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 28, 2007
videos.overview: After making a special announcement, Shane McMahon stacks the deck against his rivals by teaming with The Great Khali & Umaga to take on Bobby Lashley and WWE Champion John Cena in a Handicap Match. Randy Orton faces Rob Van Dam. Plus, a Memorial Day Bikini Beach Blast Battle Royal, Ric Flair & Torrie Wilson battle Carlito & Victoria, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 04, 2007
videos.overview: Following his loss of the ECW Championship at One Night Stand, Mr. McMahon combats his feelings of impending doom by taking out his frustrations on the Raw locker room. John Cena defends the WWE Championship in a Triple Threat Match against The Great Khali and Umaga. Torrie Wilson faces Carlito. Plus, Randy Orton battles Ric Flair and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 11, 2007
videos.overview: On a night where the Superstars of SmackDown and ECW come to Raw for the first ever Tri-brand Draft, the evening also plays host to the ill-fated Mr. McMahon Appreciation Night. Superstars from all three brands battle in a series of matches to decide their fates. The celebration for The Chairman of WWE backfires and literally goes up in smoke.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 18, 2007
videos.overview: While the WWE Universe buzzes over the investigation into Mr. McMahon's alleged death in a mysterious limo explosion, Stephanie McMahon vows to exact vengeance on whoever is responsible. Randy Orton teams with King Booker to take on Bobby Lashley and WWE Champion John Cena. Plus, Mick Foley goes one-on-one with Umaga and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 25, 2007
videos.overview: A three-hour look at the life and career of WWE wrestler (and former champion) Chris Benoit.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 02, 2007
videos.overview: Several RAW Superstars compete in Beat the Clock Matches for an opportunity to challenge John Cena for the WWE Championship at The Great American Bash. When Dusty Rhodes introduces his son Cody around the locker room, Randy Orton shows The American Dream some disrespect. Plus, Santino Marella faces Umaga, Carlito battles The Sandman, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 09, 2007
videos.overview: When WWE Hall of Famer Dusty Rhodes comes to Monday Night RAW to demand some respect from Randy Orton after his recent actions, The American Dream finds himself faced with a challenge from The Legend Killer. Mr. Kennedy partners with King Booker to take on Bobby Lashley & Jeff Hardy in a Tag Team Match. Plus, Paul London, Umaga, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 16, 2007
videos.overview: Tensions rise between Bobby Lashley and WWE Champion John Cena when both men come face-to-face in a heated in-ring debate. Randy Orton looks to make a statement at the expense of Cody Rhodes. Jeff Hardy, Shelton Benjamin, and Santino Marella battle in a Triple Threat Match to determine the Number One Contender for the Intercontinental Championship.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 23, 2007
videos.overview: In an attempt to get the better of John Cena, Jonathan Coachman orders the WWE Champion to team with Women's Champion Candice Michelle to take on Intercontinental Champion Umaga and World Tag Team Champions Lance Cade & Trevor Murdoch in a No Disqualification Champions Only main event. Cody Rhodes demands to go one-on-one with Randy Orton and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 30, 2007
videos.overview: While WWE Champion John Cena looks to teach Carlito a lesson in the main event, the new No. 1 Contender for the WWE Championship, Randy Orton, goes one-on-one with Sgt. Slaughter. Before Triple H makes his return at SummerSlam, King Booker sends a message to the so-called King of Kings in a match against Jerry "The King" Lawler. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 06, 2007
videos.overview: On a night where Mr. McMahon explains his recent actions before announcing a Battle Royal to determine a new General Manager of Raw, The Chairman receives some news that could change his family forever. WWE Champion John Cena is forced to battle Intercontinental Champion Umaga. King Booker faces Jerry "The King" Lawler. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 13, 2007
videos.overview: After gathering the entire WWE roster together to address his recent paternity suit, Mr. McMahon soon discovers that the identity of his illegitimate child is closer than ever. WWE Champion John Cena teams with Intercontinental Champion Umaga to take on Carlito & Randy Orton. King Booker receives word that he will soon be playing a whole new game.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 20, 2007
videos.overview: WWE Champion John Cena goes one-on-one with Snitsky. Mr. Kennedy faces off with Carlito to determine the No. 1 Contender for the Intercontinental Championship. King Booker summons Triple H to crown him in front of the WWE Universe. Plus, Maria and Ron Simmons go on a date, Cody Rhodes battles Shelton Benjamin, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 27, 2007
videos.overview: Randy Orton is given an opportunity to prove that he deserves another chance at the WWE Championship title by making his presence felt in the main event when Cena defends the gold against King Booker. Mr. McMahon finds himself subject to more humiliation after Triple H interrupts his guest appearance on Carlito's Cabana. All this and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 03, 2007
videos.overview: After using John Cena's father to gain another shot at WWE Championship, Randy Orton avoids the wrath of the WWE Champion by joining this edition of Raw via satellite. While speculation over the identity of his illegitimate son runs rampant, Mr. McMahon embraces a new strategy in dealing with his family. All this and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 10, 2007
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon's search to discover the identity of his illegitimate child comes up short. Randy Orton's despicable attempts to secure a WWE Championship opportunity finally catch up with him. Intercontinental Champion Jeff Hardy is forced to face SmackDown's World Heavyweight Champion The Great Khali. Plus, Triple H battles Shelton Benjamin and more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 17, 2007
videos.overview: On a night where John Cena's father tries to protect his son from being stripped of the WWE Championship by agreeing to face Randy Orton in the main event, Mr. McMahon shows the WWE Universe what kind of father he makes when he tries to put Hornswoggle up for adoption. Shelton Benjamin challenges Jeff Hardy for the Intercontinental Championship.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 24, 2007
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon teams with Carlito to take on Triple H in a Steel Cage Match. John Cena is forced to surrender the WWE Championship to Raw General Manager Jonathan Coachman. Hornswoggle gets to see another side of Melina. Plus, Intercontinental Champion Jeff Hardy & Women's Champion Candice Michelle to take on Shelton Benjamin & Beth Phoenix and more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 01, 2007
videos.overview: Cena takes goes one-on-one with Mr. Kennedy for the first time. With Carlito serving as special guest referee, Mr. McMahon faces off with his son-in-law, Triple H. Plus, Santino Marella proves that everybody is a critic, Hornswoggle continues to torment Melina, a Six-Man Tag Team Match, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 08, 2007
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon orders every Raw Superstar shake the hand of new WWE Champion Randy Orton. However, Orton's WWE Championship reign could come to an abrupt end when Triple H invokes his rematch clause for the gold. Mr. Kennedy puts the Intercontinental Championship on the line against Jeff Hardy. Plus, a live interview with John Cena and more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 15, 2007
videos.overview: With Randy Orton set to defend the WWE Championship against either Mr. Kennedy, Jeff Hardy, or Shawn Michaels at Cyber Sunday, Raw General Manager William Regal orders the Orton to face all three of his potential opponents in a series of matches. Mr. McMahon has Umaga give Triple H a demonstration of things to come. Plus, Santino Marella and more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 22, 2007
videos.overview: WWE Champion Randy Orton & Mr. Kennedy take on Shawn Michaels & Intercontinental Champion Jeff Hardy in a tag team main event. Before Umaga can make an example out of Hornswoggle, Triple H looks to get a piece of The Samoan Bulldozer. Plus, Beth Phoenix defends the Women's Championship, Cody Rhodes goes one-on-one with Shelton Benjamin, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 29, 2007
videos.overview: Umaga & WWE Champion Randy Orton take on Triple H in a Handicap Match. Mr. McMahon encourages Hornswoggle to make his family proud by having him go one-on-one with Jonathan Coachman. Despite coming up short due to a technicality at Cyber Sunday, Shawn Michaels looks for another chance at gold. Plus, the Finals of the 2007 Divas Search and more.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 05, 2007
videos.overview: Shawn Michaels & Triple H take on Umaga and WWE Champion Randy Orton. Weeks of insulting "Stone Cold" Steve Austin's acting ability leave Santino Marella stunned by the arrival of The Rattlesnake. Rey Mysterio & Intercontinental Champion Jeff Hardy battle Mr. Kennedy & Finlay. All this and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 12, 2007
videos.overview: Triple H takes on Umaga in a Lumberjack Match. After The Undertaker and World Heavyweight Champion Batista bring their rivalry from SmackDown to Raw, The Deadman and The Animal face Lance Cade & Trevor Murdoch. When WWE Champion Randy Orton and Shawn Michaels go face-to-face before their match at Survivor Series. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 19, 2007
videos.overview: After successfully retaining the WWE Championship at Survivor Series, Randy Orton is confronted by a new challenger for his gold. An exchange of words between Shawn Michaels and Mr. Kennedy leads General Manager William Regal to order them to meet in one-on-one action. Plus, Santino Marella receives some royal treatment and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 26, 2007
videos.overview: When Ric Flair returns to WWE with a major announcement, Mr. McMahon forces "The Nature Boy" to put his career on the line in the main event against WWE Champion Randy Orton. After coming to Jeff Hardy's aid last week, Triple H finds himself teaming with the Intercontinental Champion to take on Umaga & Snitsky. Plus, Chris Jericho and more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 03, 2007
videos.overview: With Randy Orton and Chris Jericho set to battle for the WWE Championship at Armageddon, General Manager William Regal gives both men the right to choose each other's opponents tonight. Jeff Hardy defends the Intercontinental Championship against Snitsky. Mr. Kennedy tries to break Shawn Michaels' heart by offering him a blast from the past.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 10, 2007
videos.overview: Superstars from the past and the present celebrate the 15th Anniversary of Monday Night Raw. Jeff Hardy defends the Intercontinental Championship against Carlito in a Ladder Match. Mr. Kennedy faces Marty Jannetty. WWE Champion Randy Orton and an old friend battle his former Evolution allies. Plus, a 15-Man Battle Royal and more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 17, 2007
videos.overview: Shawn Michaels & Intercontinental Champion Jeff Hardy face Mr. Kennedy & WWE Champion Randy Orton. The career of Ric Flair is put in jeopardy once again when "The Nature Boy" battles Umaga. Plus, Triple H faces Jonathan Coachman & General Manager William Regal in a Handicap Match, Chris Jericho receives a message from a wealthy Superstar, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 24, 2007
videos.overview: On a very special Tribute to the Troops, the Superstars of RAW journey to Iraq to perform for members of the U.S. Military. From WWE Champion Randy Orton going one-on-one with Chris Jericho, to D-Generation X taking on the team of Umaga & Mr. Kennedy, WWE offers the men and women of our armed forces some holiday wishes and a little taste of home.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 31, 2007
videos.overview: With career of his friend and mentor Ric Flair on the line, Triple H finds himself in a difficult situation when he battles "The Nature Boy" for a spot in the upcoming Royal Rumble Match. WWE Champion Randy Orton gets personal with Jeff Hardy. John "Bradshaw" Layfield comes to the RAW brand for a face-to-face confrontation with Chris Jericho.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 07, 2008
videos.overview: The fate of every Raw Superstar is in the hands of lady luck, as Mr. McMahon reintroduces Raw Roulette. From Triple H battling General Manager William Regal, to a Steel Cage Match main event between Umaga and Intercontinental Champion Jeff Hardy, the WWE Universe is treated to a night of some unique and unforgettable contests.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 14, 2008
videos.overview: Jeff Hardy defends the Intercontinental Championship against Randy Orton. While Shawn Michaels competes to qualify for a spot in the upcoming Royal Rumble, Triple H’s frustrations over not being in the match lead Mr. McMahon to make a difficult decision. Plus, Ric Flair fights for his career once again and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 21, 2008
videos.overview: Intercontinental Champion Jeff Hardy and WWE Champion Randy Orton come face-to-face when Mr. McMahon orders both men to shake hands. Before he can qualify for the Royal Rumble Match, Triple H must compete in a Gauntlet Match. Plus, Shawn Michaels and Mr. Kennedy clash, Chris Jericho sends a message to John “Bradshaw” Layfield, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 28, 2008
videos.overview: John Cena sends a message to WWE Champion Randy Orton. Orton teams with John “Bradshaw” Layfield to take on Chris Jericho & Intercontinental Champion Jeff Hardy. Shawn Michaels & Triple H unite under the D-Generation X banner to battle Umaga & Snitsky. Plus, Mr. Kennedy, Women’s Champion Beth Phoenix, and many more in action.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 04, 2008
videos.overview: On a night where John Cena and WWE Champion Randy Orton sign the contract for their upcoming battle at No Way Out, Cena must prove his strength by taking on Mark Henry in an Arm Wrestling Match. Shawn Michaels partners with Chris Jericho & Intercontinental Champion Jeff Hardy to battle John “Bradshaw” Layfield, Umaga & Snitsky and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 11, 2008
videos.overview: Shawn Michaels goes one-on-one with Intercontinental Champion Jeff Hardy. In retribution for his recent actions, Hornswoggle is forced compete in a No Disqualification Match against his father Mr. McMahon. WWE Champion Randy Orton takes a front row seat to witness John Cena in action against Mark Henry. Ric Flair gives Mr. Kennedy a history lesson.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 18, 2008
videos.overview: Triple H serves as the special guest referee as John Cena faces WWE Champion Randy Orton. Shawn Michaels announces the newest inductee into the WWE Hall of Fame. A steel cage takes the place of the woodshed when Mr. McMahon looks to teach Hornswoggle a lesson in discipline. Plus, Superstars compete in Money in the Bank Qualifying Matches and more.

videos.title: Raw - Feb 25, 2008
videos.overview: Triple H and John Cena take on Mr. Kennedy and WWE Champion Randy Orton in the main event. Ric Flair makes a heartbreaking challenge.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 03, 2008
videos.overview: While Triple H and WWE Champion Randy Orton prepare to battle each other in the main event, the other opponent in their Triple Threat Match at WrestleMania, John Cena, takes on Mr. Kennedy. Shawn Michaels & Ric Flair face Trevor Murdoch & Lance Cade. An appearance by Jeff Hardy on The Highlight Reel leads to a twist of fate for Chris Jericho.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 10, 2008
videos.overview: The Superstars of WWE relive anew some of their classic battles from previous WrestleManias. From The Undertaker battling Mark Henry in a Casket Match, to Shawn Michaels and John Cena recreating their classic bout, these WrestleMania Rewind Matches are must see. Plus, Big Show and Floyd “Money” Mayweather weigh-in for their upcoming match.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 17, 2008
videos.overview: John Cena and WWE Champion Randy Orton find themselves as unlikely partners when they compete in 17-On-2 Handicap Elimination Match. Mr. McMahon looks to end Ric Flair’s career himself by battling “The Nature Boy” in a Street Fight. Chris Jericho defends the Intercontinental Championship against Big Show. Plus, CM Punk faces Carlito and more.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 24, 2008
videos.overview: John Cena, Ric Flair, Shawn Michaels & Triple H take on John “Bradshaw” Layfield, Umaga & Big Show in an Eight-Man Tag Team main event. CM Punk & Chris Jericho face MVP & Carlito. When things break down in a match between Maria and Melina, Raw General Manager William Regal makes a special Six-Person Intergender Tag Team Match. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 31, 2008
videos.overview: After retaining the WWE Championship at WrestleMania, Randy Orton finds himself faced with new challengers to his title before he goes one-on-one with Matt Hardy. The WWE Universe bids an emotional farewell to “The Nature Boy.” CM Punk takes on Chris Jericho. Plus, Big Show comes face-to-face with another giant, Cryme Tyme in action, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 07, 2008
videos.overview: With Raw General Manager William Regal ordering Randy Orton to defend the WWE Championship against John “Bradshaw” Layfield at Backlash, Triple H and John Cena look to find their place in the upcoming battle for the gold. Chris Jericho invites Batista and Shawn Michaels to be his guests on The Highlight Reel. Plus, Umaga faces Val Venis and more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 14, 2008
videos.overview: Triple H faces John "Bradshaw" Layfield in the main event. William Regal takes on WWE Champion Randy Orton. After taunting Shawn Michaels, Chris Jericho defends the Intercontinental Championship against Umaga. Plus, Mickie James challenges Beth Phoenix for the Women's Championship, "Hacksaw" Jim Duggan in action, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr 21, 2008
videos.overview: All of the main events of Backlash are represented in an Eight-Man Tag Team main event. Superstars compete to become King of the Ring.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 28, 2008
videos.overview: Randy Orton takes advantage of his rematch clause by challenging Triple H for the WWE Championship. After winning the King of the Ring Tournament, Raw General Manager William Regal looks to take his rightful place on the throne of WWE. Chris Jericho makes light of Shawn Michaels’ apparent knee injury on The Highlight Reel and much more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 05, 2008
videos.overview: Raw General Manager and current King of the Ring William Regal orders Mr. Kennedy and WWE Champion Triple H to team up against the entire ECW roster in a Handicap Match. Shawn Michaels & Chris Jericho take on WWE Tag Team Champions The Miz and John Morrison. Plus, “Rowdy” Roddy Piper joins Carlito’s Cabana and much more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 12, 2008
videos.overview: After standing up to Raw General Manager William Regal, John Cena faces Randy Orton. Shawn Michaels proves the extent of his injury to Chris Jericho. Hardcore Holly & Cody Rhodes defend the World Tag Team Championship against Santino Marella & Carlito. Jeff Hardy battles Umaga. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 19, 2008
videos.overview: John Cena & WWE Champion Triple H face Randy Orton & John “Bradshaw” Layfield. Raw General Manager William Regal and Mr. Kennedy battle for their careers in WWE. Batista goes one-on-one with Intercontinental Champion Chris Jericho for an opportunity to face Shawn Michaels in a Stretcher Match at One Night Stand. Plus, Piper’s Pit and more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 26, 2008
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon shows the WWE Universe the appreciation that they deserve with a million dollar announcement. Randy Orton and WWE Champion Triple H come face-to-face. Shawn Michaels competes against Intercontinental Champion Chris Jericho. Plus, John Cena & Jeff Hardy team up to take on Umaga & John “Bradshaw” Layfield and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 02, 2008
videos.overview: John Cena and Jeff Hardy battle to determine the new No. 1 Contender for the WWE Championship. Mr. McMahon gives some unique insight into the first ever Million Dollar Mania contest. Chris Jericho defends the Intercontinental Championship against John “Bradshaw” Layfield. Plus, Beth Phoenix in action, Mr. Kennedy faces Umaga, and more

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 09, 2008
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon’s Million Dollar Mania officially kicks off. While WWE Champion Triple H prepares to battle Jeff Hardy in the main event, the No. 1 Contender for his title John Cena goes one-on-one with John “Bradshaw” Layfield. Tensions between Shawn Michaels and Intercontinental Champion Chris Jericho explode on The Highlight Reel.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 16, 2008
videos.overview: John Cena battles Umaga in a Street Fight. WWE Champion Triple H clashes with Intercontinental Champion Chris Jericho. Mr. McMahon continues to show the WWE Universe some appreciation with his Million Dollar Mania. Plus, Mr. Kennedy and Women’s Champion Mickie James take on Paul and Katie Lea Burchill in a Mixed Tag Team Match and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 23, 2008
videos.overview: In the annual WWE Draft, Superstars from Raw, SmackDown, and ECW compete against each other in a series of Inter-promotional Matches in the hopes of earning their brand a draft pick. After weeks of giving the WWE Universe what they deserve with his Million Dollar Mania, Mr. McMahon’s benevolence unexpectedly comes crashing down

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 30, 2008
videos.overview: CM Punk uses his Money in the Bank Contract to challenge Edge for the World Heavyweight Championship. After capturing the Intercontinental Championship, Kofi Kingston puts the gold on the line against Chris Jericho. Plus, Shane McMahon addresses Mr. McMahon’s accident, Santino Marella gets on the wrong side of Rey Mysterio, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 07, 2008
videos.overview: SmackDown General Manager Vickie Guerrero comes to Raw to protest CM Punk’s recent capture of the World Heavyweight Championship. John Cena battles John “Bradshaw” Layfield, Kane, and Batista in a Fatal 4-Way main event to determine the new No. 1 Contender for the gold. Plus, Shawn Michaels accepts Chris Jericho’s recent challenge and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 14, 2008
videos.overview: Despite Shane and Stephanie McMahon’s attempts at imploring the Superstars of Raw to maintain order in their father’s absence, chaos ensues when John Cena & Cryme Tyme take on John “Bradshaw” Layfield, Cody Rhodes & Ted DiBiase. Batista makes his presence felt during World Heavyweight Champion CM Punk’s battle with Kane and much more

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 21, 2008
videos.overview: After failing to capture the World Heavyweight Championship at The Great American Bash thanks to Kane, Batista seizes another golden opportunity by challenging CM Punk for the title in the main event. John “Bradshaw” Layfield teams up with Cody Rhodes & Ted DiBiase once again to take on John Cena and Cryme Tyme. Plus, Beth Phoenix and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 28, 2008
videos.overview: Before naming a new General Manager of Monday Night Raw, Shane McMahon orders John Cena and Batista to put aside their recent misunderstandings and take on Kane & John “Bradshaw” Layfield. William Regal goes one-on-one with World Heavyweight Champion CM Punk. Plus, Chris Jericho sends a message to Shawn Michaels and much more action.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 04, 2008
videos.overview: With both Chris Jericho and John “Bradshaw” Layfield looking to challenge CM Punk for the World Heavyweight Championship at SummerSlam, Raw General Manager Mike Adamle gives Y2J and JBL a unique chance to become the No. 1 Contender when they face The Straight Edge Superstar in a Handicap Match. All this and much more

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 11, 2008
videos.overview: Despite recently capturing the World Tag Team Championship, tensions between John Cena and Batista continue to rise when they defend the title against Cody Rhodes & Ted DiBiase. John “Bradshaw” Layfield tries to test World Heavyweight Champion CM Punk’s moral character by offering The Straight Edge Superstar a toast. Plus, Kane and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 18, 2008
videos.overview: World Heavyweight Champion CM Punk takes to the ring for main event action before the eyes of his hometown of Chicago when he goes one-on-one with Chris Jericho. John Cena takes on World Tag Team Champions Cody Rhodes & Ted DiBiase in a Handicap Match. Plus, Raw General Manager Mike Adamle reveals a new match concept for Unforgiven and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 25, 2008
videos.overview: In response to his wife’s recent injury at the hands of Chris Jericho, Shawn Michaels addresses his in-ring status. Batista battles Kane. Kofi Kingston challenges Santino Marella for the Intercontinental Championship. Plus, Raw General Manager Mike Adamle names the injured John Cena’s replacement for the upcoming Championship Scramble and more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 01, 2008
videos.overview: Before defending the World Heavyweight Championship against Batista, John “Bradshaw” Layfield, Rey Mysterio, and Kane in a Championship Scramble at Unforgiven, CM Punk competes in a Battle Royal against all four competitors. Tensions reach a breaking point as Shawn Michaels and Chris Jericho sign the contract for their upcoming Unsanctioned Match.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 08, 2008
videos.overview: After capturing the World Heavyweight Championship at Unforgiven, Chris Jericho partners with John "Bradshaw" Layfield to take on Batista in a Handicap Match. Randy Orton comes face-to-face with a trio of Superstars who have a legacy that mirrors his own. Plus, Raw General Manager Mike Adamle gives CM Punk another golden opportunity and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 15, 2008
videos.overview: CM Punk looks to regain the World Heavyweight Championship when he challenges Chris Jericho for the title in a Steel Cage Match. However, John "Bradshaw" Layfield and Batista each look to find their own golden opportunities. Plus, Manu and Tag Team Champions Ted DiBiase & Cody Rhodes take on Kof Kingston, Jerry "The King" Lawler & Charlie Haas.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 22, 2008
videos.overview: Shawn Michaels & Batista take on John "Bradshaw" Layfield, Lance Cade & World Heavyweight Champion Chris Jericho in a Handicap Match. After being suspended for violating Raw General Manager Mike Adamle's recent decree, CM Punk is saved by an unlikely source and given a chance to take out his frustrations in a match against Cody Rhodes and more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 29, 2008
videos.overview: Before challenging Chris Jericho for the World Heavyweight Championship at No Mercy, Shawn Michaels changes the game by revealing a surprise partner to help him battle Y2J & Lance Cade in a Tag Team Match. CM Punk teams with Rey Mysterio, Evan Bourne & Kofi Kingston to take on Kane, Manu, and World Tag Team Champions Cody Rhodes & Ted DiBiase.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 06, 2008
videos.overview: World Heavyweight Champion Chris Jericho assumes the role of interim Raw General Manager and places Shawn Michaels in a No Disqualification Match against Lance Cade. However, an attack from Batista leads Y2J to act as the special guest referee when The Animal puts his No. 1 Contendership on the line against John "Bradshaw" Layfield.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 13, 2008
videos.overview: With Batista and World Heavyweight Champion Chris Jericho given the opportunity to select each other's opponents, Y2J serves up some heartbreaking news while The Animal looks to push his rival over the edge. Rey Mysterio & ECW Champion Matt Hardy face Kane & Mark Henry. Actor Johnny Knoxville gets on the wrong side of Women's Champion Beth Phoenix.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 20, 2008
videos.overview: Batista and World Heavyweight Champion Chris Jericho compete in a unique Gauntlet Match. Charlie Haas feels the wrath of John "Bradshaw" Layfield. CM Punk teams with Kofi Kingston to take on the duo of The Miz and John Morrison. Plus, "Hacksaw" Jim Duggan takes exception to Intercontinental Champion Santino Marella's antics and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 27, 2008
videos.overview: After losing the World Heavyweight Championship to Batista at Cyber Sunday, Chris Jericho partners with John "Bradshaw" Layfield to take on The Animal & Shawn Michaels. Rey Mysterio goes one-on-one with Evan Bourne. Cody Rhodes & Ted DiBiase defend the World Tag Team Titles against CM Punk & Kofi Kingston. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 03, 2008
videos.overview: WWE celebrates the record-breaking feat of 800 episodes with an evening of unparalleled action and excitement. Shawn Michaels & Triple H reunite under the DX banner to take on The Miz & John Morrison. Batista defends the World Heavyweight Championship against Chris Jericho in a Steel Cage Match. Plus, CM Punk, Randy Orton, and many more in action.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 10, 2008
videos.overview: On a night where new World Heavyweight Champion Chris Jericho takes on Shawn Michaels in a Last Man Standing Match main event, the former champion, Batista, takes his frustrations out on a Superstar with a unique legacy. The duo of Santino Marella and Beth Phoenix are forced to defend both the Intercontinental and Women's Championships.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 17, 2008
videos.overview: After Stephanie McMahon gives the Raw roster a chance to have their questions answered, she orders Randy Orton to face CM Punk in a Lumberjack Match. With his World Heavyweight Championship on the line against John Cena at Survivor Series, Chris Jericho sends a message to the challenger. Rey Mysterio & Shawn Michaels face The Miz & John Morrison.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 24, 2008
videos.overview: The escalating sibling rivalry between Shane and Stephanie McMahon leads to Batista, Randy Orton, and Chris Jericho competing in a Triple Threat Match for the right to challenge Cena for the gold. CM Punk, Kofi Kingston, and more compete in a tournament to name a new No. 1 Contender for the Intercontinental Championship. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 01, 2008
videos.overview: John Cena faces Kane. Shawn Michaels is faced with a difficult business decision after receiving a unique offer from John "Bradshaw" Layfield. Cody Rhodes and Manu take on World Tag Team Champions CM Punk & Kofi Kingston. Plus, the tournament to name a No. 1 Contender for the Intercontinental Championship continues and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 08, 2008
videos.overview: On a special edition of Monday Night RAW, WWE presents the 2008 Slammy Awards. As the year's biggest, baddest, and best moments are celebrated, WWE superstars including John Cena, Edge, Chris Jericho, and many more compete in an unforgettable evening of action and excitement.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 15, 2008
videos.overview: A failed attack on Batista leads to Randy Orton and his allies Cody Rhodes & Manu taking on The Animal and World Heavyweight Champion John Cena in a Handicap Match. After becoming the new No. 1 Contender for the Intercontinental Championship, CM Punk teams with Kofi Kingston to challenge The Miz & John Morrison for the World Tag Team Championship.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 22, 2008
videos.overview: World Heavyweight Champion John Cena gives the WWE Universe a special Christmas present in the form of a surprise partner to help him take on Santino Marella & Beth Phoenix. Several Raw Superstars compete in a series of matches to see who will go on to fight for the World Heavyweight Championship at the Royal Rumble. Plus, Mickie James and more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 29, 2008
videos.overview: A Fatal 4-Way Elimination Match main event to determine the No. 1 Contender for the World Heavyweight Championship at the Royal Rumble. World Heavyweight Champion John Cena partners with Rey Mysterio, Kofi Kingston, and Cryme Tyme to take on Kane, Mike Knox, Dolph Ziggler, and World Tag Team Champions The Miz & John Morrison.

videos.title: January 5, 2009
videos.overview: Randy Orton & Chris Jericho take on John Cena & Shawn Michaels in the main event. Plus, William Regal defends the Intercontinental Championship against CM Punk, World Tag Team Champions The Miz & John Morrison face Kofi Kingston & Rey Mysterio, and much more.

videos.title: January 12, 2009
videos.overview: John "Bradshaw" Layfield orders Shawn Michaels to make WrestleMania come early when he goes one-on-one with World Heavyweight Champion John Cena. With anticipation building over Mr. McMahon's upcoming return, Chris Jericho learns the hard way not to cross the current boss, Stephanie McMahon. Plus, Randy Orton, CM Punk, and more.

videos.title: January 19, 2009
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon's return to Raw is met with a cold reception from Randy Orton. Alongside Shawn Michaels, John "Bradshaw" Layfield and World Heavyweight Champion John Cena sign the contract for their upcoming battle at the Royal Rumble. CM Punk challenges William Regal for the Intercontinental Championship in a No Disqualification Match.

videos.title: January 26, 2009
videos.overview: With his victory in the 2009 Royal Rumble and recent attack on Mr. McMahon putting WWE in an unprecedented dilemma, Randy Orton takes some special precautions to prevent Stephanie McMahon from terminating his employment. Several Superstars compete for a spot in the upcoming Elimination Chamber Match at No Way Out. All this and much more.

videos.title: February 2, 2009
videos.overview: World Heavyweight Champion John Cena battles Y2J in the main event. Shane McMahon accepts Randy Orton's challenge. JBL evaluates HBK.

videos.title: February 9, 2009
videos.overview: With Stephanie McMahon nearly becoming a victim of Randy Orton's unpredictable mean streak, The Undertaker comes to Raw to lay The Viper to rest. After Chris Jericho gets on the wrong side of a WWE Hall of Famer, Y2J partners with Kane & Mike Knox to take on Rey Mysterio, Kofi Kingston & World Heavyweight Champion John Cena. Plus, CM Punk and more.

videos.title: February 16, 2009
videos.overview: Following his capture of the World Heavyweight Championship just hours after losing the WWE Championship at No Way Out, Edge is confronted by John Cena. Shane McMahon challenges Randy Orton to a Non-Sanctioned Fight. Plus, Rey Mysterio in action, Chris Jericho assaults a WWE Hall of Famer, and more.

videos.title: February 23, 2009
videos.overview: With Randy Orton's actions leaving a trail of McMahon family casualties in his wake, WWE Champion Triple H teaches The Viper a lesson. John Cena's quest to reclaim the World Heavyweight Championship from Edge is thwarted by Vickie Guerrero. Shawn Michaels and John "Bradshaw" Layfield clash to see who will challenge The Undertaker at WrestleMania.

videos.title: March 2, 2009
videos.overview: John Cena challenges Edge for the World Heavyweight Championship. In light of WWE Champion Triple H's recent actions, Randy Orton takes legal action against The Game. While looking to lay The Undertaker's WrestleMania Streak to rest, Shawn Michaels sets his sights on conquering another Superstar's undefeated record. All this and much more.

videos.title: March 9, 2009
videos.overview: Despite being scheduled to face Legacy's Cody Rhodes & Ted DiBiase in the main event, WWE Champion Triple H brings his rivalry with Randy Orton right to The Viper's front door. A shocking revelation helps John Cena earn his way into the upcoming World Heavyweight Championship Match at WrestleMania. Plus Chris Jericho, Undertaker, and more.

videos.title: March 16, 2009
videos.overview: Vickie Guerrero serves as the special guest referee in a bout between John Cena and World Heavyweight Champion Edge. There is no escape for Cody Rhodes when he goes one-on-one with WWE Champion Triple H inside a steel cage. Plus, Chris Jericho's recent challenge to Ric Flair is answered, Shawn Michaels and The Undertaker team up and more.

videos.title: March 23, 2009
videos.overview: Randy Orton takes his ongoing rivalry with WWE Champion Triple H to uncomfortable limits. While The Undertaker reminds Shawn Michaels of their previous encounters, The Heartbreak Kid takes to hallowed ground to send a message to The Deadman. Plus, the participants in the Money in the Bank Ladder Match compete in an Eight-Man Tag Team Match.

videos.title: March 30, 2009
videos.overview: Randy Orton finds himself in a dangerous situation when he becomes the guest of honor at a McMahon family reunion. Before battling The Undertaker on The Grandest Stage of Them All, Shawn Michaels looks to lay The Deadman's Undefeated Streak to rest a little early. Plus, Chris Jericho battles another WWE Hall of Famer and much more.

videos.title: April 6, 2009
videos.overview: Randy Orton's rivalry with the McMahon family rages on when The Viper faces Mr. McMahon in the main event. In a special WrestleMania All-Star Tag Team Match, World Heavyweight Champion John Cena partners with Jeff Hardy, Rey Mysterio, Ricky "The Dragon" Steamboat & CM Punk to take on Kane, Big Show, Edge, Chris Jericho & Matt Hardy.

videos.title: April 13, 2009
videos.overview: The landscape of WWE is once again reshaped as Raw hosts the 2009 WWE Draft. While Superstars from Raw, SmackDown, and ECW compete against each other to earn their brand's draft picks, the stakes are raised in a 15-Man Tri-Branded Battle Royal. Batista, Shane McMahon, and WWE Champion Triple H team up to face Legacy in a Handicap Match and more.

videos.title: April 20, 2009
videos.overview: Following the 2009 WWE Draft, Chris Jericho bids farewell to Raw by going one-on-one with World Heavyweight Champion John Cena. WWE Champion Triple H battles Randy Orton in a No Disqualification Match. Batista makes an example out of Raw's newest acquisition, Kane and CM Punk clash in singles action, and much more.

videos.title: April 27, 2009
videos.overview: Batista and Big Show clash in the main event to determine the No. 1 Contender for the WWE Championship. Randy Orton takes on United States Champion MVP. Plus, The Miz looks to make an impact at the expense of John Cena, The Brian Kendrick goes one-on-one with Kofi Kingston, and much more action.

videos.title: May 4, 2009
videos.overview: When Batista and United States Champion MVP come to Shane McMahon's aid during his match against WWE Champion Randy Orton, both men try to earn their way into the main event by taking on Legacy's Cody Rhodes and Ted DiBiase in singles action. Despite being unable to wrestle, John Cena finally responds to The Miz's recent taunts.

videos.title: May 11, 2009
videos.overview: Batista takes on Legacy's Cody Rhodes & Ted DiBiase in a Handicap Match. A confrontation on MVP's VIP Lounge leads to Kofi Kingston teaming with United States Champion MVP to battle Matt Hardy & William Regal. In a special Exhibition Match, The Miz battles John Cena. Plus, Beth Phoenix in action, Carlito faces The Brian Kendrick, and more.

videos.title: May 18, 2009
videos.overview: Randy Orton learns he will defend the WWE Championship against Batista in a Steel Cage Match at Extreme Rules. The Animal finds himself teaming with John Cena to take on The Viper and both members of Legacy a Handicap Match. Plus, Matt Hardy challenges MVP for the United States Championship and much more.

videos.title: May 25, 2009
videos.overview: After being forced to relocate Monday Night RAW's venue due to controversy surrounding the 2009 NBA Playoffs, WWE rebounds from this personal foul with a full-court press on the owner of the Denver Nuggets and a special 10-Man Tag Team Match main event featuring an all-star lineup of WWE's finest.

videos.title: June 1, 2009
videos.overview: Before challenging Randy Orton for the WWE Championship at Extreme Rules, Batista steps inside the unforgiving Steel Cage a little early when he goes one-on-one with a member of Legacy. Fresh off of becoming No. 1 Contender for the United States Championship, Kofi Kingston challenges MVP for the gold. Plus, Matt Hardy in action and more.

videos.title: June 8, 2009
videos.overview: Despite losing the WWE Championship to Batista at Extreme Rules, Randy Orton takes The Animal to the breaking point before challenging him for the gold in the main event. Cody Rhodes & Ted DiBiase continue to prove effective as a team when they take on Unified WWE Tag Team Champions Primo & Carlito.

videos.title: June 15, 2009
videos.overview: With Batista forced to vacate the WWE Championship due to injury, the title is up for grabs in a Fatal 4-Way Match between Triple H, Randy Orton, Big Show, and John Cena. Mr. McMahon makes an announcement that reshapes Raw. CM Punk puts the World Heavyweight Championship on the line in a Triple Threat Match against Edge and Jeff Hardy.

videos.title: June 22, 2009
videos.overview: As the new owner of Monday Night RAW, Donald Trump vows to show the WWE Universe the appreciation that they deserve by making some drastic changes. Triple H challenges Randy Orton for the WWE Championship in a Last Man Standing Match. John Cena goes one-on-one with Big Show. Plus, CM Punk, Chris Jericho and much more.

videos.title: June 29, 2009
videos.overview: With Mr. McMahon buying back Monday Night Raw from Donald Trump, The Chairman shakes things up by introducing the first of many RAW Guest Hosts, Batista. WWE Champion Randy Orton is forced to run the Gauntlet. Several Superstars compete in a tournament to see who will face The Viper for his title at Night of Champions.

videos.title: July 6, 2009
videos.overview: "The Million Dollar Man" Ted DiBiase returns as the evening's Guest Host and gives Legacy a chance to prove themselves in singles action. The Night of Champions Tournament to see who will challenge Randy Orton for the WWE Championship concludes when John Cena goes one-on-one with Triple H. Plus, Jack Swagger joins The VIP Lounge and much more.

videos.title: July 13, 2009
videos.overview: Raw Guest Host Seth Green teams up with John Cena & Triple H to take on Legacy a Six-Man Tag Team Match main event. Chavo Guerrero is forced to battle Hornswoggle with one arm tied behind his back. Primo issues a challenge to Carlito that is answered by The Miz. Plus, MVP faces Jack Swagger, Chris Jericho goes one-on-one with Mark Henry, and more.

videos.title: July 20, 2009
videos.overview: Triple H & John Cena take on WWE Champion Randy Orton and his Legacy in a Handicap Match. In honor of ZZ Top serving as Raw Guest Hosts, Hornswoggle goes one-on-one with Chavo Guerrero in a "Sharp Dressed Man Match." Plus, a Six-Man Tag Team Match, Chris Jericho in action, and much more.

videos.title: July 27, 2009
videos.overview: On the orders of Raw Guest Host Shaquille O'Neal, a series of Beat The Clock Challenges are held to see who will face Randy Orton for the WWE Championship at SummerSlam. However, the basketball legend doesn't stop there, as he serves as the Enforcer for a Tag Team Match main event between Cryme Tyme and Unified WWE Tag Team Champions Jeri-Show.

videos.title: August 3, 2009
videos.overview: After bringing The Miz back to the real world, Raw Guest Host Jeremy Piven concedes to his demands by having him face John Cena in a Lumberjack Match. Triple H takes on Legacy's Cody Rhodes & Ted DiBiase in a Handicap Match. Sibling rivalry leads to Carlito going one-on-one with Primo. Plus, Jack Swagger battles Evan Bourne and much more.

videos.title: August 10, 2009
videos.overview: Big Show goes one-on-one with WWE Champion Randy Orton. Chris Jericho takes on John Cena. Triple H travels to Texas to find fellow D-Generation X member, Shawn Michaels. To secure a job on Raw, Eugene faces The Calgary Kid in a Contract On A Pole Match. Plus, MVP in action, Jack Swagger battles Evan Bourne, and much more.

videos.title: August 17, 2009
videos.overview: John Cena & WWE Champion Randy Orton take on Unified WWE Tag Team Champions Jeri-Show in a Lumberjack Match. Actor Freddie Prinze Jr. finds himself in hot water by serving as Raw Guest Host. Following his trip to Texas to reunite DX, Triple H returns with Shawn Michaels by his side. Plus, MVP in action and much more.

videos.title: August 24, 2009
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon celebrates his birthday with D-Generation X by partnering with Shawn Michaels & Triple H to take on WWE Champion Randy Orton and Legacy. An old rivalry is revisited when Raw Guest Host Floyd "Money" Mayweather makes his presence felt. Unified WWE Tag Team Champions Jeri-Show battle Mark Henry & MVP. All this and much more.

videos.title: August 31, 2009
videos.overview: Raw Guest Host Dusty Rhodes gives his son, Cody, an opportunity to challenge Randy Orton for the WWE Championship with John Cena serving as the special guest referee. While Big Show takes on Mark Henry, Chris Jericho goes one-on-one with MVP. Plus, Kofi Kingston defends the United States Championship in a Fatal 4-Way Match and more.

videos.title: September 7, 2009
videos.overview: TV's Bob Barker shakes things up by serving as the evening's Guest Host. Santino Marella learns the hard way that the best things in life really aren't free. In the main event, DX battles Chris Masters & WWE Champion Randy Orton. Before facing The Viper at Breaking Point, John Cena goes one-on-one with Cody Rhodes. All this and much more.

videos.title: September 14, 2009
videos.overview: When Batista delivers a major announcement regarding the future of his in-ring career, Randy Orton finds himself facing The Animal in a No Holds Barred Match. Shawn Michaels goes one-on-one with Cody Rhodes. Raw Guest Host Trish Stratus teams with MVP & Mark Henry to battle Beth Phoenix and Unified WWE Tag Team Champions Jeri-Show and more.

videos.title: September 21, 2009
videos.overview: Raw Guest Host Cedric The Entertainer makes a Six-Man Tag Team Match main event, where WWE Champion John Cena partners with MVP & Mark Henry to take on Randy Orton and Unified WWE Tag Team Champions Jeri-Show. Representing D- Generation X, Triple H goes one-on-one with Legacy's Cody Rhodes. All this and much more action.

videos.title: September 28, 2009
videos.overview: Raw Guest Host Reverend Al Sharpton joins the VIP Lounge and orders Jeri-Show to defend the Unified WWE Tag Team Championships against Mark Henry & MVP. WWE Champion John Cena competes in a 3-On-1 Gauntlet Match. Before they meet in Hell in a Cell, Cody Rhodes and Ted DiBiase send a message to D-Generation X. Plus, Jack Swagger and more.

videos.title: October 5, 2009
videos.overview: When Unified WWE Tag Team Champions Jeri-Show receive a lesson in team spirit from Raw Guest Host and Pittsburgh Steeler Ben Roethlisberger, Big Show & Chris Jericho find themselves competing in the main event against DX. The Miz challenges Kofi Kingston for the United States Championship. Plus, a Divas Bowl Match and much more.

videos.title: October 12, 2009
videos.overview: Problems within Legacy arise when WWE Champion Randy Orton finds himself partnering with John Cena to take on Cody Rhodes & Ted DiBiase. Also, dissension brews between Unified WWE Tag Team Champions Jeri-Show after Big Show tries to earn a spot on Team Raw at Bragging Rights by going one-on-one with SmackDown's Chris Jericho.

videos.title: October 19, 2009
videos.overview: Snoop Dogg brings his unique style to the WWE Universe as the evening's Guest Host. In what could be his final appearance on Raw, John Cena takes on Triple H. WWE Champion Randy Orton looks for some retribution on Ted DiBiase. Before they meet Team SmackDown at Bragging Rights, Team RAW warms up against another team. All this and much more.

videos.title: October 26, 2009
videos.overview: After turning on Team RAW to ensure an opportunity at The Undertaker's World Heavyweight Championship, Big Show faces Triple H in a Lumberjack Match. After losing the WWE Championship to John Cena, Randy Orton's actions cause him some vehicular damage. Kyle Busch and Joey Logano from the Joe Gibbs Racing Team serve as Guest Hosts.

videos.title: November 2, 2009
videos.overview: Ozzy and Sharon Osbourne serve as Raw Guest Hosts. WWE Champion John Cena finds himself competing in a Triple Threat Match against Big Show and Chris Jericho. A one-on-one battle between Kofi Kingston and Randy Orton turns into a Six-Man Tag Team Match. Plus, Evan Bourne challenges The Miz for the United States Championship and much more.

videos.title: November 9, 2009
videos.overview: Big Show and Chris Jericho take on D-Generation X's Shawn Michaels & Triple H. Chavo Guerrero gets on the wrong side of Raw Guest Host and Boxing Champion Ricky Hatton. Plus, MVP welcomes Kofi Kingston to the VIP Lounge, Randy Orton goes one-on-one with Mark Henry, and much more.

videos.title: November 16, 2009
videos.overview: WWE Champion John Cena partners with World Heavyweight Champion The Undertaker to take on D-Generation X and Unified WWE Tag Team Champions Jeri-Show in a Triple Threat Tag Team Match. RAW Guest Host "Rowdy" Roddy Piper gets more than he bargained for when he challenges Mr. McMahon to face him in a Street Fight. Plus, MVP and more.

videos.title: November 23, 2009
videos.overview: Raw Guest Host Jesse "The Governor" Ventura shakes things up by having Superstars compete in a series of matches to qualify for a Battle Royal to determine a new No. 1 Contender for the WWE Championship. CM Punk goes one-on-one with WWE Champion John Cena. Plus, DX takes on The Hart Dynasty and much more.

videos.title: November 30, 2009
videos.overview: As the rivalry between D-Generation X and Unified WWE Tag Team Champions Jeri-Show rages on, Triple H faces Chris Jericho. With his eyes set on challenging John Cena for the WWE Championship at TLC, Sheamus turns his attention to singles action when he takes on Santino Marella. Plus, Vern Troyer serves as the Guest Host.

videos.title: December 7, 2009
videos.overview: The owner of the Dallas Mavericks and RAW Guest Host Mark Cuban mediates a face-to-face confrontation between Sheamus and WWE Champion John Cena. Chris Jericho takes on Shawn Michaels & Triple H. Plus, Mark Henry challenges The Miz for the United States Championship, Randy Orton goes one-on-one with Kofi Kingston, and much more action.

videos.title: December 14, 2009
videos.overview: Special Guest Host of Raw Dennis Miller celebrates 2009's best Superstars and moments in WWE during "The Slammy Awards." John Cena, Undertaker, CM Punk, and Randy Orton compete in a 4-Superstar tournament to determine the 2009 Superstar of the Year. Plus, D-Generation X defends the Unified Tag Team Championship against Chris Jericho & Big Show.

videos.title: December 21, 2009
videos.overview: To help WWE ring in the holiday season, World Series Champion Johnny Damon serves as Raw Guest Host. While several Superstars turn to Santa Claus to grant their Christmas wishes, Big Show makes a request of his own for Old St. Nick. DX is summoned to court. Plus, WWE Champion Sheamus meets MVP in action, John Cena battles Jack Swagger, and more.

videos.title: December 28, 2009
videos.overview: Timbaland hosts the final Monday Night RAW of 2009, John Cena invokes his rematch clause to challenge Sheamus for the WWE Championship. Despite the WWE Universe's wishes, Mr. McMahon refuses to show any Hart. DX takes on Big Show & Chavo Guerrero. Plus, The Miz defends the United States Championship against Kofi Kingston and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 04, 2010
videos.overview: For the first time in over a decade, WWE Hall of Famer Bret Hart makes his triumphant return to WWE as Raw Guest Host. While the "Hit Man" looks to settle old rivalries, Mr. McMahon shows the WWE Universe that old habits die hard. Sheamus issues an open challenge to see who will face him for the WWE Championship at the Royal Rumble.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 11, 2010
videos.overview: Legendary boxer Mike Tyson returns to WWE to serve as Raw Guest Host and partner with Chris Jericho against Unified WWE Tag Team Champions DX. John Cena, Randy Orton, and Kofi Kingston battle in a Triple Threat Match to see who will challenge Sheamus for the WWE Championship at the Royal Rumble. Plus, Legacy faces Mark Henry & Evan Bourne and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 18, 2010
videos.overview: On a night where Hollywood's Don Johnson and Jon Heder serve as Raw Guest Hosts, the star of Napoleon Dynamite partners with The Miz & Big Show against Hornswoggle and Unified WWE Tag Team Champions D-Generation X in a Six-Man Tag Team Match. The Undertaker comes answers Shawn Michaels' challenge to a rematch at WrestleMania and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 25, 2010
videos.overview: After questioning Mr. McMahon's decision not to bring Bret Hart back to WWE, John Cena finds himself going one-on-one with WWE Champion Sheamus in a Non-Title Match. Legacy battles Unified WWE Tag Team Champions D-Generation X. Raw Guest Host Dule Hill gets a front row seat to see Gail Kim take on Alicia Fox in the Divas Championship Tournament.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 01, 2010
videos.overview: This edition of Raw promises to boldly go where no man has gone before as legendary actor William Shatner serves as Guest Host. Things take an animalistic turn when Bret Hart shows up for a face-to-face confrontation with Mr. McMahon. Several Superstars compete for a chance at qualifying for a spot in the Elimination Chamber.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 08, 2010
videos.overview: John Cena lays the ground work for Bret Hart to get a measure of revenge on Mr. McMahon. In a Triple Threat Elimination Match, DX defends the Unified WWE Tag Team Championships against The Straight Edge Society and ShoMiz. Plus, NASCAR racer Carl Edwards serves Raw Guest Host, WWE Champion Sheamus faces ECW Champion Christian, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 15, 2010
videos.overview: Bret Hart's frustrations with Mr. McMahon refusal to face him at WrestleMania force him to bid farewell to the WWE Universe. John Cena turns faces Triple H in the main event. Randy Orton's problems with Legacy escalate during his match against WWE Champion Sheamus. Plus, Jerry Springer serves as Raw Guest Host, ShoMiz in action, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 22, 2010
videos.overview: After a shady deal between Mr. McMahon and new WWE Champion Batista comes to light, John Cena is given a chance to challenge The Animal for his title at WrestleMania if he can first defeat him in the main event. Shawn Michaels' continued pursuit for a rematch with The Undertaker leads The Deadman to accept his challenge on an unexpected condition.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 01, 2010
videos.overview: Comedic legends Cheech and Chong serve as Raw Guest Hosts. While Shawn Michaels challenges anyone to doubt his ability to end The Undertaker's storied undefeated streak at WrestleMania, Triple H looks to reunite DX to challenge ShoMiz for the WWE Tag Team Championships. Mr. McMahon invites an injured Bret Hart to a face-to-face confrontation.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 08, 2010
videos.overview: On a night where renowned illusionist Criss Angel serves as Raw Guest Host, Mr. McMahon pulls off an illusion of his own in a main event match against John Cena. With his career already at risk at WrestleMania, Shawn Michaels appeals to The Undertaker to raise the stakes. Sheamus' recent attempt to force Triple H to take notice of him pays off.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 15, 2010
videos.overview: "Stone Cold" Steve Austin returns as Raw Guest Host and mediates the contract signing between Bret Hart and Mr. McMahon. Shawn Michaels promises to use his match with World Heavyweight Champion Chris Jericho to send a message to The Undertaker. Plus, John Cena faces Big Show, WWE Champion Batista takes on Kofi Kingston, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 22, 2010
videos.overview: The rivalry between John Cena and WWE Champion Batista explodes. Raw Guest Host Pete Rose gives Shawn Michaels a chance to swing for the fences in a special match against Kane. Mr. McMahon vows to screw Bret Hart once again. Plus, Sheamus & Legacy team up to take on Triple H & Randy Orton in a 3-On-2 Handicap Match and more.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 29, 2010
videos.overview: The storied career of one of the greatest performers in WWE history comes to a close as Shawn Michaels bids farewell to the WWE Universe. When his attempt to cash in his Money in the Bank contract fails, Jack Swagger teams with Batista to face Randy Orton & WWE Champion John Cena.
