After gaining closure with Mr. McMahon, Bret Hart finds a new enemy.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 05, 2010
videos.overview: Raw Guest Host and NXT Rookie David Otunga teams with John Cena to challenge ShoMiz for the Unified WWE Tag Team Championship. Jack Swagger begins his reign as the new World Heavyweight Champion by taking on Randy Orton. Triple H looks to hammer home a lesson to Sheamus. Plus, Ted DiBiase and Christian meet in singles action and more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 12, 2010
videos.overview: In light of his recent betrayal of John Cena, NXT Rookie David Otunga is ordered by Raw Guest Host David Hasselhoff to go one-on-one with the current WWE Champion. Two former Evolution members clash in the main event as Batista faces off against Randy Orton. Plus, The Hart Dynasty begins a push for gold, Sheamus in action, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 19, 2010
videos.overview: On a night where the entire Raw roster is absent do to some unusual circumstances, the Superstars of SmackDown look to seize control of Monday night, beginning with CM Punk and his Straight Edge Society picking a fight with Triple H. Jack Swagger goes one-on-one with The Undertaker. Raw Guest Host MacGruber partners with The Great Khali and more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 26, 2010
videos.overview: The landscape of WWE is once again drastically altered by the WWE Draft. As Superstars from both Raw and SmackDown battle each other to earn their brand draft picks, a Triple Threat Match main event between Batista, Randy Orton, and Sheamus decides a new No. 1 Contender to challenge John Cena for the WWE Championship.

videos.title: Raw - May. 03, 2010
videos.overview: After United States Champion The Miz offers up NXT Rookie Daniel Bryan to go one-on-one with Batista in a Beat the Clock Match, Chris Jericho follows suit by having John Cena battle his NXT Rookie, Wade Barrett. Raw Guest Host Wayne Brady makes an appearance on The Cutting Edge. The Hart Dynasty defends the Unified WWE Tag Team Championship.

videos.title: Raw - May. 10, 2010
videos.overview: New Raw General Manager Vickie Guerrero punishes Randy Orton for his recent attacks on various Raw Guest Hosts by ordering him to face Edge and a mystery partner in a Handicap Match. Mark Henry comes to the aid of WWE Champion John Cena during an assault at the hands of Sheamus and Batista. All this and much more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 17, 2010
videos.overview: WWE Hall of Famer Bret Hart challenges The Miz for the United States Championship in a No Disqualification Match. In the main event, Sheamus goes one-on-one with WWE Champion John Cena. Plus, Randy Orton looks to give Edge a deathly surprise, Mark Henry gets some payback on Batista, and much more action.

videos.title: Raw - May. 24, 2010
videos.overview: Batista quits WWE once Bret Hart takes over as General Manager. Edge and Chris Jericho both look to find their way into the upcoming Fatal 4-Way Match by battling WWE Champion John Cena in a Triple Threat Match. Plus, comedian Jon Lovitz hosts a special Superstar Search, R-Truth battles The Miz.

videos.title: Raw - May. 31, 2010
videos.overview: On a night where Randy Orton & WWE Champion John Cena take on Edge & Sheamus, The Rated-R Superstar looks to eliminate The Viper from competition. Raw General Manager Bret Hart collaborates with Raw Guest Host Ashton Kutcher on ideas for an upcoming event. Despite being eliminated from NXT, Daniel Bryan goes one-on-one with The Miz.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 07, 2010
videos.overview: The WWE Universe takes control of what they want to see with the first ever Viewer's Choice edition of Raw. several top WWE Superstars compete in matches selected by the fans. However, things take shocking turn when a band of young talents led by Wade Barrett forces everyone to sit up and take notice of The Nexus.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 14, 2010
videos.overview: When Raw General Manager Bret Hart takes matters in his own hands to stop the brutal onslaught brought on by The Nexus, he learns the painful truth of strength in numbers. Despite being targeted for another assault by Wade Barrett and his band of NXT Rookies, WWE Champion John Cena partners with Randy Orton to face Edge & Sheamus.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 21, 2010
videos.overview: After firing and replacing Bret Hart as the Raw General Manager with someone with some anonymity, Mr. McMahon rehires The Nexus to shake things up in WWE. However, The Chairman soon discovers that the hand that feeds is in danger of being bitten. Sheamus defends the WWE Championship against John Cena. All this and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 28, 2010
videos.overview: While John Cena turns to an unlikely ally to help him fight off the invading Nexus, Wade Barrett and his band of vigilantes seize another opportunity to make a name for themselves by targeting a group of WWE Legends and Hall of Famers. Raw Guest Host Rob Zombie an Eight-Man Tag Team Match main event. All this and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 05, 2010
videos.overview: With tensions on the rise throughout WWE since the arrival of The Nexus, the Anonymous Raw General Manager decrees that John Cena must make peace with Wade Barrett. Each of the eight participants in the upcoming Money in the Bank Ladder Match take to the ring to compete in a series of matches. Plus, Ted DiBiase, The Miz, and many more in action.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 12, 2010
videos.overview: John Cena continues his war with The Nexus by taking on all six members in a Handicap Match. Chris Jericho makes his presence felt when Randy Orton goes one-on-one with Edge. Two families with an enduring legacy in WWE clash as Tamina & The Usos take on The Hart Dynasty. Plus, United States Champion The Miz faces Mark Henry and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 19, 2010
videos.overview: John Cena humbles himself and asks the Nexus for a truce. Before WWE Champion Sheamus lays some disciplinary action down on Evan Bourne, a Triple Threat Match between Randy Orton, Edge, and Chris Jericho is set to determine the new No. 1 Contender to challenge The Celtic Warrior for the gold. Plus, Wade Barrett and Mark Henry and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 26, 2010
videos.overview: Despite assembling a team to help him combat The Nexus at SummerSlam, John Cena partners with Chris Jericho to take on United States Champion The Miz & WWE Champion Sheamus. Wade Barrett and his men once again prove that there is strength in numbers by competing in a Tag Team Elimination Match. All this and much more action.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 02, 2010
videos.overview: The implosion of Team WWE in their war with The Nexus continues after Edge challenges Wade Barrett to meet him in singles action. While John Cena struggles to keep his allies together, Chris Jericho looks to eliminate him from the group in a one-on-one bout. In the main event, United States Champion The Miz takes on Randy Orton and more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 09, 2010
videos.overview: When Bret Hart returns to try to salvage Team WWE before their fight with The Nexus at SummerSlam, he joins John Cena for a Tag Team Match against Chris Jericho & Edge. While Team WWE falls apart, Wade Barrett and his allies target Mark Henry. Plus, R-Truth, United States Champion The Miz, and more in action.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 16, 2010
videos.overview: After suffering defeat at SummerSlam, each of The Nexus members find themselves competing in a series of singles bouts with various Raw Superstars. Plus, Bret Hart presents The Hart Dynasty with a new pair of championship titles, Randy Orton's frustrations end up causing Sheamus a great deal of pain, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 23, 2010
videos.overview: The Anonymous Raw General Manager gives Sheamus an opportunity to choose an opponent for the WWE Championship at Night of Champions. While The Celtic Warrior sits on his throne to witness the next potential challengers for his title in action, Wade Barrett puts an end to Sheamus' truce with The Nexus. All this and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 30, 2010
videos.overview: With 900 episodes in the books, WWE celebrates a landmark achievement with an unforgettable episode of Monday Night Raw. The Nexus takes on John Cena, Edge, Randy Orton, Chris Jericho & WWE Champion Sheamus in the main event. John Morrison & R-Truth face SmackDown's Drew McIntyre & Cody Rhodes for a chance at the WWE Tag Team Championship.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 06, 2010
videos.overview: Randy Orton battles Wade Barrett in the main event. Justin Gabriel finds himself in action against John Cena. Chris Jericho and John Morrison meet in an incredible contest. Plus, tensions between Daniel Bryan and United States Champion The Miz continue to rise, Edge looks to stand toe-to-toe with a giant, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 13, 2010
videos.overview: As the Roulette Wheel returns to decide the fate of several Superstars, John Cena goes one-on-one with Randy Orton in a Tables Match. When Chris Jericho looks to force his way into the Six-Pack Challenge for the WWE Championship by going on strike, the Anonymous RAW General Manager gives Y2J the opportunity he is looking for inside a Steel Cage.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 20, 2010
videos.overview: John Cena battles every member of The Nexus in a Gauntlet Match. Despite losing the WWE Championship to Randy Orton at Night of Champions, Sheamus is given an opportunity to reclaim the gold at Hell in a Cell. With The Miz vowing to take the United States Title back from him, Daniel Bryan goes one-on-one with Edge and more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 27, 2010
videos.overview: The Anonymous Raw General Manager pushes Edge to the breaking point when an interview on The Cutting Edge leads to The Rated-R Superstar going one-on-one with the next potential member of The Nexus, John Cena. Sheamus gets more than he bargained for when he issues an open challenge. Plus, Chris Jericho faces WWE Champion Randy Orton and more!

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 04, 2010
videos.overview: After being forced to join The Nexus, John Cena looks to cause chaos when he & Michael Tarver take on Evan Bourne & Mark Henry. However, Cena's attempts are rendered futile by the Anonymous RAW General Manager. Plus, a 20-Man Battle Royal to determine a new No. 1 Contender for the WWE Championship, Johnny Knoxville serves as Guest Host, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 11, 2010
videos.overview: John Cena battles The Miz in a No Disqualification Match for the right to lead Team Raw against Team SmackDown at Bragging Rights. With his opportunity to challenge Randy Orton for the WWE Championship approaching, Wade Barrett enlists Nexus member Justin Gabriel to go one-on-one with The Viper. CM Punk takes on Evan Bourne and more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 18, 2010
videos.overview: As Bragging Rights approaches, SmackDown General Manager Theodore Long tries taking over Raw. However, things take an unexpected turn when Team RAW captain The Miz faces the captain of Team SmackDown, Big Show. John Cena is tasked with testing the abilities of a pair of new additions to the Nexus, Husky Harris and Michael McGillicutty.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 25, 2010
videos.overview: John Cena faces Randy Orton in the main event to give Wade Barrett a special opportunity. However, Barrett's control of The Nexus begins to wane when he makes a title change of his own. In an Inter-promotional rematch, SmackDown's Intercontinental Champion Dolph Ziggler takes on United States Champion Daniel Bryan. All this and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 01, 2010
videos.overview: With everything at stake for him at Survivor Series, John Cena serves as the special guest referee when WWE Champion Randy Orton & R-Truth take on The Nexus' Wade Barrett & David Otunga. After trying to bully Pee-wee Herman, The Miz finds himself battling one of Pee-wee's larger relatives. Plus, The Hart Dynasty in action and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 08, 2010
videos.overview: Before serving as the Special Guest Referee when Wade Barrett and The Nexus take on WWE Champion Randy Orton and his team of WWE Superstars in a 10-Man Tag Team Match, John Cena is ordered to chastise David Otunga for his recent actions on SmackDown. Plus, Goldust and Ted DiBiase face off, The Hart Dynasty battles The Usos, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 15, 2010
videos.overview: Raw goes Old School. After going one-on-one with Mr. Money in the Bank, The Miz, John Cena joins "Rowdy" Roddy Piper on an all new edition of Piper's Pit. In the main event, United States Champion Daniel Bryan goes one-on-one with Jack Swagger. Plus, Sgt. Slaughter looks to teach Alberto Del Rio some respect, Wade Barrett battles R-Truth, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 22, 2010
videos.overview: As a result of Wade Barrett failing to capture the WWE Championship from Randy Orton at Survivor Series, John Cena's career in WWE comes to an apparent end. While The Viper looks to successfully defend his title against Barrett in a main event rematch, nothing can prepare the current champion for the awesome display of opportunism that awaits him.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 29, 2010
videos.overview: On a night where John Morrison, Sheamus, Alberto Del Rio, and many more compete for the opportunity to sit on their very own throne in the conclusion of the 2010 King of the Ring Tournament, The Miz defends the WWE Championship against the epitome of sports-entertainment royalty in a Tables, Ladders, and Chairs Match. Plus, John Cena and more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 06, 2010
videos.overview: Despite having the power to rehire John Cena in the palm of his hand, Wade Barrett begins to lose his grip on The Nexus. WWE Champion The Miz leads Alex Riley into one-on-one action against Randy Orton. When Sheamus looks to ascend to his throne after winning the 2010 King of the Ring Tournament, John Morrison steps up to overthrow his reign.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 13, 2010
videos.overview: The best in WWE are honored on this edition of Raw as WWE and David Arquette kick off the 2010 Slammy Awards. While Arquette gets reacquainted with the WWE Universe, the former WCW World Heavyweight Champion partners with Alex Riley to face Randy Orton. The problems within The Nexus lead Wade Barrett to make a decision regarding John Cena's future.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 20, 2010
videos.overview: After trying to get into the Christmas spirit in an unusual way, WWE Champion The Miz partners with Alex Riley and King Sheamus to take on John Morrison, Randy Orton, and Jerry "The King" Lawler in a Six-Man Tag Team Match. Following his victory over Wade Barrett at WWE TLC, John Cena goes one-on-one with Intercontinental Champion Dolph Ziggler.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 27, 2010
videos.overview: When John Cena calls out CM Punk to answer for his recent attack on him, The Straight Edge Superstar shows the WWE Universe that his true colors may be yellow. In the main event, Randy Orton goes one-on-one with King Sheamus. WWE Champion The Miz faces off against Jerry "The King" Lawler. Plus, John Morrison takes on Alex Riley and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 03, 2011
videos.overview: The first Raw of 2011 begins with The Miz defending the WWE Championship against John Morrison in a Falls Count Anywhere Match. Before battling Randy Orton and King Sheamus in a Triple Threat Steel Cage Match main event to determine a new No. 1 Contender for the WWE Title, Wade Barrett's reign as leader of The Nexus is contested by CM Punk.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 10, 2011
videos.overview: As CM Punk takes control of his New Nexus, John Cena returns to issue a challenge to The Straight Edge Superstar. Jerry "The King" Lawler & Randy Orton take on Alex Riley & WWE Champion The Miz. When the first inductee of the WWE Hall of Fame Class of 2011 is announced, Alberto Del Rio gets a real kick out of the situation. Plus, R-Truth and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 17, 2011
videos.overview: With the largest Royal Rumble Match ever rapidly approaching, several Raw Superstars look to stake their claim in the upcoming contest. Despite the members of his New Nexus being banned from ringside, CM Punk faces John Cena in the main event. Plus, The Usos challenge Santino Marella & Vladimir Kozlov for the WWE Tag Team Championship and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 24, 2011
videos.overview: The Anonymous RAW General Manager looks to make CM Punk rethink his plans about using his New Nexus to help win the Royal Rumble by ordering John Cena to serve as the special guest referee in a main event bout between The Straight Edge Superstar and the leader of The Corre, Wade Barrett. WWE Champion The Miz faces World Heavyweight Champion Edge.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 31, 2011
videos.overview: After Alberto Del Rio uses his victory in the 2011 Royal Rumble Match to go challenge Edge for the World Heavyweight Championship at WrestleMania XXVII, Raw Superstars compete in a special RAW Rumble main event to see who will challenge The Miz for the WWE Championship. Plus, Santino Marella & Vladimir Kozlov defend the Tag Team Championship.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 07, 2011
videos.overview: As the road to WrestleMania gets underway, Mr. McMahon returns to make an announcement regarding The Grandest Stage of Them All. Randy Orton looks to take out the New Nexus, CM Punk goes one-on-one with John Cena. Jerry "The King" Lawler partners with Daniel Bryan to face WWE Champion The Miz & Ted DiBiase. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 14, 2011
videos.overview: While the Road to WrestleMania prepares to go through Elimination Chamber, the WWE Universe gets electrified when The Rock is introduced to be the Guest Host for The Showcase of the Immortals. WWE Champion The Miz goes one-on-one with his former NXT pupil and the current United States Champion Daniel Bryan. Plus, John Cena battles CM Punk and more.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 21, 2011
videos.overview: John Cena addresses some disparaging comments made by The Rock. On a night where the bell tolls for the return of The Undertaker, the WWE Universe is left in awe when another Superstar shows up with a symbolic challenge to The Deadman. Plus, CM Punk clashes with John Morrison in one-on-one action, King / Sheamus battles Mark Henry, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 28, 2011
videos.overview: With his silent challenge to The Undertaker still echoing throughout the WWE Universe, Triple H explains his motivations behind wanting to conquer The Deadman's streak. While The Rock's insults toward him continue from The Great One's home, John Cena takes to the ring for main event competition against Alex Riley inside a Steel Cage.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 07, 2011
videos.overview: The rivalry between John Cena and The Rock picks up when Cena takes the gloves off to speak out about the so-called People's Champion. Plus, The Undertaker vows to make Triple H rest in peace on The Grandest Stage of Them All, CM Punk in action, "Stone Cold" Steve Austin returns, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 14, 2011
videos.overview: WWE Champion The Miz looks to stand out in the rivalry between The Rock and the challenger for his title, John Cena. Daniel Bryan puts the United States Championship on the line against Sheamus. Michael Cole makes things personal in his rivalry with Jerry Lawler by welcoming a member of The King's family back to WWE. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 21, 2011
videos.overview: In John Cena's absence, The Miz takes it upon himself to rewrite history by unveiling a new design for the WWE Championship that he will be defending at WrestleMania. While continuing to go through The New Nexus on the way to facing CM Punk on The Grandest Stage of Them All, Randy Orton goes one-on-one with Rey Mysterio. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 28, 2011
videos.overview: With WrestleMania just days away, WWE Champion The Miz gets involved in a confrontation between The Rock and John Cena. As Triple H readies to break The Undertaker's undefeated streak, The Game receives some words of wisdom from an old friend. Christian & World Heavyweight Champion Edge face Alberto Del Rio & Brodus Clay and more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 04, 2011
videos.overview: After failing to defeat The Miz to capture the WWE Championship at WrestleMania thanks to The Rock, John Cena comes face-to-face with The Great One in a history-making moment. "Stone Cold" Steve Austin introduces the WWE Universe to a group of men and women who will compete for a WWE contract on the next season of Tough Enough and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 11, 2011
videos.overview: The WWE Universe says goodbye to one of the most talented WWE Superstars ever when World Heavyweight Champion Edge announces his retirement from competition in an emotional farewell address. John Cena, Randy Orton, Dolph Ziggler, R-Truth, and John Morrison compete in a Gauntlet Match to determine a new No. 1 Contender for the WWE Championship.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 18, 2011
videos.overview: With both R-Truth and John Cena set to challenge The Miz for the WWE Championship inside a Steel Cage at Extreme Rules, Truth decides to gamble his position by defending his status as No. 1 Contender against John Morrison. In the main event, CM Punk and Randy Orton face each other in rematch from their battle at WrestleMania and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 25, 2011
videos.overview: While the 2011 WWE Draft looks to reshape the landscapes of both SmackDown and Raw, a Six-Man Tag Team Match sees the newest draftees to each brand compete against each other. Plus, Randy Orton vows to put CM Punk to sleep at Extreme Rules, Sir Michael Cole takes on Jim Ross, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 02, 2011
videos.overview: The Rock celebrates his birthday in a huge way with the WWE Universe. After losing the WWE Championship at Extreme Rules, The Miz looks to regain what he lost by challenging John Cena for the gold. R-Truth continues to embrace a more unpredictable side when he targets John Morrison. Plus, Kane faces Mason Ryan, Rey Mysterio in action, and more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 09, 2011
videos.overview: R-Truth continues to slip further into insanity when the Anonymous RAW General Manager neglects to include him in a Triple Threat Match to determine a new No. 1 Contender for the WWE Championship. While waiting to see who will challenge him for his title, WWE Champion John Cena takes to the ring to go one-on-one with Alex Riley and more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 16, 2011
videos.overview: With John Cena selecting to defend the WWE Championship against The Miz in an "I Quit" Match at Over the Limit, the Anonymous RAW General Manager allows The Miz to choose both the stipulation and the opponent to battle to Cena in the main event. Plus, Kharma arrives to make an impact, CM Punk takes on United States Champion Kofi Kingston, and more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 23, 2011
videos.overview: After returning to congratulate Jerry "The King" Lawler on his victory over Michael Cole at Over the Limit, Bret Hart finds himself serving as the special guest referee when WWE Champion John Cena & Rey Mysterio face R-Truth & CM Punk in the main event. While being scolded by The Miz, Alex Riley decides to make a change. Plus, Evan Bourne and more.

videos.title: Raw - May. 30, 2011
videos.overview: In response to R-Truth's beliefs of a conspiracy against him, the Anonymous Raw General Manager gives him a main event bout against WWE Champion John Cena. Just as her tenure in WWE is set to begin, Kharma makes a shocking announcement regarding her career. Michael Cole confronts Alex Riley. Plus, Dolph Ziggler, Kofi Kingston, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 06, 2011
videos.overview: On a night where WWE Hall of Famer "Stone Cold" Steve Austin announces the winner of Tough Enough, The Rattlesnake serves as the special guest referee when Alex Riley partners with WWE Champion John Cena to take on the unlikely duo of The Miz & R-Truth in the main event. In a rematch from their previous encounter, CM Punk and Rey Mysterio face off.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 13, 2011
videos.overview: "Stone Cold" Steve Austin takes control Raw. While Superstars from both Raw and SmackDown find themselves at the mercy of The Rattlesnake, CM Punk's Nexus is banned from ringside when he takes on WWE Champion John Cena in the main event. A confrontational Piper's Pit leads to The Miz and "Rowdy" Roddy Piper facing off in match. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 20, 2011
videos.overview: On a Power to the People edition of Raw, the WWE Universe is given the opportunity to make the matches. From choosing Kane and Mark Henry to meet in an Arm Wrestling Contest to having CM Punk battle Alberto Del Rio and Rey Mysterio in a Falls Count Anywhere Match for a chance at the WWE Championship, control is truly in the hands of the fans.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 27, 2011
videos.overview: On a night where everything is left up to chance with Raw Roulette deciding the stipulations of every match, the WWE Universe expects the unexpected. However, nothing will prepare the WWE Universe for what CM Punk has to say when The Straight Edge Superstar sits down to give everyone a piece of his mind. Plus, John Cena and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 04, 2011
videos.overview: With CM Punk's controversial statements causing his suspension, WWE Champion John Cena calls on Mr. McMahon to reinstate The Straight Edge Superstar. While the WWE Universe awaits The Chairman's decision, Alberto Del Rio, R-Truth, and Rey Mysterio compete in a Triple Threat Match to determine a new No. 1 Contender for the WWE Championship.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 11, 2011
videos.overview: CM Punk returns to negotiate a new WWE contract with Mr. McMahon. While The Straight Edge Superstar proclaims himself to be "The Voice of the Voiceless," WWE Champion John Cena takes exception to his rivals apparent hypocrisy. The participants in the upcoming Money in the Bank Ladder Match compete in a Six-Man Tag Team Match and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 18, 2011
videos.overview: With CM Punk leaving the company after capturing the WWE Championship at Money in the Bank, Mr. McMahon initiates a tournament to crown a new WWE Champion and vows to punish John Cena for failing to defeat The Straight Edge Superstar. However, The Chairman's plans backfire when another member of the McMahon family returns to restore order.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 25, 2011
videos.overview: After the WWE Championship Tournament concludes in a bout between Rey Mysterio and The Miz, Chief Operating Officer Triple H announces that John Cena will challenge the new champion for the gold in the main event. However, the state of the WWE Championship descends into chaos when another Superstar stakes his claim in the title picture.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 01, 2011
videos.overview: With CM Punk's return causing controversy in the WWE Championship picture, Chief Operating Officer Triple H sets out to decide whether The Straight Edge Superstar or John Cena has a better claim to the WWE Championship. United States Champion Dolph Ziggler tries to gain the WWE Universe's respect. Plus, Alberto Del Rio faces Evan Bourne and more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 08, 2011
videos.overview: While John Cena and CM Punk each proclaim themselves to be the sole WWE Champion, Chief Operating Officer Triple H inserts himself in their upcoming SummerSlam bout to ensure that only one man will hold the gold. But before Punk and Cena sign the contract for their confrontation, both men compete in singles action.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 15, 2011
videos.overview: Following a controversial SummerSlam that saw CM Punk lose the WWE Championship thanks to interference from Kevin Nash, Chief Operating Officer Triple H denies any involvement in his longtime friend's actions. Alberto Del Rio defends the WWE Championship against Rey Mysterio. Plus, Jack Swagger faces Alex Riley, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 22, 2011
videos.overview: CM Punk makes a mistake that costs him dearly when he confronts Kevin Nash once again. While waiting to see who will challenge him for his title, Alberto Del Rio goes one-on-one with John Morrison. Michael McGillicutty & David Otunga defend the WWE Tag Team Championship against Kofi Kingston & Evan Bourne. All this and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 29, 2011
videos.overview: Triple H makes an announcement that changes the future of Raw while the controversy surrounding his involvement in the rivalry between Kevin Nash and CM Punk leads The Game to make an important decision. John Cena partners with Sheamus to take on Mark Henry & Christian in a Tag Team Match. Plus, Sin Cara battles Jack Swagger and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 05, 2011
videos.overview: The ongoing issues involving CM Punk, Kevin Nash, and Triple H lead the Chief Operating Officer of WWE to fire his longtime friend. While The Game looks to do what's best for business, The Straight Edge Superstar to goes one-on-one with R-Truth. Plus, John Cena, Sheamus, John Morrison, and more compete in a Tag Team Elimination Match.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 12, 2011
videos.overview: With his career as Chief Operating Officer on the line at Night of Champions, Triple H comes face-to-face with CM Punk to let him know that their problems are about more than just business. A verbal altercation leads to John Cena teaming up with Bret Hart to take on WWE Champion Alberto Del Rio and his personal ring announcer Ricardo Rodriguez.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 19, 2011
videos.overview: After feeling the result of the power struggle between John Laurinaitis and Triple H, CM Punk partners with WWE Champion John Cena against Awesome Truth. Hollywood actor Hugh Jackman enlists Zack Ryder to go one-on-one with United States Champion Dolph Ziggler. Mark Henry looks to make an example out of someone. All this and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 26, 2011
videos.overview: While several disgruntled WWE Superstars confront COO Triple H about their recent issues, The Game looks puts his employees to the test with in-ring competition. Before defending the WWE Championship against CM Punk and Alberto Del Rio at Hell in a Cell, John Cena gets a front row seat to watch his two opponents battle each other in the main event.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 03, 2011
videos.overview: When Triple H's tenure as Chief Operating Officer is once again criticized by a handful of disgruntled WWE Superstars, he orders those unhappy with his leadership to compete in a 12-Man Tag Team Match main event. Plus, Randy Orton and Drew McIntyre meet in singles action, John Morrison takes on World Heavyweight Champion Mark Henry, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 10, 2011
videos.overview: Despite the vast majority of WWE Superstars walking out in protest of Triple H's role as Chief Operating Officer, The Game assembles Sheamus, John Cena, and CM Punk to help him run this edition of Raw. However, order is once again restored when Mr. McMahon returns to name a new Interim RAW General Manager. Plus, Mark Henry takes on Randy Orton.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 17, 2011
videos.overview: After offering Jim Ross a public apology for firing him, John Laurinaitis orders John Cena & Good Ol' JR to team up against Michael Cole & WWE Champion Alberto Del Rio. With Triple H in his corner, CM Punk faces The Miz. World Heavyweight Champion Mark Henry, Christian & Cody Rhodes compete in a Six-Man Tag Team Match. All this and more!

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 24, 2011
videos.overview: With The Miz and R-Truth costing him a shot at reclaiming the WWE Championship at Vengeance, John Cena has payback on his mind. In an effort to earn the respect of CM Punk, John Laurinaitis gives CM Punk an opportunity to challenge Alberto Del Rio for the WWE Championship. Kevin Nash uses a sledgehammer to stab Triple H in the back and more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 31, 2011
videos.overview: As The Rock answers John Cena's request to be his partner at Survivor Series, Cena takes to the ring to battle The Miz. After WWE Champion Alberto Del Rio interferes in CM Punk's match against World Heavyweight Champion Mark Henry, The Straight Edge Superstar returns the favor during Del Rio's battle with Big Show. Plus, The Muppets and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 07, 2011
videos.overview: Despite The Rock accepting his request to team up with him against Awesome Truth at Survivor Series, John Cena enlists Zack Ryder to be his partner in the main event of this edition of Raw. Alberto Del Rio asks John Laurinaitis to cancel his upcoming WWE Championship defense against CM Punk. Kevin Nash addresses his recent attack on Triple H.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 14, 2011
videos.overview: While John Cena receives an unusual present from Mick Foley, The Rock returns to come face-to-face with his Survivor Series partner and size-up their opponents. Michael Cole finds himself in an uncomfortable position when he meets Jim Ross in a special challenge. Big Show & CM Punk face Mark Henry & Alberto Del Rio. All this and more action.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 21, 2011
videos.overview: CM Punk begins his reign as WWE Champion by facing United States Champion Dolph Ziggler. Despite a successful victory alongside The Rock, John Cena learns that his problems with Awesome Truth are not over. In the main event, Wade Barrett goes one-on-one with Kofi Kingston. Plus, Santino Marella faces Intercontinental Champion Cody Rhodes and more.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 28, 2011
videos.overview: John Cena is put to the test when "Rowdy" Roddy Piper welcomes him to Piper's Pit. Alberto Del Rio looks to reclaim the WWE Championship by challenging CM Punk for the gold. In a Falls Count Anywhere Match, The Miz battles his former partner John Morrison. Plus, Randy Orton and United States Champion Dolph Ziggler face off and more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 05, 2011
videos.overview: With The Miz, John Cena, and Alberto Del Rio each looking for a chance at the WWE Championship, John Laurinaitis gives all three men a chance to challenge CM Punk for the gold at TLC if they can first defeat their assigned opponents. Kevin Nash faces Santino Marella. Divas Champion Beth Phoenix & Natalya take on Eve Torres & Kelly Kelly, and more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 12, 2011
videos.overview: Witness WWE honor the most unforgettable moments and superstars from 2011 as the Monday Night RAW Super Show hosts The Slammy Awards. Amidst the celebration of the year's best and worst, WWE's finest are in action including John Cena, Randy Orton, and many more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 19, 2011
videos.overview: WWE Champion CM Punk, United States Champion Zack Ryder & World Heavyweight Champion Daniel Bryan take on The Miz, Alberto Del Rio & Dolph Ziggler. While trying to make sense of his recent assault at the hands of Kane, John Cena is once again targeted by The Big Red Monster. Plus, Randy Orton faces Wade Barrett, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 26, 2011
videos.overview: In his hometown of Chicago, WWE Champion CM Punk is ordered by John Laurinaitis to compete in a Gauntlet Match with major implications for his WWE Championship reign. After weeks of targeting John Cena with no explanation, Kane finally addresses his recent actions and implores Cena to embrace the hate. Plus, The Miz, Big Show, and many more.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 02, 2012
videos.overview: RAW kicks off 2012 with a bang from Memphis, TN! John Cena delivers a special message to Kane. Cody Rhodes clashes with Daniel Bryan. CM Punk defends the WWE Championship against Dolph Ziggler. The Bella Twins are in action against Kelly Kelly and Eve. John Cena, Big Show, and Zack Ryder face Mark Henry and Jack Swagger in a Handicap Match.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 09, 2012
videos.overview: Kane looks to spread the hate, Chris Jericho makes his second return appearance on Raw, Brodus Clay finally debuts, and the first two members of the 2012 class of the WWE Hall of Fame are revealed.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 16, 2012
videos.overview: WWE Champion CM Punk rails against Interim GM John Laurinaitis stacking the deck for Punk's WWE Championship defense against Dolph Ziggler at the Royal Rumble in two weeks, while a former WWE Champion attempts to become one of the 30 competitors in the Royal Rumble Match.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 23, 2012
videos.overview: With less than a week until the Royal Rumble, CM Punk must deal with Interim GM John Laurinaitis's pledge to screw Punk during his WWE Championship Match with Dolph Ziggler at the Rumble, John Cena and Kane continue to clash, and Chris Jericho finally speaks.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 30, 2012
videos.overview: General Manager John Laurinaitis kicks off the show by announcing the participants in this year's Elimination Chamber match. Randy Orton collides with Dolph Ziggler. CM Punk battles Daniel Bryan to determine who really is the best in the world. The return of the Undertaker and much more!

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 06, 2012
videos.overview: Triple H addresses the WWE Universe about his confrontation with the Undertaker last week. Big Show goes one on one with World Heavyweight Champion, Daniel Bryan. CM Punk, Kofi Kingston, R-Truth, The Miz, and Chris Jericho face off in a Six-Pack Challenge with the winner advancing into the last spot in the Elimination Chamber.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 13, 2012
videos.overview: Six days before they must enter the sadistic Elimination Chamber, WWE Champion CM Punk and the five challengers to his title each make their case as to who will emerge from the dreaded structure as the victor. Kane continues to play mind games with John Cena, and Shawn Michaels makes a rare appearance to deliver a message to Triple H.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 20, 2012
videos.overview: WWE Champion CM Punk looks on from ringside as ten Superstars from Raw and SmackDown compete in a Battle Royal to determine his challenger for the ultimate prize at WrestleMania XXVIII. Undertaker emerges to entice The Game, Triple H, into a rematch on the world's grandest stage. John Cena has some harsh words for The Rock.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 27, 2012
videos.overview: The Rock and John Cena exchange heated words as their 'Once in a Lifetime' match at WrestleMania draws closer. Cena and The Miz reprise their encounter from last year's big event. WWE Champion CM Punk faces World Heavyweight Champion Daniel Bryan and Kane returns to spread his message of hate.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 05, 2012
videos.overview: Just 27 days away from WrestleMania, Raw kicks off with a bang as Shawn Michaels delivers a message to the Boston crowd and entire WWE Universe. John Cena and The Rock exchange a war of words leading up to the big event. Sheamus joins forces with CM Punk to take on Daniel Bryan and Chris Jericho. Big Show and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 12, 2012
videos.overview: Before they meet in one-on-one action at WrestleMania XXVIII, The Rock and John Cena come face-to-face in a different competition. The Undertaker lets the world know exactly how he feels about Shawn Michaels getting involved in his upcoming battle with Triple H. WWE Champion CM Punk battles The Miz. All this and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 19, 2012
videos.overview: Undertaker, Triple H and Shawn Michaels meet in a heated confrontation and offer their predictions for the End of an Era Hell in a Cell Match. Chris Jericho continues to cross personal lines with CM Punk. The Rock delivers a rousing speech proclaiming that he will conquer John Cena at WrestleMania.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 26, 2012
videos.overview: In the final Raw Supershow before WrestleMania XXVIII, The Rock and John Cena have one more face-to-face encounter before their Once in a Lifetime Match. CM Punk becomes unhinged by the biting words of Chris Jericho. Team Johnny and Team Teddy make some high profile, last-minute additions. Plus, many more top Superstars are in action.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 02, 2012
videos.overview: WWE caps off an earth-shattering week in Miami, Florida with a historic Raw the night after WrestleMania XXVIII. Brock Lesnar makes his shocking return to WWE to bring the pain to John Cena. Fans also witness the reemergence of Alberto Del Rio. Plus, The Rock declares his intention to bring the WWE Championship back to Team Bring It.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 09, 2012
videos.overview: General Manager John Laurinaitis recaps last week's confrontation between John Cena and Brock Lesnar. Will Brock bring the pain to Cena once again? Dolph Ziggler & Jack Swagger take on Brodus Clay & Santino Marella. R-Truth faces Cody Rhodes. Chris Jericho looks to degrade CM Punk. A special appearance from The Three Stooges and more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 16, 2012
videos.overview: From London, England, John Cena faces Lord Tensai in an Extreme Rules Match set up by RAW GM John Laurinaitis. WWE Champion CM Punk squares off against Mark Henry and is later confronted by Chris Jericho about their upcoming Chicago Street Fight at Extreme Rules.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 23, 2012
videos.overview: John Cena demands revenge from Brock Lesnar, but a certain WWE Hall of Famer has something else in store for Cena. Chris Jericho goes one-on-one with Kofi Kingston. Tensai takes on R-Truth. CM Punk continues his war of words with Chris Jericho. Mark Henry looks to induct Sheamus into the Hall of Pain and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 30, 2012
videos.overview: General Manager John Laurinaitis and COO Triple H confront Brock Lesnar after his loss to John Cena. Chris Jericho, Big Show, Daniel Bryan, Jerry "The King" Lawler, Randy Orton, and Jack Swagger look to set the fastest time as all six Superstars compete in a Beat the Clock Challenge to become the No. 1 Contender for CM Punk's WWE Championship.

videos.title: Raw - May. 07, 2012
videos.overview: General Manager John Laurinaitis addresses the WWE Universe, but WWE Champion CM Punk is ready to drop a verbal pipe bomb on the GM. Kofi Kingston takes on Dolph Ziggler. John Cena has a special message. Sheamus & Randy Orton join forces to take on Alberto Del Rio & Chris Jericho. CM Punk faces Daniel Bryan & Tensai in a Handicap Match.

videos.title: Raw - May. 14, 2012
videos.overview: Triple H addresses his altercation with Brock Lesnar. Big Show squares off with Kane, while the purveyor of People Power John Laurinaitis still seeks an apology from Big Show for mocking him. Two No. 1 Contenders for the World Heavyweight Championship go head-to-head with reigning champ Sheamus looking on from ringside.

videos.title: Raw - May. 21, 2012
videos.overview: John Cena addresses the controversy surrounding last night's match against John Laurinaitis at Over the Limit. Alberto Del Rio collides with Randy Orton. Kane goes one on one with Daniel Bryan. Kelly Kelly faces Beth Phoenix. John Cena and Sheamus join forces to take on Dolph Ziggler, Jack Swagger, and Tensai in a Lumberjack Handicap Match.

videos.title: Raw - May. 28, 2012
videos.overview: Big Show talks about his upcoming match with John Cena at No Way Out, then later squares off against Brodus Clay. CM Punk faces Daniel Bryan, and tensions mount between the struggling tag team of Dolph Ziggler and Jack Swagger.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 04, 2012
videos.overview: Sheamus goes one-on-one against Dolph Ziggler. Kane faces CM Punk. Kofi Kingston and R-Truth are in tag team action. John Cena faces Tensai in the main event and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 11, 2012
videos.overview: Is it the end of People Power? WWE CEO Vince McMahon has GM John Laurinaitis under his radar. Sheamus battles Tensai. Daniel Bryan continues his war of words with CM Punk over AJ Lee. Kofi Kingston battles Big Show in a Steel Cage Match. It's Time for Heath Slater to meet his match when he faces a legendary WWE and WCW Superstar.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 18, 2012
videos.overview: Mick Foley serves as guest GM, while Cyndi Lauper and Wendi Richter make a guest appearance. Two World Champions team up as CM Punk and Sheamus take on Daniel Bryan and Kane, while John Cena faces John Laurinaitis and David Otunga in a 2-on-1 Handicap match.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 25, 2012
videos.overview: Chris Jericho returns to action to face John Cena. CM Punk, Daniel Bryan and Kane reprise their recent Triple Threat Match while their unstable love interest, AJ, contemplates a decision between the three of them. Speaking of unstable, another surprise blast from Raw's past returns to celebrate the upcoming 1000th episode.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 02, 2012
videos.overview: A star-studded tag team main event features John Cena, WWE Champion CM Punk, Daniel Bryan and Chris Jericho. With Punk and Bryan in the same ring, will AJ be lurking at ringside to influence the outcome? Alberto Del Rio makes a statement toward his contendership for the WWE Title, and Paul Heyman addresses Triple H's challenge to Brock Lesnar.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 09, 2012
videos.overview: As Raw's 1000th episode draws closer, tensions heat up for the richest prizes in WWE and shocking secrets are revealed. Will AJ become the fiancé of CM Punk or Daniel Bryan? Who will gain momentum headed into Money in the Bank? And after all this time, who is the Anonymous Raw General Manager? All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - Jul 16, 2012
videos.overview: In the final 2-hour episode of Raw, John Cena reveals his intentions for cashing in the Money in the Bank contract for a WWE Title Match.

videos.title: Raw - Jul 23, 2012
videos.overview: After much anticipation, Raw's Monumental 1000th Episode surpasses the hype! Stars, legends and celebrities converge to celebrate history.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 30, 2012
videos.overview: Following a fire scare on the WWE's famed Titantron, new General Manager AJ Lee delivers a match with huge SummerSlam implications between John Cena and Big Show and the first-ever RawActive match featuring Sheamus and Daniel Bryan. Plus, CM Punk explains his GTS on The Rock.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 06, 2012
videos.overview: New GM AJ Lee allows the WWE Universe to choose the opponent for WWE Champion CM Punk in an innovative RawActive Match. WWE Hall of Famer Shawn Michaels appears in his hometown of San Antonio with a warning for Triple H's SummerSlam opponent, Brock Lesnar. And John Cena is in action against Daniel Bryan.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 13, 2012
videos.overview: Just 6 days before SummerSlam, the perfect storm is building as Brock Lesnar and Triple H sign a contract making their match official. Raw General Manager AJ Lee pairs WWE Champion CM Punk with bitter rival John Cena to take on Big Show and the unhinged Daniel Bryan. Plus, the WWE Universe goes RawActive to pick the next guest on Piper's Pit.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 20, 2012
videos.overview: In the aftermath of the perfect storm at SummerSlam, what will Triple H's defeat at the hands of Brock Lesnar mean for the future of the WWE? Who will be the next number one contender for the WWE Championship? And Chris Jericho puts his career on the line for chance to win Dolph Ziggler's Money in the Bank contract.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 27, 2012
videos.overview: CM Punk issues a special challenge to Jerry "The King" Lawler. The Miz goes one-on-one with John Cena. Team Rhodes Scholars battle Brodus Clay and Sin Cara. Team Hell No seek group counseling with Dr. Shelby. Daniel Bryan takes on R-Truth. The Viper Randy Orton teams with Sheamus to face Alberto Del Rio and Dolph Ziggler.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 03, 2012
videos.overview: WWE Champion CM Punk continues his quest for respect in his hometown of Chicago, while a pair of number one contenders, John Cena and Alberto Del Rio, meet in an unpredictable main event. Who will build momentum leading up to Night of Champions? Also, Daniel Bryan and Kane attempt to settle their issues with anger management and each other.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 10, 2012
videos.overview: WWE Hall of Famer Bret Hart is on hand for Raw in Montreal, Canada. The "Excellence of Execution" interviews WWE Champion CM Punk and his challenger at Night of Champions John Cena. The ongoing case against The Brogue Kick continues when Sheamus is deposed by David Otunga and Ricardo Rodriquez. CM Punk faces an opponent chosen by the WWE Universe.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 17, 2012
videos.overview: Following the confusion and controversy at Night of Champions, WWE Champion CM Punk faces John Cena once more, this time in tag team action with partner Alberto Del Rio against Cena and his counterpart, Sheamus. Plus, WWE's odd couple Kane & Daniel Bryan defend their Tag Team Championship against Kofi Kingston and R-Truth.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 24, 2012
videos.overview: CM Punk and Paul Heyman seek retribution for the controversial end to last week's main event, but John Cena and a certain hardcore legend have other plans for the WWE Champion. The WWE Universe receives a welcomed message from Jerry "The King" Lawler, who continues to recover in his Memphis home. Plus, Kofi Kingston battles Dolph Ziggler and more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 01, 2012
videos.overview: The new WWE Tag Team Champions, Team Hell No, must find their in ring chemistry to take on the team of Dolph Ziggler and WWE Champion CM Punk. It's Jim Ross Appreciation Night in Oklahoma City. What does Good Ol' JR have to say about the proposed Punk vs. Cena match at Hell in a Cell? Plus Sheamus, Rey Mysterio, Alberto Del Rio, and more!

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 08, 2012
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon pays a rare visit to the RAW ring to deliver the State of WWE Address, but WWE Champion CM Punk has his own message for the Chairman. John Cena is in the building, but will Punk finally accept his challenge for a match at Hell in a Cell? Plus Rey Mysterio & Sin Cara, The Rhodes Scholars, Team Hell No and more!

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 15, 2012
videos.overview: After weeks of speculation, who will be named as CM Punk's challenger for The WWE Championship at Hell in a Cell? Big Show looks to build momentum toward his showdown with World Heavyweight Champion Sheamus by facing the man who ruined his previous title reign, Daniel Bryan. And the rivalry between The Miz and Kofi Kingston gets more heated.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 22, 2012
videos.overview: The two WWE World Champions who are set to defend their titles in mere days at Hell in a Cell are surrounded by fellow Superstars for a main event Lumberjack Match. Why was AJ Lee summoned to meet with the WWE Board of Directors? Who will face Team Hell No for the WWE Tag Team Championship?

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 29, 2012
videos.overview: Did WWE Champion CM Punk survive his collision with the monster Ryback inside Hell in a Cell? Mick Foley is back to confront the battered and bruised WWE Champion. Who came out on top in the World Heavyweight Championship battle between Sheamus and The Big Show? Plus Team Hell No, Alberto Del Rio, Ryback and more!

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 05, 2012
videos.overview: Team Punk gets a major shake up just weeks before Survivor Series and its namesake finds himself in a massive tag team match with the newly teamed John Cena & Ryback. Vickie Guerrero escalates her accusations against Cena and former General Manager AJ Lee. Sheamus, Alberto Del Rio, Kane, Daniel Bryan and more are in action.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 12, 2012
videos.overview: One week before Survivor Series, CM Punk and John Cena look to gain momentum heading into their Triple Threat Match by going one-on-one with Mick Foley as the special guest enforcer. Plus, lineups for Team Foley and Team Ziggler are finalized, Jerry "The King" Lawler makes his emotional return to Raw after suffering a heart attack, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 19, 2012
videos.overview: The fallout from a shocking Survivor Series! Did CM Punk survive to see another day as WWE Champion? Who were the mysterious vigilantes that attacked Ryback in the Triple Threat WWE Championship Match? What will be the result of the controversy and chaos that transpired in the World Heavyweight Championship battle between The Big Show and Sheamus?

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 26, 2012
videos.overview: Seth Rollins, Roman Reigns, and Dean Ambrose have made a devastating impression on Ryback. What is their connection to WWE Champion CM Punk? The John Cena and AJ story has reached a boiling point thanks to Vickie Guerrero and Dolph Ziggler. How will Ziggler and Cena settle the score?

videos.title: Raw - Dec 03, 2012
videos.overview: John Cena and Sheamus team up to take on their rivals, The Big Show and Dolph Ziggler. Who will feel The Shield's wrath next?

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 10, 2012
videos.overview: The members of The Shield continue their onslaught with only six days remaining until their Six-Man TLC Match at Tables, Ladders & Chairs. John Cena and Big Show renew their earthshaking rivalry. Plus, Mr. McMahon gives former Raw GM AJ Lee a chance to finally get her hands on Vickie Guerrero.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 17, 2012
videos.overview: The WWE Superstars celebrate those who thrilled, shocked and amazed in 2012 with the annual WWE Slammy Awards. Legendary Superstars Ric Flair, Triple H, Ricky Steamboat, as well as many more WWE Legends returned to WWE. Plus, what was the aftermath of the stunning turn of events regarding John Cena and AJ Lee at WWE: TLC?

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 24, 2012
videos.overview: On a special Christmas Eve edition of RAW, will a Street Fight between John Cena and Alberto Del Rio be the setting for a holiday miracle? Plus, World Heavyweight Champion Big Show attempts to ice Sheamus in a non-title Lumberjack Frost Match. AJ Lee cozies up to Dolph Ziggler as they reminisce over the events of 2012.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 31, 2012
videos.overview: As the ball prepares to drop on 2012, WWE ends the year by putting all championships on the line! John Cena & The Miz team up to face vs Team Rhodes Scholars. The status of CM Punk's match with Ryback comes into question. And WWE's new power couple, Dolph Ziggler and AJ Lee, have a New Year's toast for the WWE Universe.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 07, 2013
videos.overview: Finally... The Rock returns to Monday Night RAW for the first episode of 2013! Will The Rock respond to CM Punk's harsh comments, and will Punk still hold the WWE Title after he finally squares off with Ryback in a TLC Match? Plus, Dolph Ziggler looks for revenge on John Cena for embarrassing him on the final RAW of 2012.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 14, 2013
videos.overview: Raw celebrates its monumental 20th Anniversary! The legendary Ric Flair appears on Miz TV. The first member of the 2013 WWE Hall of Fame Class is announced, and John Cena brawls with Dolph Ziggler in a Steel Cage.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 21, 2013
videos.overview: John Cena vows that 2013 will belong to Cena and it all starts in the Royal Rumble Match, but 29 other competitors are out to prove otherwise. Several Superstars try to earn a key advantage heading into the Royal Rumble Match by winning a Beat the Clock challenge. Plus, The Rock is hell-bent to find his way into the arena to address CM Punk.

videos.title: Raw - Jan. 28, 2013
videos.overview: It's Raw Roulette! The Rock addresses the people as WWE Champion for the first time in over 10 years. Royal Rumble winner John Cena declares his intentions for WrestleMania 29. Mr. McMahon is on hand to address the fate of CM Punk's cohort Paul Heyman and Heyman's relationship with the Shield. All this and more.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 04, 2013
videos.overview: After the shocking return of Brock Lesnar, what is the condition of WWE Chairman Vince McMahon? Former WWE Champion CM Punk must face a previous WrestleMania opponent chosen by the WWE Universe. An epic announcement is made regarding the WWE Hall of Fame, and John Cena calls out The Shield.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 11, 2013
videos.overview: A mere six days from the brutal Elimination Chamber, the final entrants into the #1 Contender Match inside the chamber are chosen. The Rock and CM Punk have some strong words before their epic rematch for the WWE Championship. And the confrontation heats up between John Cena, Sheamus and Ryback and The Shield.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 18, 2013
videos.overview: The Rock celebrates his WWE Championship victory at Elimination Chamber with a major surprise for the WWE Universe. But amidst the celebration, John Cena and CM Punk are embroiled in conflict over the right to challenge The Great One at WrestleMania. Plus, The Shield is ready for another Six-Man Tag Team Match and more.

videos.title: Raw - Feb. 25, 2013
videos.overview: John Cena and CM Punk collide in one of the most high stakes showdowns in their storied rivalry, where the winner meets The Rock for the WWE Championship at WrestleMania 29. Mr. McMahon returns for the first time since sustaining a broken hip to brawl with Paul Heyman. MizTV aims to address the controversy surrounding Jack Swagger.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 04, 2013
videos.overview: WWE goes Old School as several Legends return for a night marked by a tribute to Raw and monster WrestleMania implications. The iconic Undertaker returns, but who will challenge his incomparable streak at WrestleMania XXIX. Triple H lays down the gauntlet for Brock Lesnar. And WWE Champion The Rock renews his epic war of words with rival John Cena.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 11, 2013
videos.overview: The road to WrestleMania continues. WWE honors the memory of Paul Bearer, but the disrespect by a certain former WWE Champion sends the Brothers of Destruction into a fury. Chris Jericho brings back his infamous talk show The Highlight Reel. And WWE's resident powerhouses Ryback and Mark Henry continue their game of one-upmanship.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 18, 2013
videos.overview: The WrestleMania gauntlet has been thrown between Triple H and Brock Lesnar, but will The Game sign on the dotted line for the match without knowing what stipulation lies ahead? Intercontinental Champion Wade Barrett defends his title in a Triple Threat Match against Chris Jericho and The Miz. Plus, a special look at John Cena and the Rock.

videos.title: Raw - Mar. 25, 2013
videos.overview: With WrestleMania rapidly approaching, WWE Champion The Rock and challenger John Cena address some pointed questions from WWE Hall of Famers in a special Q and A segment. Triple H has a message for Brock Lesnar. CM Punk's disrepect for the Undertaker continues. And Chris Jericho gets his WrestleMania opponent.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 01, 2013
videos.overview: In the final Raw before WrestleMania, both The Rock and John Cena vow to walk out of Met Life Stadium with the WWE Championship around their waist. CM Punk strikes at the heart of the Undertaker six days before attempting to end the streak. Shawn Michaels returns to lend support to Triple H for his upcoming battle with Brock Lesnar.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 08, 2013
videos.overview: On the first night of John Cena's 11th WWE Championship reign, which new contender will emerge? Plus, The Shield has a new target and Dolph Ziggler shocks the WWE Universe and so much more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 15, 2013
videos.overview: WWE Champion John Cena responds to being blitz attacked by the montrous Ryback. What was the motivation for the attack? Also, what will CM Punk have to say in his first appearance since becoming Undertaker's latest WrestleMania victim? And both Alberto Del Rio and Jack Swagger seek the first shot at Dolph Ziggler's World Heavyweight Championship.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 22, 2013
videos.overview: Paul Heyman has a special message to Triple H from Brock Lesnar. Antonio Cesaro faces R-Truth. Chris Jericho goes one on one with Dolph Ziggler. Team Hell No and the Undertaker go up against The Shield in a special Six-Man Tag Team Match. Mick Foley, John Cena, and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Apr. 29, 2013
videos.overview: WWE Champion John Cena battles through injury to join Tag Team Champions Team Hell No in a Six-Man Tag Team Match against The Shield. Can the three champions stop the Hounds of Justice from extending their winning streak? Plus, Alberto Del Rio sets a stipulation for his upcoming match with Jack Swagger and World Heavyweight Champion Dolph Ziggler.

videos.title: Raw - May. 06, 2013
videos.overview: Triple H reacts to Brock Lesnar's shocking invasion of WWE headquarters. The 'Human Wrecking Ball' Ryback names the stipulation for his Extreme Rules showdown with hobbled WWE Champion John Cena. Mark Henry lays down a challenge for Sheamus.

videos.title: Raw - May. 13, 2013
videos.overview: John Cena and Team Hell No get another chance to hand The Shield their first defeat, but with Extreme Rules a week away, a beast is lurking in the shadows waiting to unleash a fury on the Champ. Triple H calls out Brock Lesnar for a Steel Cage preview. And Chris Jericho cuts a rug in an attempt to upstage rival Fandango.

videos.title: Raw - May. 20, 2013
videos.overview: In the aftermath of Extreme Rules brutality, Ryback emerges to lay down another sadistic challenge for WWE Champion John Cena. The Shield is in action for the first time with all three members showing off their newly-won championships. And after watching his client, Brock Lesnar, defeat Triple H, Paul Heyman unveils the next 'Paul Heyman guy'.

videos.title: Raw - May. 27, 2013
videos.overview: The rivalry between WWE Champion John Cena and Ryback intensifies. Cena goes one-on-one with Paul Heyman protégé Curtis Axel. Bret Hart is honored in his home town of Calgary. Kofi Kingston gets his rematch with The Shield's Dean Ambrose. Chris Jericho brings back the world famous Highlight Reel.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 03, 2013
videos.overview: Triple H seeks revenge against Curtis Axel but do Vince and Stephanie McMahon have other plans for The Game? The battle lines are drawn as Paul Heyman signs the contract for CM Punk to face Chris Jericho at Payback. Daniel Bryan faces Ryback. The Shield takes on Team Hell No & Randy Orton in a Six-Man Tag Team Match. Cody Rhodes battles Sheamus.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 10, 2013
videos.overview: WWE Champion John Cena and his challenger Ryback confront each other six days before their 3 Stages of Hell Match at WWE Payback. A McMahon family feud is brewing between WWE COO Triple H and his father-in-law, Mr McMahon. Dolph Ziggler returns, and Kaitlyn's secret admirer is finally revealed.

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 17, 2013
videos.overview: The three new champions crowned at WWE Payback begin their title reigns. A night after teaming together, Daniel Bryan and Randy Orton oppose each other one-on-one in a No Disqualification match. And is one Superstar's 17-year career coming to an end?

videos.title: Raw - Jun. 24, 2013
videos.overview: WWE Champion John Cena responds to Mark Henry's deceptive attack after his faux retirement speech the week before. CM Punk confronts Paul Heyman regarding his involvement in an ambush from Brock Lesnar. And still determined to prove he is not the 'weak link'. Daniel Bryan battles The Viper Randy Orton.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 01, 2013
videos.overview: It's a Money in the Bank melee as Daniel Bryan, Randy Orton, Sheamus and the rest of the ladder match contestants look to prove their worth on Raw before their pay-per-view showdown. One of the most dominant Superstars in WWE falls victim to a surprising upset. And champions clash as John Cena takes on Alberto Del Rio.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 08, 2013
videos.overview: Who will be the next Mr. Money in the Bank? Vickie Guerrero receives word on her job status from Mr. McMahon. The Wyatt Family arrives.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 15, 2013
videos.overview: In the aftermath of two pulse racing Money in the Bank Ladder Matches, what will Randy Orton and Damien Sandow do with their newly earned briefcases? How will CM Punk react to the shocking betrayal of his 'best friend' Paul Heyman? And for the first time in nearly six years, Rob Van Dam competes on Raw.

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 22, 2013
videos.overview: Raw kicks off with a contract signing for the WWE Championship match between John Cena and Daniel Bryan at SummerSlam. Sheamus goes one-on-one with Alberto Del Rio. Will Mark Henry be able to overcome the 3-on-1 odds when he issues a special challenge to The Shield? CM Punk plans to drop a verbal pipe bomb on Brock Lesnar. Will Paul Heyman respond?

videos.title: Raw - Jul. 29, 2013
videos.overview: WWE Champion John Cena battles Ryback in a McMahon-mandated Tables Match. Daniel Bryan tries to prove his 'ruthless aggression' when he tangles with his former tag team partner, Kane. And how will CM Punk attempt to further get under the skin of Paul Heyman?

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 05, 2013
videos.overview: With a dream matchup against John Cena coming up at SummerSlam, will Daniel Bryan conform to the standards of a main event Superstar? The Shield faces three top Superstars in a Six-man Tag Team Match. And CM Punk battles Intercontinental Champion, Curtis Axel.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 12, 2013
videos.overview: With SummerSlam just days away, tensions rise in the seemingly friendly rivalry between John Cena and Daniel Bryan. WWE COO Triple H makes a shocking announcement. And CM Punk springs a surprise for 'The Beast', Brock Lesnar.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 19, 2013
videos.overview: With shockwaves from SummerSlam reverberating throughout the WWE, how will Daniel Bryan and other Superstars react to the treacherous deed performed by WWE COO Triple H? New WWE Champion Randy Orton receives his coronation. And CM Punk still has plenty of fight left despite his narrow loss to Brock Lesnar.

videos.title: Raw - Aug. 26, 2013
videos.overview: The ongoing battle between Daniel Bryan and WWE COO Triple H continues when 'The Game' unleashes The Shield to do his dirty work. WWE Champion Randy Orton renews an old rivalry with Christian. Plus, the WWE Universe plays a pivotal role in CM Punk's attempt to get his hands on Paul Heyman.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 02, 2013
videos.overview: Daniel Bryan continues to fight the iron fist that is the leadership of WWE COO Triple H. What further degradation will 'The Game' contrive for Bryan and Big Show? Cody Rhodes finds his career in jeopardy when he too crosses the boss. Plus, CM Punk responds to Paul Heyman's disturbing attack.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 09, 2013
videos.overview: As Night of Champions approaches, it's a night of homecomings in Toronto. Hometown hero Edge shows up to lend support to Daniel Bryan. A member of the Rhodes family attempts to win back Cody's job by defeating WWE Champion Randy Orton. Plus, will Paul Heyman weasel out of his confrontation with CM Punk at Sunday's pay-per-view event?

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 16, 2013
videos.overview: The WWE Universe welcomes its new champion, Daniel Bryan! But how long will he bask in the glow of his victory at Night of Champions? The McMahons bring out the best and the worst side of 'The Apex Predator', Randy Orton. Another member of the Rhodes family attempts to save Cody's job, and Ryback explains his actions from Night of Champions.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 23, 2013
videos.overview: WWE COO Triple H and Stephanie McMahon hold a Town Hall Meeting with the Superstars who came to Daniel Bryan's aid and schedule an enormous 11-on-3 Handicap Match. CM Punk is welcomed with open arms for the first time since his controversial defeat at Night of Champions. The WWE Universe chooses Randy Orton's opponent via the WWE APP and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Sep. 30, 2013
videos.overview: After a special invitation from Stephanie McMahon, Dusty Rhodes meets WWE COO Triple H and Stephanie McMahon in the ring to listen to their very personal proposal. CM Punk addresses his concerns with Paul Heyman and Ryback, Daniel Bryan meets Randy Orton face-to-face, Big Show's problems with The Authority continue, and Los Matadores debut.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 07, 2013
videos.overview: What is the aftermath of Battleground? Big Show faces the music from one of the principal owners of WWE, Stephanie McMahon, for his involvement in the previous night's main event. Ryback calls out CM Punk. Plus, The Rhodes family is back and a shocking announcement is made regarding the World Heavyweight Championship.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 14, 2013
videos.overview: After being voted for by the WWE Universe as the special guest referee for the WWE Championship Match at Hell in a Cell, Shawn Michaels returns to Raw to address Daniel Bryan and Randy Orton. Cody Rhodes & Goldust compete against Seth Rollins & Roman Reigns in a No Disqualification match for the WWE Tag Team Championship and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 21, 2013
videos.overview: With nothing left to lose, Big Show continues his onslaught against The Authority. Guest referee Shawn Michaels looks on as Daniel Bryan and Randy Orton make their Hell in a Cell match official for Hell in a Cell. Plus CM Punk gets an unlikely aid in his vendetta against Paul Heyman and more.

videos.title: Raw - Oct. 28, 2013
videos.overview: WWE coronates its new WWE Champion Randy Orton and new World Heavyweight Champion John Cena, but what surprises are in store for the new champs? Shawn Michaels addresses Daniel Bryan and his shocking actions at 'Hell in a Cell'. And after finally getting his hands on Paul Heyman, CM Punk looks to decimate Heyman's montrous protege, Ryback.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 04, 2013
videos.overview: Big Show returns to WWE, but suffers The Authority's wrath. After being pummeled by the Wyatt Family last week, CM Punk seeks out a fair fight when he takes on Luke Harper. WWE Champion Randy Orton faces Big E Langston. And Tyson Kidd returns from injury to team with his new wife, Natalya.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 11, 2013
videos.overview: With Triple H and Stephanie McMahon on vacation, will Kane take control as the newly appointed Director of Operations, or will Raw turn to anarchy? WWE Champion Randy Orton must face a member of the WWE Tag Team Champions The Rhodes Brothers. John Cena faces Zeb Colter's Real Americans. And CM Punk teams with Daniel Bryan to take on The Shield.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 18, 2013
videos.overview: WWE presents Raw Country, featuring a very special musical performance by Florida Georgia Line. A huge 12-Man Tag Team main event pits CM Punk, Daniel Bryan, The Usos, and Goldust & Cody Rhodes taking on The Wyatt Family and The Shield. Curtis Axel defends the Intercontinental Championship against Big E Langston and more.

videos.title: Raw - Nov. 25, 2013
videos.overview: Special guest Michael Strahan hosts Raw. CM Punk and Daniel Bryan face The Wyatt Family. The Shield sees Six-Man Tag action and much more.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 02, 2013
videos.overview: CM Punk confronts The Authority. Dolph Ziggler goes-one-on one with Damien Sandow. Daniel Bryan takes on Erick Rowan of The Wyatt Family. The Shield faces off against Big Show and The Rhodes Brothers in a Six-Man Tag Team Match. World Heavyweight Champion John Cena and WWE Champion Randy Orton sign the contract for their title unification match.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 09, 2013
videos.overview: Superstars & Divas celebrate those who thrilled, shocked, and amazed in 2013 with the annual WWE Slammy Awards. Legendary Superstars Bret Hart, the New Age Outlaws, Shawn Michaels, and more return to WWE to celebrate this historic evening.

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 16, 2013
videos.overview: WWE World Heavyweight Champion Randy Orton addresses the WWE Universe and John Cena. The fans decide the opponents for Cody Rhodes & Goldust. Mark Henry & Big E Langston face The Real Americans in tag team action. CM Punk addresses the WWE Universe. What message will a certain WWE Hall of Famer have for Punk?

videos.title: Raw - Dec. 23, 2013
videos.overview: A very special Raw Christmas episode sees the constant struggle between good and evil when Good Santa, Mark Henry, tries to thwart the actions of Bad Santa, Damien Sandow. The Wyatt Family takes on The Rhodes Brothers and Daniel Bryan in a Six-Man Tag Team Match. The Shield face John Cena, CM Punk, and Big E Langston in the main event.

videos.title: Raw - Dec 30, 2013
videos.overview: CM Punk issues a challenge to The Shield, but which member will step up? Will Daniel Bryan be able to overcome the odds of the authority?

videos.title: January 4, 2016 (San Antonio, TX)
videos.overview: Roman Reigns beat the odds by defending WWE World Heavyweight Championship against Sheamus with Mr. McMahon as the guest referee, but his next title bout will truly be one versus all.

videos.title: January 11, 2016 (New Orleans, LA)
videos.overview: From Brock Lesnar's return to Kalisto's soaring U.S. Title victory, see what went down on the Raw that changed the Royal Rumble picture.

videos.title: January 18, 2016 (Columbus, OH)
videos.overview: The road to the Royal Rumble winded down when Chris Jericho brought Brock Lesnar and Roman Reigns to "The Highlight Reel" on an all-new Monday Night Raw.

videos.title: January 25, 2016 (Miami, FL)
videos.overview: The Road to WrestleMania began on Raw as Triple H set the parameters for his WrestleMania title defense, and The Rock got a dose of The Power of Positivity when The New Day interrupted his homecoming.

videos.title: February 1, 2016 (Birmingham, AL)
videos.overview: What happened when Brock Lesnar, Roman Reigns and Dean Ambrose were all under the same roof ahead of their WWE Fastlane showdown?

videos.title: February 8, 2016 (Seattle, WA)
videos.overview: During Raw’s emotional conclusion, Daniel Bryan spoke out about his retirement, reflected on his groundbreaking career and thanked the “Yes!” Movement for their unending support over the years. Find out what the four-time World Champion revealed, and what went down after Raw.

videos.title: February 15, 2016 (Anaheim, CA)
videos.overview: As The Wyatt Family attempted to dominate Big Show after Raw’s main event, Ryback and Demon Kane entered the fray to even the odds against the swamp monsters. Have The Eater of Worlds and his sinister flock met their match?

videos.title: February 22, 2016 (Detroit, MI)
videos.overview: In one of the most jaw-dropping moments in sports-entertainment history, Shane McMahon returned to WWE after six years away from the company to interrupt his sister Stephanie’s acceptance of the Vincent J. McMahon Legacy of Excellence Award, confront his father and demand control of Monday Night Raw! But to get it, he'll have to defeat The Undertaker inside Hell in a Cell at WrestleMania!

videos.title: February 29, 2016 (Nashville, TN)
videos.overview: Mr. McMahon might have considered The Undertaker to be his own personal "force of nature" against his son Shane at WrestleMania, but The Deadman follows no man … not even The Chairman. Get all the details on The Phenom’s unsettling message to the McMahon family, and how Mr. McMahon changed the landscape of The Show of Shows’ high-stakes Hell in a Cell Match.

videos.title: March 7, 2016 (Rosemont, IL)
videos.overview: As Shane McMahon responded to his father planning to “disown” him after WrestleMania, The Undertaker emerged to deliver a stern message to WWE’s prodigal son … or did he? Find out about the cruel joke Mr. McMahon masterminded to psyche out his son, and what The Boy Wonder did to The Chairman's security when they attempted to remove him from the building.

videos.title: March 14, 2016 (Pittsburgh, PA)
videos.overview: Triple H escaped with the WWE World Heavyweight Championship, but as he walks into Pittsburgh with the ultimate prize, what message will he have for his WrestleMania opponent Roman Reigns? And how will Dean Ambrose respond to coming up short at WWE Roadblock?

videos.title: March 21, 2016 (Philadelphia, PA)
videos.overview: To ensure that The Undertaker defeats Shane McMahon inside Hell in a Cell at WrestleMania, Mr. McMahon decreed on Raw that if The Deadman is unsuccessful against WWE's prodigal son, this will be his last appearance on The Grandest Stage of Them All! Also on Raw, Dean Ambrose went berserk against The Wyatt Family and Roman Reigns gave WWE World Heavyweight Champion Triple H some serious car trouble.

videos.title: March 28, 2016 (Brooklyn, NY)
videos.overview: WWE World Heavyweight Champion Triple H talked a big game on the final Raw before WrestleMania, but Roman Reigns was ready for a fight, sparking a brawl with his Show of Shows opponent that required nearly the entire roster to restore the peace. Does The Big Dog have The Cerebral Assassin running scared before they square off on The Grandest Stage of Them All? Also on Raw, Shane McMahon performed an awe-inspiring feat that grounded The Undertaker ... but not for long.

videos.title: April 4, 2016 (Dallas, TX)
videos.overview: Shane McMahon was given the keys to Raw for a night and did not disappoint, creating a thrilling Fatal 4-Way main event between AJ Styles, Chris Jericho, Kevin Owens and the returning Cesaro to determine the No. 1 contender to WWE World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns.

videos.title: April 11, 2016 (Los Angeles, CA)
videos.overview: Per Shane McMahon, who ran Raw for the second straight week thanks to the WWE Universe’s support on social media, WWE World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns teamed up with longtime nemesis Bray Wyatt to battle Sheamus & Alberto Del Rio in a never-before-seen main event. Could The Big Dog and The Eater of Worlds coexist? Also on Raw, Natalya vied for Charlotte’s WWE Women’s Title, AJ Styles clashed with Sami Zayn and a No. 1 Contenders’ Tag Team Tournament began!

videos.title: April 18, 2016 (London, England)
videos.overview: In a hard-hitting Raw main event made by temporary Raw showrunner Shane McMahon, Dean Ambrose and Kevin Owens brought each other to the brink, but it was Chris Jericho who would have reason to celebrate as WWE’s flagship show went off the air. Find out how “The Best in the World at What He Does” got the better of The Lunatic Fringe, less than two weeks before their clash at WWE Payback. Plus, learn who advanced in the Semifinal Matches of the No. 1 Contenders’ Tag Team Tournament, sponsored by Booty-O’s.

videos.title: April 25, 2016 (Hartford, CT)
videos.overview: In the aftermath of Raw’s main event bout pitting WWE World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns against Alberto Del Rio, Luke Gallows & Karl Anderson played the numbers game against The Big Dog — a game that became more difficult for Reigns when AJ Styles hit the ring. Will The Phenomenal One ensnare sports-entertainment’s grandest prize at WWE Payback, with his longtime friends at his back?

videos.title: May 2, 2016 (Saint Louis, MO)
videos.overview: After AJ Styles, Luke Gallows and Karl Anderson defeated WWE World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns & The Usos in Raw’s main event, an intense chair-swinging melee culminated with The Big Dog tossing The Phenomenal One through the announce table. Will Styles suffer a similar fate in less than three weeks at Extreme Rules?

videos.title: May 9, 2016 (Omaha, NE)
videos.overview: One week after Chris Jericho sadistically smashed Dean Ambrose’s prized plant over his head, The Lunatic Fringe got his share of retribution when he utterly destroyed Jericho’s iconic $15,000 light-up jacket. Plus, find out what happened during the tense steel chair standoff between WWE World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns and his Extreme Rules opponent, AJ Styles.

videos.title: May 16, 2016 (Greensboro, NC)
videos.overview: After The Usos defeated Luke Gallows and Karl Anderson in tag team action, WWE World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns and AJ Styles entered the fray, but The Phenomenal One stood triumphantly after laying out The Big Dog with a steel chair.
