videos.overview: Raw is on The Road to WrestleMania. Royal Rumble fallout includes new challengers and familiar foes. The Miz welcomes multi-platinum recording artist Bad Bunny to "Miz TV." Bobby Lashley defends his United States Title against Riddle. The Lucha House Party challenge Cedric Alexander & Shelton Benjamin for the Raw Tag Team Titles.

videos.title: February 8, 2021
videos.overview: Drew McIntyre rekindles his rivalry with Randy Orton in a non-title match and addresses Sheamus' betrayal. After weeks of Lacey Evans and Ric Flair tormenting Charlotte Flair, The Queen and The Sassy Southern Belle come face-to-face.

videos.title: February 15, 2021
videos.overview: A Gauntlet Match determines the final entrant in the WWE Championship Elimination Chamber Match, and a new challenger emerges for the career-altering contest. WWE Champion Drew McIntyre joins "Miz TV." Charlotte Flair & Asuka's match against Lacey Evans & Peyton Royce leads to a shocking announcement.

videos.title: February 22, 2021
videos.overview: After cashing in his Money in the Bank Contract and becoming WWE Champion at WWE Elimination Chamber, The Miz presents a special Championship celebration episode of "Miz TV." New United States Champion Riddle faces John Morrison in a non-title match. Sheamus goes head-to-head with Jeff Hardy.

videos.title: March 1, 2021
videos.overview: The Miz defends the WWE Championship against Bobby Lashley. Drew McIntyre returns to Raw for the first time since losing the WWE Title.

videos.title: March 8, 2021
videos.overview: The Miz attempts to win back the WWE Championship when he challenges Bobby Lashley for the title. Braun Strowman demands an apology from Shane McMahon after being disrespected by Shane-O-Mac. WWE Women's Tag Team Champions Nia Jax & Shayna Baszler defend their titles against Naomi & Lana.

videos.title: March 15, 2021
videos.overview: WWE Champion Bobby Lashley's All Mighty Era begins. Riddle battles Mustafa Ali for the United States Championship. The Hurt Business defend the Raw Tag Team Championship against The New Day. Asuka returns to the ring seeking payback against Shayna Baszler.

videos.title: March 22, 2021
videos.overview: Randy Orton summons The Fiend after his adversary's horrifying return at WWE Fastlane. A new challenger emerges for Raw Women's Champion Asuka. WWE Champion Bobby Lashley collides with Sheamus in a non-title match. Kofi Kingston goes one-on-one with AJ Styles. Jeff Hardy battles The Miz.

videos.title: March 29, 2021
videos.overview: WWE Champion Bobby Lashley offers a title opportunity at WrestleMania to anyone who can take down Drew McIntyre before The Show of Shows. Raw Women's Champion Asuka and Rhea Ripley make their WrestleMania showdown official with a contract signing. United States Champion Riddle looks for payback against Sheamus in a non-title match.

videos.title: April 5, 2021
videos.overview: Drew McIntyre battles King Corbin, and Bobby Lashley takes on Cedric Alexander just days ahead of their WWE Title Match at WrestleMania.

videos.title: April 12, 2021
videos.overview: After an epic two-night WrestleMania, the most unpredictable Raw of the year brings Superstar returns and surprises. Multiple challengers come forward for Bobby Lashley's WWE Championship. New Raw Women's Champion Rhea Ripley faces Asuka in a WrestleMania rematch.

videos.title: April 19, 2021
videos.overview: Asuka looks for payback against Charlotte Flair. Drew McIntyre demands answers from MVP after being attacked by MACE & T-BAR. The Miz & Maryse host a Miz & Mrs. celebration on "Miz TV."

videos.title: April 26, 2021
videos.overview: WWE Champion Bobby Lashley returns. Drew McIntyre & Braun Strowman take on MACE & T-BAR. Sonya Deville uses her power to make a surprising decision. Asuka, Naomi & Lana battle Rhea Ripley, Nia Jax & Shayna Baszler. Damian Priest joins forces with The New Day against The Miz, Elias & Jaxson Ryker.

videos.title: May 3, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1458

WWE Champion Bobby Lashley collides with Braun Strowman. Raw Tag Team Champions AJ Styles & Omos defend their titles against New Day. Nia Jax & Shayna Baszler put the WWE Women’s Tag Team Titles on the line against Lana & Naomi.

videos.title: May 10, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1459

WWE Champion Bobby Lashley battles Drew McIntyre in a WrestleMania rematch. Former WWE Champion Jinder Mahal makes his return to Raw. The New Day & R-K-Bro join forces to take on AJ Styles, Omos, Jaxson Ryder & Elias. Asuka, Mandy Rose & Dana Brooke face Charlotte Flair, Shayna Baszler & Nia Jax.

videos.title: May 17, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1460

WWE Champion Bobby Lashley issues an open challenge to anyone other than Drew McIntyre and Braun Strowman. New WWE Women's Tag Team Champions Natalya & Tamina venture into Alexa’s Playground before defending their titles against Shayna Baszler & Nia Jax. Asuka takes on Charlotte Flair. Damian Priest battles John Morrison in a Lumberjack Match.

videos.title: May 24, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1461

WWE Women's Tag Team Champions Natalya & Tamina defend their titles against Shayna Baszler & Nia Jax. Kofi Kingston and Drew McIntyre clash to determine the next challenger to WWE Champion Bobby Lashley. Xavier Woods and Riddle settle their differences in a head-to-head battle.

videos.title: May 31, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1462

Drew McIntyre and Kofi Kingston battle in a rematch to determine the challenger to WWE Champion Bobby Lashley. AJ Styles & Omos take on Elias & Jaxson Ryker in a Raw Tag Team Title Match. Raw Women’s Champion Rhea Ripley and her WWE Hell in a Cell opponent Charlotte Flair join “Miz TV.” Reginald faces Shayna Baszler.

videos.title: June 7, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1463

Bobby Lashley and Drew McIntyre sign their WWE Championship Match contract ahead of WWE Hell in a Cell. Shayna Baszler stops by "Alexa's Playground." A Tag Team Battle Royal determines the next challengers to AJ Styles & Omos’ Raw Tag Team Titles.

videos.title: June 14, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1464

Drew McIntyre takes on AJ Styles with WWE Hell in a Cell on the horizon. Eva Marie makes her highly-anticipated return to Raw. RK-Bro and The New Day settle their differences in tag team action.

videos.title: June 21, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1465

The Hell in a Cell Match returns to Raw for the first time in over 20 years as WWE Champion Bobby Lashley steps inside the unforgiving steel structure for the second night in a row. The road to WWE Money in the Bank begins as Raw Superstars battle in Money in the Bank Qualifying Matches.

videos.title: June 28, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1466

A Last Chance Money in the Bank Qualifying Match gets a last-minute change. Kofi Kingston comes face-to-face with MVP after Bobby Lashley's vicious attack on Xavier Woods. Rhea Ripley, Mandy Rose & Dana Brooke battle Charlotte Flair, Natalya & Tamina in a Six-Woman Tag Team Match. Jaxson Ryker takes on Elias in a Strap Match.

videos.title: July 5, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1467

The New Day battle Bobby Lashley & MVP in tag team action. The Miz hosts a special Money in the Bank edition of "Miz TV." Charlotte Flair provides a medical update after being attacked by Rhea Ripley. Ricochet and John Morrison clash in a Raw rematch.

videos.title: July 12, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1468

Xavier Woods goes head-to-head with Bobby Lashley. MVP throws the WWE Champion a celebration on The VIP Lounge. Ricochet and John Morrison collide in a Falls Count Anywhere Match. Alexa Bliss, Asuka, Naomi and Nikki A.S.H. battle in a Fatal 4-Way Match. United States Champion Sheamus clashes with Humberto Carrillo.

videos.title: July 19, 2021
videos.overview: John Cena returns to Raw after his surprise appearance at WWE Money in the Bank. Keith Lee answers WWE Champion Bobby Lashley's open challenge. WWE Hall of Famer Goldberg arrives with a challenge of his own. Nikki A.S.H. cashes in her Money in the Bank contract.

videos.title: July 26, 2021
videos.overview: Nikki A.S.H.'s Raw Women's Title reign gets off to a rocky start thanks to Charlotte Flair. WWE Champion Bobby Lashley lets his actions do the talking in response to Goldberg. Raw Tag Team Champions AJ Styles & Omos defend their titles against The Viking Raiders.

videos.title: August 2, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1471

Raw Women's Champion Nikki A.S.H. battles Charlotte Flair in a No Holds Barred Match. Goldberg confronts WWE Champion Bobby Lashley. Riddle collides with the colossal Omos.

videos.title: August 9, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1472

Randy Orton returns to Raw, much to the delight of his RK-Bro partner Riddle. WWE Champion Bobby Lashley addresses his upcoming title showdown against Goldberg. Raw Women's Champion Nikki A.S.H. battles Rhea Ripley to build momentum for SummerSlam, but Charlotte Flair has other plans. NXT Champion Karrion Kross gets a rematch against Jeff Hardy.

videos.title: August 16, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1473

Goldberg sends a message to WWE Champion Bobby Lashley ahead of their title showdown. Raw Women's Champion Nikki A.S.H. attempts to fend off Rhea Ripley and Charlotte Flair. Drew McIntyre faces Veer & Shanky in a Handicap Match with SummerSlam implications. Riddle earns Randy Orton's respect.

videos.title: August 23, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1474

WWE Champion Bobby Lashley and MVP address their actions at SummerSlam. Randy Orton & Riddle's RK-Bro Championship Celebration is interrupted by AJ Styles & Omos. The Miz & John Morrison's partnership implodes after Logan Paul's appearance on "Moist TV." Rhea Ripley & Nikki A.S.H. square off against Nia Jax & Shayna Baszler.

videos.title: August 30, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1475

RK-Bro put their Raw Tag Team Titles on the line against WWE Champion Bobby Lashley & MVP. Damian Priest's United States Title Open Championship Challenge produces not one, but two challengers. Nia Jax makes an impactful statement against Charlotte Flair. The Miz runs from John Morrison.

videos.title: September 6, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1476

A tag team turmoil match takes place to determine the number one contenders to RK-Bro's Tag Team Championship. Charlotte and Nia Jax have a rematch after Nia got the best of Charlotte last week. The unusual duo of Rhea Ripley and Nikki A.S.H take on the Women's Tag Champions Natalya and Tamina in a non-title match.

videos.title: September 13, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1477

Big E promises to cash in his Money in the Bank briefcase. Shayna Baszler looks to prove herself against the Women's Champion Charlotte. After their tag bout last week, Nikki A.S.H takes on Tamina and Rhea Ripley takes on Natalya in singles competition. Doudrop continues to fight back against Eva Marie's abuse.

videos.title: September 20, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1478

Head of the Table Roman Reigns with the rest of The Bloodline make an appearance on Monday Night Raw. The New Day celebrate newly-crowned WWE Champion Big E. Doudrop continues to exact her revenge on Eva Marie. Randy Orton and AJ Styles put on another masterclass in wrestling. After earning their title match two weeks ago, Nikki A.S.H and Rhea Ripley compete for the Women's Tag Championship. Charlotte participates in Alexa's Playground.

videos.title: September 27, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1479

Chaos surrounding Big E and Bobby Lashley's WWE Championship Match moves their massive showdown inside a steel cage. Goldberg delivers a menacing message. Damian Priest defends the United States Championship against Sheamus in an extreme battle. Doudrop answers Charlotte Flair's Raw Women's Championship Open Challenge.

videos.title: October 4, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1480

Raw and SmackDown make their selections on Night Two of the 2021 WWE Draft. Becky Lynch returns to Raw, instigating a huge main event showdown between Charlotte Flair and Bianca Belair. WWE Hall of Famer Goldberg comes looking for Bobby Lashley.

videos.title: October 11, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1481

WWE Champion Big E and his WWE Crown Jewel challenger Drew McIntyre attempt to join forces. Raw Women’s Champion Charlotte Flair & SmackDown Women’s Champion Becky Lynch battle Bianca Belair & Sasha Banks. The 2021 King of the Ring and Queen's Crown Tournaments continue.

videos.title: October 18, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1482

Charlotte Flair defends the Raw Women's Championship against Bianca Belair. The King of the Ring and Queen's Crown Tournaments continue with semifinal showdowns. WWE Champion Big E unites with his WWE Crown Jewel challenger Drew McIntyre to take on The Dirty Dawgs. Raw Tag Team Champions RK-Bro battle The Street Profits.

videos.title: October 25, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1483

A new era of Raw begins with multiple Superstars vying for the chance to challenge WWE Champion Big E. Queen Zelina revels in her coronation as the first-ever Queen’s Crown Tournament Champion. Bianca Belair delivers a painful statement to Raw Women's Champion Becky Lynch. RK-Bro defend the Raw Tag Team Championship.

videos.title: November 1, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1484

Becky Lynch defends the Raw Women's Championship against Bianca Belair. Big E collides with Kevin Owens for the first time ever. United States Champion Damian Priest takes on T-BAR in a No Disqualification Match. Rey Mysterio faces Austin Theory.

videos.title: November 8, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1485

Kevin Owens collides with Seth Rollins. Several Superstars protest Raw’s Survivor Series team selections. Bianca Belair, Rhea Ripley, Liv Morgan, Carmella and Queen Zelina vie for an opportunity to challenge for Becky Lynch’s Raw Women’s Championship.

videos.title: November 15, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1486

Several Superstars insert themselves into the middle of WWE Champion Big E's conflict with Kevin Owens. Raw Women's Champion Becky Lynch responds to SmackDown Women's Champion Charlotte Flair. Rey Mysterio battles Bobby Lashley.

videos.title: November 22, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1487

The search is on for the person that stole Mr. McMahon's precious Cleopatra’s Egg. Following an explosive Survivor Series event, Raw's champions focus their attention back on their challengers. Rey Mysterio and his son Dominik look for payback against Bobby Lashley in a 2-on-1 Handicap Match.

videos.title: November 29, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1488

WWE Champion Big E battles Kevin Owens. Edge makes his return to Raw. Becky Lynch and Liv Morgan sign their Raw Women's Title Match contract. Finn Bálor looks for payback against Seth Rollins. Raw Tag Team Champions RK-Bro take on The Dirty Dawgs.

videos.title: December 6, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1489

Raw Women's Champion Becky Lynch defends her title against Liv Morgan. WWE Champion Big E collides with Kevin Owens inside a steel cage. The Miz hosts Edge on "Miz TV." The RK-Bro-nament to determine the next challengers to RK-Bro’s Raw Tag Team Title begins.

videos.title: December 13, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1490

Bobby Lashley looks to turn his recent domination into a WWE Championship opportunity. Raw Women's Champion Becky Lynch's heated rivalry with Liv Morgan escalates. Edge and The Miz mix it up ahead of their match at Day 1.

videos.title: December 20, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1491

Big E, Bobby Lashley, Kevin Owens and Seth Rollins continue their conflict ahead of Day 1. Edge hosts The Miz and Maryse on "The Cutting Edge," while The A-Lister hosts AJ Styles & Omos on "Miz TV." Finn Bálor battles Austin Theory. Damian Priest takes on Dolph Ziggler in a Championship Contender’s Match.

videos.title: December 27, 2021
videos.overview:
RAW #1492

The Miz and Maryse renew their wedding vows with the help of a special surprise officiant. Dolph Ziggler challenges Damian Priest for the United States Championship. The Street Profits face Rey & Dominick Mysterio in the RK-Bro-nament Finals.

videos.title: January 3, 2022
videos.overview: New WWE Champion Brock Lesnar addresses his Day 1 triumph. Big E, Seth Rollins, Kevin Owens and Bobby Lashley collide for a WWE Title opportunity. Damian Priest defends the United States Championship against Dolph Ziggler. AJ Styles clashes with former tag team partner Omos.

videos.title: January 10, 2022
videos.overview: Bianca Belair, Liv Morgan and Doudrop battle in a Triple Threat Match to determine the next challenger to Raw Women's Champion Becky Lynch. RK-Bro defend the Raw Tag Team Championship against Alpha Academy. WWE Champion Brock Lesnar comes face-to-face with his Royal Rumble challenger Bobby Lashley.

videos.title: January 17, 2022
videos.overview: Bobby Lashley battles Seth "Freakin" Rollins. Raw Women's Champion Becky Lynch joins forces with her Royal Rumble challenger Doudrop to take on Liv Morgan & Bianca Belair. The Alpha Academy kick off their Raw Tag Team Championship reign with a graduation ceremony.

videos.title: January 24, 2022
videos.overview: WWE Champion Brock Lesnar and his challenger Bobby Lashley meet inside the ring for a Royal Rumble weigh-in. The Miz throws a birthday extravaganza for Maryse. Raw Tag Team Champions Alpha Academy and RK-Bro do battle in an Academic Challenge.

videos.title: January 31, 2022
videos.overview: Raw's Road to WrestleMania begins. Royal Rumble Match winner Ronda Rousey returns to the red brand for the first time in nearly three years. Royal Rumble Match winner Brock Lesnar chooses his WrestleMania 38 opponent. New WWE Champion Bobby Lashley once again ushers in The All Mighty Era.

videos.title: February 7, 2022
videos.overview: Riddle battles Seth "Freakin" Rollins. RK-Bro face Alpha Academy in a Quiz Bowl in the final round of their Academic Challenge. WWE Hall of Famer Lita makes a statement ahead of her Raw Women's Championship clash against Becky Lynch.

videos.title: February 14, 2022
videos.overview: Becky Lynch and Lita sign their Raw Women's Title Match contract. Brock Lesnar addresses the WWE Universe ahead of WWE Elimination Chamber. Women's Elimination Chamber Match participants compete in a high-stakes Gauntlet Match. Riddle throws an RK-Broga Party. AJ Styles collides with Damian Priest for the United States Title.

videos.title: February 21, 2022
videos.overview: New WWE Champion Brock Lesnar's celebration gets cut short. The Miz brings a global megastar into his rivalry with Rey & Dominick Mysterio. Seth "Freakin" Rollins & Kevin Owens face RK-Bro in a high-stakes showdown.

videos.title: February 28, 2022
videos.overview: WWE Hall of Famer Edge looks for a Superstar to answer his open challenge at WrestleMania. Damian Priest battles Finn Bálor for the United States Championship. Bianca Belair, Rhea Ripley & Liv Morgan join forces to take on Raw Women's Champion Becky Lynch, Doudrop & Nikki A.S.H.

videos.title: March 7, 2022
videos.overview: Alpha Academy defend the Raw Tag Team Championship in a Triple Threat Match against RK-Bro and Kevin Owens & Seth Rollins. Owens extends a WrestleMania invite to a WWE Hall of Famer. Logan Paul returns to throw a homecoming celebration with The Miz. Edge explains his vicious attack on AJ Styles.

videos.title: March 14, 2022 (Jacksonville, FL)
videos.overview: WWE remembers WWE Hall of Famer Scott Hall. Kevin Owens responds to “Stone Cold” Steve Austin accepting his invitation for WrestleMania and RK-Bro throws a Championship Celebration.

videos.title: March 21, 2022 (Rosemont, IL)
videos.overview: Becky Lynch addresses her brutal attack on Bianca Belair, while RK-Bro takes on Alpha Academy, and Finn Bálor looks for retribution on Austin Theory. Plus, AJ Styles returns to Raw.

videos.title: March 28, 2022
videos.overview: WWE Champion Brock Lesnar and Universal Champion Roman Reigns make their final statements ahead of The Biggest WrestleMania Match of All Time. Raw and SmackDown Tag Team Champions collide as RK-Bro face The Usos. The four tag teams set to battle for the Women's Tag Team Championship at WrestleMania clash in a huge Eight-Woman Tag Team Match.

videos.title: April 4, 2022
videos.overview: A new Undisputed WWE Universal Champion, Cody Rhodes' return to Monday nights and Veer's highly-anticipated arrival to the red brand highlights the Raw after WrestleMania.

videos.title: April 11, 2022
videos.overview: Cody Rhodes battles The Miz in his first match on Raw in six years. AJ Styles looks for payback when he clashes with Damian Priest. RK-Bro face Alpha Academy. Omos & MVP address their attack on Bobby Lashley on "The VIP Lounge."

videos.title: April 18, 2022
videos.overview: Theory challenges Finn Bálor for the United States Championship. WWE Women's Tag Team Champions Sasha Banks & Naomi battle Rhea Ripley & Liv Morgan. R-Truth officiates a Double Commitment Ceremony between Dana Brooke & Reggie and Tamina & Akira Tozawa.

videos.title: April 25, 2022
videos.overview: WWE celebrates the 20th anniversary of Randy Orton's debut. Bianca Belair defends the Raw Women's Championship against Sonya Deville. Becky Lynch returns for the first time since WrestleMania and is met by another returning Superstar. Bobby Lashley and Omos lock up in a mammoth arm-wrestling contest.

videos.title: May 2, 2022
videos.overview: The Bloodline come to Raw with WrestleMania Backlash less than a week away. Bianca Belair, Liv Morgan & Asuka battle Becky Lynch, Rhea Ripley & Sonya Deville in a Six-Woman Tag Team Match. AJ Styles faces Damian Priest in a high-stakes showdown. Seth "Freakin" Rollins hosts his own appreciation night.

videos.title: May 9, 2022
videos.overview: Asuka faces Raw Women's Champion Bianca Belair in a Championship Contender's Match. Cody Rhodes challenges Theory for the United States Championship. The Judgment Day welcome their newest member.

videos.title: May 16, 2022
videos.overview: Bobby Lashley collides with Omos in a massive Steel Cage Match. A new challenger earns herself a match against Raw Women's Champion Bianca Belair at WWE Hell in a Cell. Lacey Evans addresses the WWE Universe.

videos.title: May 23, 2022
videos.overview: Becky Lynch addresses her loss to Asuka. Bobby Lashley issues an All Mighty challenge for Omos & MVP. Cody Rhodes battles The Miz. Veer Mahaan joins a special edition of Jerry "The King" Lawler's "King's Court."

videos.title: May 30, 2022
videos.overview: Bianca Belair faces Asuka. Cody Rhodes addresses Seth "Freakin" Rollins. Riddle & Shinsuke Nakamura battle The Usos in a Championship Contenders Match. Bobby Lashley, Omos and MVP sign the contract for their Handicap Match at WWE Hell in a Cell.

videos.title: June 6, 2022
videos.overview: Alexa Bliss, Liv Morgan, Doudrop and Rhea Ripley battle in a high-stakes Fatal 4-Way Match. Cody Rhodes addresses the WWE Universe after his valiant win at WWE Hell in a Cell. The Judgment Day welcome a new member. The Miz and Maryse take to the ring for the premiere episode of “Miz TV.”

videos.title: June 13, 2022
videos.overview: Bobby Lashley faces off with Theory in the Inaugural Theory Invitational Pose-Down. Seth "Freakin" Rollins responds to his attack on Cody Rhodes. Qualifying Matches continue for the Men's and Women's Money in the Bank Ladder Matches.

videos.title: June 20, 2022
videos.overview: Elias returns to Raw to perform one more concert with his brother, Ezekiel. Becky Lynch battles Asuka in a Women's Money in the Bank Qualifying Match. Riddle faces Omos in a Men's Money in the Bank Qualifying Match.

videos.title: June 27, 2022
videos.overview: John Cena returns to Raw to celebrate his 20-year anniversary with WWE. Superstars compete in a Last Chance Battle Royal for a spot in the Men's Money in the Bank Ladder Match. Six women battle it out to qualify for the Women's Money in the Bank Ladder Match.

videos.title: July 4, 2022
videos.overview: Asuka and Becky Lynch battle in a No Holds Barred Match. New SmackDown Women's Champion Liv Morgan comes to Raw. The Miz responds to Logan Paul's SummerSlam challenge. The Mysterios take on The Judgment Day. Bobby Lashley & The Street Profits face Theory & Alpha Academy.

videos.title: July 11, 2022
videos.overview: Brock Lesnar returns to Raw for the first time since WrestleMania 38. Carmella challenges Bianca Belair for the Raw Women's Championship. Rey Mysterio goes one-on-one with Finn Bálor.

videos.title: July 18, 2022
videos.overview: Logan Paul comes to Raw looking for The Miz. Carmella challenges Bianca Belair for the Raw Women's Championship. Kevin Owens welcomes Riddle to “The KO Show.”

videos.title: July 25, 2022
videos.overview: Rey Mysterio celebrates 20 years with WWE. Undisputed WWE Universal Champion Roman Reigns comes to Raw as The Bloodline clash with Riddle & The Street Profits in a huge Six-Man Tag Team Match. Logan Paul hosts “Impaulsive TV.”

videos.title: August 1, 2022
videos.overview: The Raw after SummerSlam brings multiple returns and new title opportunities. The Mysterios challenge The Usos for the Undisputed WWE Tag Team Championship. Superstars compete for a chance to challenge for the United States Championship.

videos.title: August 8, 2022
videos.overview: Ciampa challenges Bobby Lashley for the United States Championship. Rey Mysterio faces The Judgment Day’s Finn Bálor. Angelo Dawkins battles Seth "Freakin" Rollins.

videos.title: August 15, 2022
videos.overview: AJ Styles challenges Bobby Lashley for the United States Championship. Riddle gives an update on his future. The WWE Women's Tag Team Championship Tournament continues.

videos.title: August 22, 2022
videos.overview: A pair of WWE Hall of Famers return to their hometown of Toronto as Edge takes on The Judgment Day's Damian Priest, and Trish Stratus addresses the WWE Universe. Alexa Bliss & Asuka face Dakota Kai & IYO SKY in the semifinals of the WWE Women’s Tag Team Championship Tournament.

videos.title: August 29, 2022
videos.overview: Raquel Rodriguez & Aliyah face Dakota Kai & IYO SKY to crown the new WWE Women’s Tag Team Champions. WWE Hall of Famer Kurt Angle returns to Raw. Matt Riddle and Seth "Freakin" Rollins sit down for an interview ahead of their battle at WWE Clash at the Castle.

videos.title: September 5, 2022
videos.overview: The Miz challenges Bobby Lashley for the United States Championship inside a steel cage. Four tag teams battle to determine the new challengers to the WWE Undisputed Tag Team Championship. A monstrous former WWE Superstar returns.

videos.title: September 12, 2022
videos.overview: Edge looks for payback when he faces The Judgment Day's newest disciple Dominik Mysterio. Johnny Gargano makes his in-ring return against Chad Gable. Dakota Kai & IYO SKY challenge Raquel Rodriguez & Aliyah for the WWE Women's Tag Team Championship.

videos.title: September 19, 2022
videos.overview: Seth "Freakin" Rollins challenges Bobby Lashley for the United States Championship. The Miz calls out the enigmatic Dexter Lumis to explain himself on "Miz TV." Kevin Owens collides with Austin Theory.

videos.title: September 26, 2022
videos.overview: Matt Riddle battles Damian Priest. AJ Styles collides with "Honorary Uce" Sami Zayn. Bianca Belair clashes with IYO SKY. Rey Mysterio faces Seth "Freakin" Rollins. Kevin Owens & Johnny Gargano team up to take on Alpha Academy.

videos.title: October 3, 2022
videos.overview: Bianca Belair and Bayley sign their Raw Women's Championship Ladder Match contract. Rey Mysterio teams with AJ Styles against The Judgment Day. Matt Riddle and Seth "Freakin" Rollins come face-to-face before stepping Inside the Fight Pit. Candice LeRae faces Dakota Kai. Johnny Gargano battles Otis.

videos.title: October 10, 2022
videos.overview: D-Generation X celebrate their 25-year anniversary. Undisputed WWE Universal Champion Roman Reigns and The Bloodline come to Raw. Bobby Lashley defends the United States Championship against Seth “Freakin” Rollins. Johnny Gargano faces Austin Theory.

videos.title: October 17, 2022
videos.overview: Matt Riddle challenges Seth "Freakin" Rollins for the United States Championship. Elias makes his long-awaited return. Brock Lesnar comes to Raw on a collision course with Bobby Lashley. Dexter Lumis receives a Raw contract if he can defeat The Miz.

videos.title: October 24, 2022
videos.overview: Raw Women's Champion Bianca Belair and Bayley continue their rivalry with a head-to-head showdown. The O.C.'s Karl Anderson clashes with The Judgment Day's Finn Bálor. Mustafa Ali battles Austin Theory. Johnny Gargano faces Baron Corbin.

videos.title: October 31, 2022
videos.overview: Matt Riddle collides with Otis in a Trick or Street Fight on a special Halloween edition of Raw. Undisputed WWE Universal Champion Roman Reigns delivers one last message to Logan Paul ahead of WWE Crown Jewel. Bianca Belair faces Nikki Cross.

videos.title: November 7, 2022
videos.overview: Seth "Freakin" Rollins holds a United States Championship Open Challenge. Backup arrives for The O.C. in their conflict against The Judgment Day. The New Day target The Usos ahead of their history-making showdown.

videos.title: November 14, 2022
videos.overview: Seth “Freakin” Rollins faces Finn Bálor for the United States Title. The Miz's public apology on "Miz TV" goes awry thanks to Johnny Gargano and Dexter Lumis. Bianca Belair's WarGames team gets a new member. Matt Riddle collides with Chad Gable.

videos.title: November 21, 2022
videos.overview: The battle lines are drawn on the final Raw before Survivor Series WarGames. Rhea Ripley and Asuka clash in a high-stakes WarGames Advantage Match. The conflict between United States Champion Seth "Freakin" Rollins, Bobby Lashley and Austin Theory escalates. Matt Riddle joins forces with Elias to take on Alpha Academy.

videos.title: November 28, 2022
videos.overview: The conflict between rivals continues after an explosive Survivor Series WarGames. Dexter Lumis can earn a WWE contract if he defeats The Miz one-on-one. Becky Lynch addresses the WWE Universe. The Street Profits return to take on Alpha Academy.

videos.title: December 5, 2022
videos.overview: Raw features two high-stakes Triple Threat Matches as Asuka, Bayley and Rhea Ripley collide, and Becky Lynch, Nikki Cross and Alexa Bliss clash. JBL hosts an invitational poker tournament. Matt Riddle & Elias challenge The Usos for the Undisputed WWE Tag Team Championship.

videos.title: December 12, 2022
videos.overview: Alexa Bliss battles Bayley in a Raw Women's Championship No. 1 Contender's Match. Bobby Lashley collides with Seth "Freakin" Rollins in a United States Championship No. 1 Contender's Match. Candice LeRae faces Damage CTRL's Iyo Sky.

videos.title: December 19, 2022
videos.overview: With a bundle of money hanging above the ring, Dexter Lumis and The Miz clash in a Winner Takes All Ladder Match. Becky Lynch battles Bayley. Former tag team partners reconnect to take on The Usos. The Street Profits face The Judgment Day's Finn Bálor and Damian Priest.

videos.title: December 26, 2022
videos.overview: The final Raw of 2022 highlights the best matches and moments from an unforgettable year in a special episode.

videos.title: January 2, 2023
videos.overview: The Bloodline look to make a statement on the first Raw of 2023. Raw Women's Champion Bianca Belair defends her title against Alexa Bliss. Seth "Freakin” Rollins challenges Austin Theory for the United States Championship.

videos.title: January 9, 2023
videos.overview: Alexa Bliss continues down a dark road. Dominik Mysterio opens up about his time in prison on "Miz TV." New challengers to the Undisputed WWE Tag Team Championship emerge through Tag Team Turmoil. Kevin Owens brings the fight to The Bloodline.

videos.title: January 16, 2023
videos.overview: Bobby Lashley was victorious in a Six-Way Elimination Match for a United States Title opportunity, The Judgment Day outlasted Alpha Academy, Bronson Reed made a statement debut and much more.

videos.title: January 23, 2023
videos.overview: A historic episode of Raw celebrates 30 years of the Monday night staple with appearances by WWE Legends such as Hulk Hogan, Ric Flair, D-Generation X and Undertaker. The Bloodline put Sami Zayn on trial in Tribal Court. Bobby Lashley challenges Austin Theory for the United States Title. Becky Lynch collides with Bayley inside a steel cage.

videos.title: January 30, 2023
videos.overview: In an explosive Raw main event, Royal Rumble winner Cody Rhodes took down Finn Bálor as The Rated-R Superstar and The Glamazon laid waste to Damian Priest, Dominik Mysterio and Rhea Ripley at ringside. Plus, Ripley declared she will face Charlotte Flair at WrestleMania, Rhodes geared up to challenge Undisputed WWE Universal Champion Roman Reigns at The Show of Shows, three Superstars qualified for the U.S. Title Elimination Chamber Match, and a Women’s Elimination Chamber Match was established to determine who will battle the Raw Women’s Champion.

videos.title: February 6, 2023
videos.overview: Becky Lynch and Bayley finally clash inside a steel cage. Michin, Candice LeRae, Carmella and Piper Niven battle for the right to step into the Elimination Chamber. Angelo Dawkins takes on Damian Priest, and Montez Ford faces Elias in United States Title Elimination Chamber Qualifying Matches.

videos.title: February 13, 2023
videos.overview: Brock Lesnar and Bobby Lashley meet in a massive encounter to sign their WWE Elimination Chamber contract. Elimination Chamber Match entrants clash in a Raw vs. SmackDown Six-Woman Tag Team Match when Asuka, Carmella & Nikki Cross battle Raquel Rodriguez, Liv Morgan & Natalya. Seth "Freakin" Rollins joins "Miz TV."

videos.title: February 20, 2023
videos.overview: Sami Zayn addresses the WWE Universe after his emotional showdown against Roman Reigns at WWE Elimination Chamber. United States Champion Austin Theory defends his title against Edge. Bayley hosts “Ding Dong, Hello!” with Dakota Kai & IYO Sky. Seth "Freakin" Rollins clashes with The Miz.

videos.title: February 27, 2023
videos.overview: On the ultra-turbulent Road to WrestleMania, WWE Hall of Famer Trish Stratus emerged to help The Man and Lita conquer IYO SKY & Dakota Kai and claim the WWE Women’s Tag Team Championships! Plus, Brock Lesnar agreed to battle Omos at The Show of Shows before taking out MVP with the F-5, Seth “Freakin” Rollins “borrowed” Miz’s phone to place a call and invite Logan Paul to meet him in the ring, and Bray Wyatt performed “The Muscle Man Dance” for Bobby Lashley.

videos.title: March 6, 2023
videos.overview: Raw moves into overdrive on The Road to WrestleMania, as “Main Event” Jey Uso makes a shocking return to help The Bloodline’s Jimmy Uso and Solo Sikoa launch a vicious assault on the one-time “Honorary Uce.” Plus, three WrestleMania Matches are made official, including John Cena accepting United States Champion Austin Theory’s challenge with a scathing indictment on the mic. and so much more. Catch WWE action on Peacock, WWE Network, FOX, USA Network, Sony India and more.

videos.title: March 13, 2023
videos.overview: Thanks to a surprise attack from The Usos, Solo Sikoa reigned supreme over Kevin Owens in a brutal Street Fight. Plus, Omos threw Brock Lesnar from the squared circle, Edge challenged Finn Bálor to a Hell in a Cell Match at WrestleMania and so much more.

videos.title: March 20, 2023
videos.overview: Roman Reigns and Cody Rhodes come face-to-face, Bianca Belair and Asuka join forces, Rhea Ripley faces a challenge from Bayley, Kevin Owens & Sami Zayn unite against The Usos, Logan Paul brings IMPAULSIVE TV to Raw and much more.

videos.title: March 27, 2023
videos.overview: On WrestleMania Raw, The American Nightmare overcame the undefeated Solo Sikoa before the biggest match of his career against Undisputed WWE Universal Champion Roman Reigns at WrestleMania, Omos dropped Brock Lesnar when their WrestleMania weigh-in descended into an all-out brawl, Sonya Deville & Chelsea Green overcame Michin & Candice LeRae to qualify for the WrestleMania Showcase and so much more.

videos.title: April 3, 2023
videos.overview: On a tremendous Monday Night Raw, Brock Lesnar assaulted his would-be partner Cody Rhodes, absolutely decimating The American Nightmare! Plus, Damian Priest sent Bad Bunny though an announce table, Riddle made his stunning return, Kevin Owens and Sami Zayn beat The Street Profits, Raquel Rodriguez and Liv Morgan earned a WWE Women’s Tag Team Title Match and so much more!

videos.title: April 10, 2023
videos.overview: In Raw’s turbulent main event, Sami Zayn and Matt Riddle arrived on Raw from a travel delay just in time to help Kevin Owens repel a 3-on-1 attack by The Usos and Solo Sikoa in a chaotic Raw main event showdown. Plus, Raquel Rodriguez & Liv Morgan captured the WWE Women's Tag Team Titles from Becky Lynch & WWE Hall of Famer Trish Stratus and Cody Rhodes challenged Brock Lesnar to a match at WWE Backlash.

videos.title: April 17, 2023
videos.overview: On an incredible Monday Night Raw, Kevin Owens, Sami Zayn, Matt Riddle, The LWO, The Judgment Day and The Bloodline engaged in an all-out brawl after KO, Zayn and Riddle defeated The Judgment Day! Plus, Solo Sikoa dispatched Rey Mysterio, Trish Stratus explained her shocking betrayal of Lita and Becky Lynch, the match between Cody Rhodes and Brock Lesnar was made for WWE Backlash and so much more!

videos.title: April 24, 2023
videos.overview: On a game-changing Monday Night Raw, Bad Bunny sought payback by attacking Damian Priest with a Kendo stick before challenging The Archer of Infamy to a San Juan Street Fight! Plus, Triple H revealed the World Heavyweight Championship, Cody Rhodes earned a win over Finn Bálor, and so much more!

videos.title: May 1, 2023
videos.overview: Night Two of the 2023 WWE Draft got started with an early bang as SmackDown Women's Champion Rhea Ripley, United States Champion Austin Theory, Seth "Freakin" Rollins and Charlotte Flair were drafted during the First Round. Plus, Seth "Freakin" Rollins took on Solo Sikoa and Cody Rhodes, and Brock Lesnar needed security to keep them apart and so much more!

videos.title: May 8, 2023
videos.overview: After battling through a brutal Triple Threat Match and a hard-hitting main event showdown against Finn Bálor, Seth “Freakin” Rollins became the first competitor who will battle for the World Heavyweight Title at WWE Night of Champions. Plus, Brock Lesnar laid waste to Cody Rhodes before challenging him to a rematch at Night of Champions and so much more.

videos.title: May 15, 2023
videos.overview: On a momentous Monday Night Raw, Paul Heyman found a way to undermine Kevin Owens and Sami Zayn as Imperium helped The Judgment Day gain a victory over the Undisputed WWE Tag Team Champions. Plus, Cody Rhodes told Brock Lesnar to get out of his way, Becky Lynch challenged Trish Stratus to a match at WWE Night of Champions, Mustafa Ali earned an Intercontinental Title Match against Gunther and so much more!

videos.title: May 22, 2023
videos.overview: On the final Raw before WWE Night of Champions, Undisputed WWE Tag Team Champions Kevin Owens and Sami Zayn joined forces with Matt Riddle to reign supreme over Intercontinental Champion Gunther, Ludwig Kaiser and Giovanni Vinci. Plus, Brock Lesnar injured Cody Rhodes in a pair of brutal attacks and so much more.

videos.title: May 29, 2023
videos.overview: Just two days after they battled each other for title gold, the new World Heavyweight Champion Seth “Freakin” Rollins joined forces with AJ Styles to overcome Finn Bálor & Damian Priest of The Judgment Day. Plus, Ronda Rousey & Shayna Baszler emerged victorious in a Fatal 4-Way Match to capture the WWE Tag Team Titles, Cody Rhodes made an open challenge to Brock Lesnar and so much more.

videos.title: June 5, 2023
videos.overview: Seth "Freakin" Rollins overcame a challenge from Damian Priest for the World Heavyweight Title, Becky Lynch and Zoey Stark punched their tickets to the Women's Money in the Bank Ladder Match, Dominik Mysterio crashed Cody Rhodes' appearance on "Miz TV," and more.

videos.title: June 12, 2023
videos.overview: On a momentous Monday Night Raw, Undisputed WWE Tag Team Champions Kevin Owens and Sami Zayn defeated Intercontinental Champion Gunther and Ludwig Kaiser to retain their gold. Plus, Damian Priest became the final entrant in the Men’s Money in the Bank Ladder Match by defeating Matt Riddle, Finn Bálor challenged Seth “Freakin” Rollins for the World Heavyweight Title at WWE Money in the Bank, Rhea Ripley was presented with the new Women’s World Championship and so much more!

videos.title: June 19, 2023
videos.overview: In an action-packed Raw main event, The American Nightmare and Undisputed WWE Tag Team Champions Kevin Owens & Sami Zayn emerged victorious and handed The Judgment Day a rare defeat. Plus, Logan Paul returned to the red brand to reveal that he had been invited into Money in the Bank Ladder Match and ignited a brawl ensues between all the Money in the Bank Ladder Match participants in the process.

videos.title: June 26, 2023
videos.overview: On the final Raw before WWE Money in the Bank,  The American Nightmare geared up for Dominik Mysterio by overcoming major interference from The Judgment Day and reigning supreme over Damian Priest. Plus, Seth “Freakin” Rollins brawled with Finn Bálor, the Women’s Money in the Bank Ladder Match combatants looked to rip each other apart, Matt Riddle helped Kevin Owens and Sami Zayn even the odds against Imperium, Ronda Rousey defeated Raquel Rodriguez and so much more.

videos.title: July 3, 2023
videos.overview: On a wild Monday Night Raw, World Heavyweight Champion Seth “Freakin” Rollins fended off a Damian Priest Money in the Bank cash-in attempt after Finn Bálor inadvertently interfered with his fellow Judgment Day member. Plus, Rhea Ripley retained her Women’s World Title against Natalya, Brock Lesnar and Cody Rhodes engaged in a fierce brawl, Ronda Rousey and Shayna Baszler had a war of words that evolved into physicality and so much more!

videos.title: July 10, 2023

videos.title: July 17, 2023
videos.overview: On a rambunctious Monday Night Raw, Kevin Owens and Sami Zayn retained their WWE Undisputed Tag Team Titles against Damian Priest and Dominik Mysterio of The Judgment Day! Plus, Chelsea Green and Sonya Deville were crowned the new WWE Women’s Tag Team Champions, Cody Rhodes vs. Brock Lesnar as well as Seth “Freakin” Rollins vs. Finn Bálor for the World Heavyweight Title were made for SummerSlam, and so much more!

videos.title: July 24, 2023
videos.overview: Moments after Seth “Freakin” Rollins made his World Heavyweight Title Rematch against Finn Bálor official for SummerSlam, The Judgment Day followed up the vicious attacks of Kevin Owens, Liv Morgan and Apollo Crews earlier in the night with a brutal beatdown of The Visionary and Sami Zayn.

videos.title: July 31, 2023
videos.overview: On the final Raw before SummerSlam, World Heavyweight Champion Seth Rollins and Undisputed WWE Tag Team Champion Sami Zayn overcame Damian Priest and “Dirty” Dom Mysterio. videos.title: August 7, 2023
videos.overview: On an incredible Monday Night Raw, Shinsuke Nakamura leveled Seth “Freakin” Rollins with the Kinshasa moments after he, Rollins and Cody Rhodes beat The Judgment Day! Plus, Chad Gable became the next challenger to Gunther’s Intercontinental Title, Raquel Rodriguez obliterated Rhea Ripley, The New Day made a winning return over The Viking Raiders and so much more!

videos.title: August 21, 2023
